Practice-squad additions included Will Levis among several new names as the team digests an overtime loss to Green Bay. Coach Aaron Glenn continues to stress defensive yardage strength while looking ahead to Detroit.

10c631125e29b635579fb12a76ab1bcf80c2743c.headline: Penguins list Ben Kindel day-to-day with lower-body injury after shot block
10c631125e29b635579fb12a76ab1bcf80c2743c.summary: Pittsburgh said Tuesday that 19-year-old forward Ben Kindel is day-to-day with a lower-body injury after leaving Monday’s preseason win over Buffalo late in the first period when he blocked a shot with his foot. Kindel had centered a line with Bryan Rust and Andrei Kuzmenko before exiting. With Blake Lizotte also banged up, the Penguins’ center depth is already a story as camp rolls toward the Sept. 30 opener.

e481ff19f4eb3139072ca507fcb8cc387e27bd67.headline: Connecticut Renaissance Faire heads into Faerie Ring Revels weekend (Sept 26–27)
e481ff19f4eb3139072ca507fcb8cc387e27bd67.summary: The Connecticut Renaissance Faire in Lebanon continues its 2026 season with Faerie Ring Revels on September 26–27, featuring fairy and flora costume contests after Shirefolk Weekend. The faire runs on select weekends through late October. For anyone mapping a New England autumn outing with jousts, crafts, and themed weekends, this is the near-term date to circle.

51bc4570441adae9e66db69d433188ca58f18ce9.headline: New England fall foliage 2026: healthier color after a wet reset, slower peak march
51bc4570441adae9e66db69d433188ca58f18ce9.summary: WBUR’s free foliage outlook says New England’s 2026 color season should look healthier than last year’s dull, early drop after a classic snowy winter and summer rain recharged soils. Peak still marches north-to-south — far northern New England late September, central mid-October, coastal Connecticut late October into early November — but a gradual cooldown may stretch the show. Early color seekers should head north over the next couple of weeks.

6975ad191d5193a5b736715f9800be6f38a46fd2.headline: Westport Volunteer EMS recruiting for EMT course — life-saving skills for Fairfield County
6975ad191d5193a5b736715f9800be6f38a46fd2.summary: Westport Volunteer EMS continues its long local tradition of training community EMTs, with coursework covering bandaging, childbirth, and multi-system trauma under veteran instructors. Officials say seats fill quickly with adults from across Fairfield County who want to volunteer. The squad’s mix of paid staff, volunteers, and Norwalk Hospital paramedic backup underpins 24/7 coverage for the town.

7b5dabe2899a0b12cb00d51c8ec369b244c6ae50.headline: Karen Woodall clarifies unauthorized article and distances work from PASG framing
7b5dabe2899a0b12cb00d51c8ec369b244c6ae50.summary: On September 11 expert Karen Woodall publicly clarified that an article bearing her name and photo appeared in Contemporary Family Quarterly without her submission or permission. She notes she left the Parental Alienation Study Group in 2019 and no longer uses classic parental-alienation diagnostic frameworks, focusing instead on children’s attachment adaptations and coerced alignment. Her book The Journey of the Alienated Child is slated for Routledge this autumn.

a6a1c769ad206ea8ac84b34fb98b2510edb4b290.headline: iPhone Duo countdown: 15 features to know before October pre-orders
a6a1c769ad206ea8ac84b34fb98b2510edb4b290.summary: Apple’s first foldable iPhone Duo is racing toward October 16 pre-orders and an October 23 launch after the September 9 “Surprise and Shine” event. MacRumors rounds up hinge design, dual displays, A20 Pro silicon, dual-battery behavior, IP68 sealing, and the $1,999 starting price. Separately, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 with the new Health Sensing System began shipping September 18.

4e351a7cffe6a1e21731c0937be201caca32a36d.headline: 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A: retro tribute to the original Willys CJ-2A
4e351a7cffe6a1e21731c0937be201caca32a36d.summary: Jeep’s September reveal of the Wrangler JL-2A — part of the Twelve 4 Twelve special-edition run — tips its hat to the 1945 Willys CJ-2A with retro styling on a Rubicon foundation. Orders are expected to open in October for a limited run aimed at heritage buyers. Separately, Jeep and Harley-Davidson kept their European community partnership visible at Bike Week earlier this month.

e2a63fc3fdc76961a27aa83ac6bc7410bf80a3b1.headline: Penguins’ center depth already tested as Kindel and Lizotte deal with injuries
e2a63fc3fdc76961a27aa83ac6bc7410bf80a3b1.summary: Pittsburgh’s preseason opened with a 4–1 win over Buffalo and a 7–4 loss to Detroit, but the bigger story is early injury noise down the middle. TribLive reports Ben Kindel and Blake Lizotte issues already stressing center depth, with additional day-to-day tags on Brazeau and Koivunen. Fans tracking the Penguins’ runway into the regular season will want every update from camp medicals.

f0c3da000241fb7c903f09cc74344aa1cad96961.headline: Adirondacks travel pitch: peak foliage paired with family adventure
f0c3da000241fb7c903f09cc74344aa1cad96961.summary: As September tips into foliage season, the Adirondacks are getting fresh national travel ink for combining early color with family-friendly outdoor itineraries. Guides emphasize shoulder-season pacing — cooler hikes, lake towns, and fewer midsummer crowds than peak July. Elsewhere, fall destination marketing is pushing Smokies and Great Lakes alternatives alongside classic New England leaf-peeping.

a51e8bf028eb1a53147e91533c72e669aff60684.headline: Trumbull Farm Fair Sept. 26 at Chester Hill Farm — pony rides and barn open house
a51e8bf028eb1a53147e91533c72e669aff60684.summary: Chester Hill Farm in Trumbull will host a farm fair Saturday, Sept. 26, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. at 55 Old Dairy Road. The hunter/jumper facility plans pony rides, a barn open house, local vendors, and a tack tag sale on its 20-acre campus.

52090a36294737ee23549be657afb75965f5000c.headline: Marjorie Taylor Greene at TribFest: ‘MAGA is dead,’ calls movement a cult
52090a36294737ee23549be657afb75965f5000c.summary: Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene told the Texas Tribune Festival that “MAGA is dead,” labeling the broader Trump movement a “cult” while saying she still believes in America First. She cited broken campaign promises, the Iran war, and private Republican fear of Trump’s Truth Social posts after her public break with the president.

3276da8004cc960f98534927782755e204dd74fc.headline: Trump and Xi trade warm state-dinner toasts with little progress on Taiwan or AI
3276da8004cc960f98534927782755e204dd74fc.summary: At a lavish White House state dinner, Trump and Xi Jinping traded warm toasts about harmony and responsible major-power ties, but offered little public progress on Taiwan, trade, or AI rivalry. Tech CEOs including Elon Musk, Tim Cook, and Jensen Huang joined the meal as Xi heads into a Friday Archives tour before departing.

c4629a2e647dc9e04c45060f70dc62e58d0c35a3.headline: HSI and FBI arrest Senegalese LPR accused of voting in multiple N.J. elections
c4629a2e647dc9e04c45060f70dc62e58d0c35a3.summary: Homeland Security Investigations and the FBI arrested Sanata Coulibaly, a Senegalese lawful permanent resident, on charges of unlawful naturalization procurement and voting by an alien. DHS says she allegedly voted in the 2018, 2020, and 2024 New Jersey general elections and admitted voting in 2020 and 2024.

44e23e8d40c81af223a3261e33b468fde72f6f3e.headline: Two hurt as activists and ICE clash at Meriden courthouse
44e23e8d40c81af223a3261e33b468fde72f6f3e.summary: A confrontation at Meriden’s courthouse left one activist pepper-sprayed and another taken by ambulance after being pushed during an ICE arrest. Activists argued agents violated Connecticut’s Trust Act mask and courthouse limits; Judicial Branch officials said marshals received a warrant and are reviewing video.

409973b619b40df116d45470592644869c9eec30.headline: CT volunteer firefighter ranks shrink — state launches fire-protection audit
409973b619b40df116d45470592644869c9eec30.summary: Connecticut Public reports the state has lost nearly two-thirds of its volunteer firefighters since 2017, with over 60% of departments still volunteer-run. Officials cite two-income households, leadership, and training gaps as daytime staffing frays, while a new law will require local fire-protection plans starting in July 2027.

c9ba518b090ba768e2e99538f915666cfd3fc49f.headline: ‘MacBook Ultra’ rumored with OLED, touchscreen, Dynamic Island, thinner design
c9ba518b090ba768e2e99538f915666cfd3fc49f.summary: MacRumors rounds up reports that Apple’s next high-end laptop may debut as a MacBook Ultra above today’s M5 Pro/Max MacBook Pros, with OLED panels, native touch, a reinforced hinge, a thinner chassis, and an interactive Dynamic Island-style cutout. Timing is loosely pegged for late 2026 amid memory-chip constraints.

a64523c228d27e9d7896b04532440b88a619927f.headline: Insta360 Spatial Capture turns X5/X6 360 video into walkable 3D scenes — free Sept. 28
a64523c228d27e9d7896b04532440b88a619927f.summary: Insta360’s Spatial Capture update, due Sept. 28, converts up to two minutes of 360 video from the X6, X5, and X4 Air into explorable 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes in the cloud. Owners of last-gen cameras get the feature without buying new hardware; four scene generations a month are free.

09880ff7909a00f3b829f4289d7f60fb15e2b766.headline: Penguins prospects blanked 4–0 by Blue Jackets in preseason Game 3
09880ff7909a00f3b829f4289d7f60fb15e2b766.summary: Pittsburgh’s mostly young lineup was shut out 4–0 in Columbus as Sergei Murashov played the full game. Coach Dan Muse praised the work ethic against a veteran Blue Jackets group and called the matchup a useful evaluation ahead of the Sept. 29 regular-season opener.

2f9af1e54c2a776fe4eda71f9b75aca4412c54d4.headline: Starship aces Flight 14 wet dress; Monday orbital attempt still targeted
2f9af1e54c2a776fe4eda71f9b75aca4412c54d4.summary: SpaceX completed a wet dress rehearsal for Starship Flight 14, keeping a Monday Sept. 28 window that opens at 8:15 a.m. EDT. The planned first orbital attempt would send Ship around Earth six times, deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites, and splash down off Chile.

44af46eb335a6ef8534647da6614063b9cd55c89.headline: Tesla Android app leak shows Optimus ‘Gen 3’ robot asset filenames
44af46eb335a6ef8534647da6614063b9cd55c89.summary: A teardown of Tesla’s Android app found signed assets labeled robot_*_gen3.png, confirming an internal Gen 3 Optimus label. The sealed-joint renders look more finished than prior demos; Tesla has not commented on timing as Optimus factory work at Giga Texas continues.

f6da7cbf8c05634fa6e0ca606beb15e6ccf7cf02.headline: LEGO Icons SpongeBob Bikini Bottom: 1,794 pieces, $219.99, now on sale
f6da7cbf8c05634fa6e0ca606beb15e6ccf7cf02.summary: LEGO’s first adult SpongeBob set (11386) builds Bikini Bottom with SpongeBob’s pineapple, Squidward’s house, Patrick’s rock, and Jellyfish Fields across 1,794 pieces for $219.99. Minifigures plus brick-built Gary and DoodleBob ship with the set, on sale since Sept. 1 after a July unveil.

880310139bce655f2f33426072def08ebef98203.headline: National Public Lands Day Sept. 26: Forest Service and Army Corps fee waivers — not all parks
880310139bce655f2f33426072def08ebef98203.summary: Saturday’s National Public Lands Day waives many Forest Service day-use and Army Corps recreation fees, but it is not a nationwide National Park Service free-entry day. Planners should verify the land manager, concession rules, and whether volunteer events offer a future-entry coupon.

c37124f3360f996307694cd2aa8846822f33e6cf.headline: Jets enter Lions Week 3 No. 1 in total defense; Glenn calls Ford Field ‘a place we want to win’
c37124f3360f996307694cd2aa8846822f33e6cf.summary: Official Lions coverage of Jets Week 3 quotes Aaron Glenn on returning to Ford Field and highlights New York’s No. 1 total and rush defense after holding Titans and Packers under 200 yards. Jets players flag Jahmyr Gibbs as the top run-stopping challenge Sunday.

c0362a9cda55d1afffc28816da6998b33d4ee64d.headline: Trumbull Eagles bounce back 27–14 over Crosby; Volpicelli racks up 116 yards and 2 scores
c0362a9cda55d1afffc28816da6998b33d4ee64d.summary: After a blowout loss to New Canaan, Trumbull beat Crosby 27–14 as Cade Volpicelli hauled in 116 receiving yards and two touchdowns, including a 75-yard score. The Eagles piled up 422 total yards to move to 1–1 and host Norwalk at 7 p.m. Friday for their home opener.

196438fc436b324e0ce6f38678eb90fe2c9f9095.headline: Xi caps Trump state visit with National Archives tour before departing Washington
196438fc436b324e0ce6f38678eb90fe2c9f9095.summary: After Oval Office talks on tariffs, rare earths, fentanyl, and export controls, Trump and Xi closed the two-and-a-half-day summit with morning tea and a National Archives viewing of historic U.S.–China records. Xi also announced two pandas for Zoo Atlanta and invited 100,000 young Americans to visit China, while Hong Kong protests echoed outside the White House.

9cd1ca2d6d06e3acf6c2596fd8ca0b3ca310b4ac.headline: Mike Lee presses SAVE Act after report of 30,000 noncitizens mistakenly on voter rolls
9cd1ca2d6d06e3acf6c2596fd8ca0b3ca310b4ac.summary: Sen. Mike Lee (R-Utah) blasted resistance to the SAVE America Act after a Reuters review found more than 30,000 self-declared noncitizens added to U.S. voter rolls since 2000, largely blamed on software and clerical errors. Lee argued current bans on noncitizen voting are nearly unenforceable and urged citizenship verification plus voter ID; the House-passed bill remains stalled in the Senate.

cac80f23e1684569a38276327a1bfb181f98f3d8.headline: ICE Dallas arrests 121 in Lake Lewisville summer ops — including two Tren de Aragua members
cac80f23e1684569a38276327a1bfb181f98f3d8.summary: ICE Dallas said a summer enforcement initiative around Lake Lewisville netted 121 arrests, including two self-admitted Tren de Aragua members investigated for an illegal boat-livery operation. Partners helped free local officers for peak boating season while targeting assault, family violence, DWI, and child sex-offense histories among those taken into custody.

daa31717be9eb7f68d9bd64c1b1b6d2b13d5ae50.headline: Man charged with arson after fire at Montville halfway house with 23 people inside
daa31717be9eb7f68d9bd64c1b1b6d2b13d5ae50.summary: Connecticut State Police say Juan Betancourt, 42, of New Haven, lit a fire Thursday night at Cochegan House in Montville, putting 23 people at risk before fleeing. Troopers found him on Route 32; he was charged with first-degree arson, criminal mischief, interfering, and reckless endangerment and held on $250,000 bond.

142b7a995017abbd890afd8e7533c5848b363fd0.headline: Stamford police: two arrested after cocaine-and-gun search warrants
142b7a995017abbd890afd8e7533c5848b363fd0.summary: After a monthlong narcotics probe, Stamford detectives executed warrants on Sept. 17 and seized powder cocaine, packaging, a scale, nearly $5,000 cash, and a loaded Smith & Wesson .32 handgun. Victor Martinez, 47, and Brenis Arias-Arias, 53, face drug and weapons charges with court dates set for Oct. 1.

90d3aca5a326e3e313b9c4f1d8684883ee0c15c9.headline: iPhone 18 Pro Max ships in four hardware versions — U.S. model keeps Qualcomm modem
90d3aca5a326e3e313b9c4f1d8684883ee0c15c9.summary: MacRumors details four Pro Max SKUs: the U.S. eSIM-only A3473 with mmWave and Qualcomm’s X80 modem, a non-mmWave eSIM model for Canada/Japan, a nano-SIM Europe unit, and a China A3718. eSIM-only phones carry larger ~5,567 mAh batteries versus ~5,391 mAh trayside models — roughly an extra hour of typical use.

664c1645ba4360012e874015818cb84871357253.headline: First look: HomePod mini 2 keeps the sphere, adds green and pink — drops yellow and orange
664c1645ba4360012e874015818cb84871357253.summary: MacRumors published Apple’s own coded product icons for HomePod mini 2 in green, pink, blue, white, and black — dropping the original’s yellow and orange. The spherical design stays; a newer chip and Siri AI support are expected as Apple aims for a late-2026 launch after holding the refresh for personalized Siri.

ffefa32311fe43fa6ea2951a278270565cb50c89.headline: LEGO Icons Star Trek Enterprise Bridge: 1,701 pieces, eight crew, $199.99 — on sale now
ffefa32311fe43fa6ea2951a278270565cb50c89.summary: LEGO’s second Star Trek set recreates the original-series U.S.S. Enterprise bridge and transporter room in 1,701 pieces — a nod to NCC-1701 — with a rocking captain’s chair, transporter dial, and turbo-lift doors. Eight Starfleet minifigures plus tribbles ship for $199.99; the set launched Sept. 1 for Star Trek’s 60th anniversary month.

9dec904fa462289ea6b86e82ace07ba0c097e194.headline: Jets special teams grind extras ahead of Lions — Williams catches 85 practice punts
9dec904fa462289ea6b86e82ace07ba0c097e194.summary: After muffed punts vs. Green Bay, returner Isaiah Williams logged 85 extra practice catches while coordinator Chris Banjo stressed earning it every week against Detroit. Injuries forced Arian Smith and Marcelino McCrary-Ball to IR; Troy Reeder, Jack Heflin, and Malik McClain joined the 53 as the unit preps for Ford Field.

b6ad761f2fed82486fac166c0724749fa3c265df.headline: Penguins’ Ben Kindel downgraded to week-to-week after 4–0 preseason loss in Columbus
b6ad761f2fed82486fac166c0724749fa3c265df.summary: Pittsburgh’s B-squad fell 4–0 to Columbus in preseason game three, and forward Ben Kindel was moved from day-to-day to week-to-week with a lower-body injury. PensBurgh also notes Andrei Kuzmenko’s leave after his father’s death, Caleb Jones skating again, and 10 players assigned to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton ahead of Saturday’s finale.

68842afeb3bb94b6fd65133a54f7fc778fc66297.headline: National Public Lands Day at Minute Man: volunteer stewardship Saturday at North Bridge
68842afeb3bb94b6fd65133a54f7fc778fc66297.summary: Friends of Minute Man National Park invite volunteers Saturday, Sept. 26, 9 a.m.–1 p.m. at Concord’s North Bridge for invasive-plant removal, orchard and trail care, and trash pickup under the theme “Caring for Our Shared America.” Participants get a fee-free public-lands coupon; the free event marks America 250 stewardship near the Revolutionary battlefield.

2beae46c69654a4c0170a12e908eabf473c8fb75.headline: Trumbull Arts Festival postponed to Oct. 11 after nor’easter advisory
2beae46c69654a4c0170a12e908eabf473c8fb75.summary: Town officials said Friday the Trumbull Arts Festival, planned for Sunday on the Town Hall Green, has been rescheduled to Oct. 11 under advice from Trumbull Emergency Management. A hazardous-weather outlook for a powerful weekend nor’easter prompted the delay; the event still invites residents to support local art and live entertainment when it returns.

f12c6f394c4e107a1a497d8a0264397b84583f24.headline: Supreme Court clears Trump admin to use modified SAVE voter-citizenship database
f12c6f394c4e107a1a497d8a0264397b84583f24.summary: In an unsigned Friday opinion 39 days before the Nov. 3 midterms, the justices paused a D.C. district-court block on DHS’s expanded SAVE system, which taps Social Security data for state voter-citizenship checks. The majority said challengers’ privacy claims likely lack merit; Justices Jackson, Sotomayor, and Kagan dissented, warning of harms to lawful voters even as systematic purges remain barred within 90 days of an election.

0d61bbda1600d46d7a66f577e7dd2f73f749bfca.headline: Trump books Mobile midterm rally Oct. 2 at USA Mitchell Center
0d61bbda1600d46d7a66f577e7dd2f73f749bfca.summary: President Trump will hold a Trump 47 Committee midterm rally Friday, Oct. 2, at the University of South Alabama’s Mitchell Center in Mobile. Doors open at 3:30 p.m. with the program at 6 p.m.; attendees must RSVP. The stop pairs with a Durant, Oklahoma, rally the day before as the White House returns to the trail after the Xi state visit.

b5b7c488e14f956e32a8d0cf234657dd962bf461.headline: WSHU: Did masked ICE agents break Connecticut’s TRUST Act at Meriden courthouse?
b5b7c488e14f956e32a8d0cf234657dd962bf461.summary: Connecticut’s TRUST Act bars ICE from wearing masks and from courthouse arrests without a warrant — rules activists say agents flouted Wednesday in Meriden. Gov. Ned Lamont told reporters the agents lacked a warrant; ICE said it arrested a man with a 2023 removal order after a DUI court date and accused marshals of impeding the arrest. Two activists were hurt in the clash.

a26b1c3a13ee11f5267e34f86efe8a5125815e98.headline: iPad mini 8 leak: A20 Pro chip, landscape front camera, new speakers
a26b1c3a13ee11f5267e34f86efe8a5125815e98.summary: Apple code spotted by MacRumors shows the next iPad mini with an A20 Pro chip, a landscape FaceTime camera (the last iPad to make the switch), and a speaker cutout groove atop the glass. The icons align with Mark Gurman’s water-resistance and vibration-speaker reports; an OLED bump and late-October launch remain the working rumor.

99b2e829716c0d67bfa56083d34b0ec9e96c9a28.headline: Apple TV 4K (4th gen) image surfaces — A17 Pro, 8GB RAM, Wi-Fi 7 rumored
99b2e829716c0d67bfa56083d34b0ec9e96c9a28.summary: MacRumors found Apple’s own “Apple TV 4K (4th generation)” product image, ending a nearly four-year wait since the A15 model. Specs are still rumor-tier — A17 Pro or newer, 8GB RAM for Siri AI, N1 Wi-Fi 7/Bluetooth 6, and a revised Siri Remote — with the same black-box shell and an October announcement window in play after June’s price hike to $199/$249.

dcf59273d0943bbc20807260d1d28e25b5badbde.headline: LEGO Astro Bot GWP revealed: 276 pieces, swappable eyes — tied to PlayStation set
dcf59273d0943bbc20807260d1d28e25b5badbde.summary: LEGO’s official store page confirms the 18+ Astro Bot set: 276 pieces, about eight inches tall, with dynamic posing and swappable eyes. It’s a gift-with-purchase, not a standalone buy — likely paired with the $179.99 PlayStation set or a ~$150 cart — launching Oct. 1 for Insiders and Oct. 4 for everyone alongside the console diorama set.

cb216bd09a39b233b2091a911d07ffd4c955f7a7.headline: Jets: Adonai Mitchell limited with finger snag; Shepard or Johnson likely elevated
cb216bd09a39b233b2091a911d07ffd4c955f7a7.summary: Ahead of Sunday at Detroit, Aaron Glenn said Adonai Mitchell will be limited again after catching a finger in a jersey Thursday — Glenn doesn’t think it’s broken but stayed coy on Week 3 availability. Mitchell has nine catches for 123 yards; Glenn also said either Tyler Johnson or Sterling Shepard will be elevated from the practice squad with Mason Taylor doubtful.

0116200140a482b838321b2d15ef1190fb9e655e.headline: CT nor’easter: Wind Advisory and coastal flood warnings through Sunday
0116200140a482b838321b2d15ef1190fb9e655e.summary: A Wind Advisory covers all of Connecticut Friday afternoon through Sunday morning, with gusts over 50 mph possible especially along the shore. Coastal Flood Advisories and Warnings flag minor-to-moderate inundation at high tides Friday evening through Sunday morning as rain arrives late Friday and lingers into Monday — the same system that pushed Trumbull to postpone Sunday’s Arts Festival.

7d20cca47be2ec064715e325ff155209e3b4351d.headline: Trumbull boys soccer’s unbeaten run ends 1–0 at Ridgefield; Stamford next Saturday
7d20cca47be2ec064715e325ff155209e3b4351d.summary: Trumbull fell 1–0 to Ridgefield on Thursday, its first loss after opening 4–0–1 against the Tigers’ tight defense. Ridgefield improved to 4–0–1; the Eagles host conference foe Stamford at 11:15 a.m. Saturday while Ridgefield faces Ludlowe at 10 a.m.

27480cc8479812c92a01783672e9fc2c9cba9d5f.headline: LEGO October 2026 guide: Avengers Doomsday wave and Vader lightsaber GWP
27480cc8479812c92a01783672e9fc2c9cba9d5f.summary: The Brick Fan’s Friday October shopping guide highlights a busy month of Christmas prep and Avengers: Doomsday sets landing Oct. 4 — including the Quinjet, Epic Battle, and New Avengers Tower BrickHeadz/playsets. Confirmed promotion: LEGO Star Wars Darth Vader’s Lightsaber (40897) as a gift-with-purchase with the UCS Executor Super Star Destroyer from Oct. 1–10 while supplies last. A rumored PlayStation set promo is still unconfirmed.

9d4c01f3f67db08525b64927c116d1701fc95e99.headline: Archie McDonald wins inaugural FIM Harley-Davidson Bagger World Cup
9d4c01f3f67db08525b64927c116d1701fc95e99.summary: Joe Rascal Racing’s Archie McDonald sealed the first FIM Harley-Davidson Bagger World Cup title at the Red Bull Ring finale, finishing nine points clear after a Saturday crash took rivals Granado and Iannone out of the fight. McDonald managed Race 2 to eighth on his Road Glide and dedicated the championship to his late brother Toby. Harley racing chief Jeffrey Schuessler said the series aims to grow teams, races, and markets after a five-winner inaugural season.

8e397a9565984593f1ce9c5b385163ee061f00b8.headline: watchOS 27 upgrades Modular Apple Watch face with 13 new colors
8e397a9565984593f1ce9c5b385163ee061f00b8.summary: 9to5Mac details how watchOS 27 expands the popular Modular watch face with 13 new colors — including Olive, Burgundy, Sand, Magenta, Sage, and Mulberry — plus the newest Daily Steps, Heart Rate, and Readiness complications exclusive to Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12. Modular remains a customization workhorse alongside Compact, Ultra, and Siri Modular variants, giving wearers more ways to personalize health metrics on the wrist.

c704ddd791b109402bd89e27d9e28dc0d20ba57c.headline: Tesla ramps Optimus to hundreds a week — but robots still can’t generalize
c704ddd791b109402bd89e27d9e28dc0d20ba57c.summary: Electrek reports Tesla is building several hundred Optimus humanoids a week at Fremont — roughly ten times Q2 output — on the former Model S/X line, aiming past 1,000 weekly by year-end. Most units stay inside Tesla for testing; hands remain hand-assembled with reliability issues, and sources say the AI still takes days to learn basic tasks and struggles outside trained scenarios. The piece contrasts the hardware ramp with unmet 2025 usefulness promises and a still-missing V3 demo.

740778c4ad46da06bf1a8f981491a7459133736c.headline: Penguins preseason finale lineup vs Sabres: Crosby, Malkin, Letang, Karlsson in
740778c4ad46da06bf1a8f981491a7459133736c.summary: The Penguins posted Saturday’s preseason lineup for the 3 p.m. ET finale at Buffalo’s KeyBank Center, with Sidney Crosby, Evgeni Malkin, Kris Letang, and Erik Karlsson among those skating. Forwards also include Bryan Rust, Rickard Rakell, and several prospects; Sergei Murashov and Arturs Silovs are the listed goalies. Fans can watch on SNP+ or listen on 105.9 The X as Pittsburgh closes a four-game exhibition slate after Thursday’s 4–0 loss in Columbus.

f05da23a2b305b979078e457f34131e7ab5d93ec.headline: Jets: Taylor, Fitzpatrick, Mauigoa out vs Lions; Glenn calls Detroit ‘explosive’
f05da23a2b305b979078e457f34131e7ab5d93ec.summary: After Friday’s practice, Jets coach Aaron Glenn said tight end Mason Taylor (thumb), safety Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin), and linebacker Kiko Mauigoa (quad) will miss Sunday’s game at Detroit; Adonai Mitchell was limited with a finger snag. Glenn, who spent four seasons as Lions defensive coordinator, called Jared Goff’s group one of the most explosive offenses his top-ranked defense will face all year, citing Jahmyr Gibbs, Jameson Williams, Amon-Ra St. Brown, and Sam LaPorta.

8db00f31f3c7f1aef3f1b700542f0058738a1145.headline: Waterbury mother found dead after 3-year-old seen wandering alone, police say
8db00f31f3c7f1aef3f1b700542f0058738a1145.summary: Waterbury police responding Friday morning to a report of a young child wandering alone on Poplar Street found a 3-year-old girl with no signs of abuse or neglect. A follow-up at a nearby home found her 34-year-old mother unresponsive and appearing dead for some time; she was pronounced dead at the scene. Investigators said they saw no obvious foul play. The case remains under investigation; tips can go to the Detective Bureau or Crime Stoppers.

040bd2e25859a9fb59bd4aeb5b3d689d542e2cb6.headline: Zelensky: Trump made ‘final decision’ to license Ukraine Patriot missile production
040bd2e25859a9fb59bd4aeb5b3d689d542e2cb6.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Friday that President Trump told him in New York he had made a final decision granting Ukraine licenses to produce Patriot air-defense missiles. Zelensky did not say when licenses or production would start; Trump had floated the idea at a July NATO summit then walked it back in late July over technology-transfer risks. Patriots remain among the few systems able to stop Russian ballistic missiles, and Kyiv has pressed for domestic manufacturing amid supply shortages.

dc7da0c7af2fba44c72b39b0bded3dab473cf85f.headline: Trumbull Library closed Saturday for nor’easter; town posts wind and flood prep
dc7da0c7af2fba44c72b39b0bded3dab473cf85f.summary: Trumbull Emergency Management posted Friday that the Trumbull Library will close Saturday, Sept. 26, because of the approaching nor’easter, with a Sunday decision due Saturday evening. A wind advisory and coastal flood warning are in effect; residents are told to secure outdoor furniture, clear storm drains, charge devices, avoid flooded roads and downed wires, and run generators outdoors only. Report United Illuminating outages at 800-722-5584; restoration may take more than 24 hours as Emergency Services and Public Works stand by.

bd9ed235ac527735cf6cb331282da851faa60a07.headline: Adirondacks foliage outlook: near-peak this weekend in Lake Placid–Saranac corridor
bd9ed235ac527735cf6cb331282da851faa60a07.summary: Adirondack Explorer’s Sept. 24–25 foliage outlook cites I LOVE NY’s report that Lake Placid, Saranac Lake, and Tupper Lake should be near-peak for the Sept. 25–27 weekend, with Lake Champlain still low. AccuWeather’s Chad Merrill expects vibrant early-to-mid-October peak aided by a non-drought summer; a coastal nor’easter this weekend should spare the High Peaks the worst wind. ROOST anticipates strong leaf-peeping tourism through mid-October for drive-to East Coast travelers.

d1c0d2a18ec01f7d766004320b65d4be41152649.headline: Lions rule out Bartch and Harper for Sunday vs Jets; OL starters expected back
d1c0d2a18ec01f7d766004320b65d4be41152649.summary: Detroit’s Friday injury report for Sunday’s home game against the Jets lists offensive lineman Ben Bartch (foot) and safety Thomas Harper (ankle) as Out after three straight non-participation days. Tackle Blake Miller (knee), Christian Mahogany (hip), and Tate Ratledge (elbow) returned to full participation and carry no game designation, while Alim McNeill is full after a personal absence — sharpening the Week 3 matchup picture opposite New York’s already-thin injury list.

85adc31ba3c7a40e69578047039588903cbd1f0d.headline: Penguins cut camp roster: Hayes to AHL; Brazeau out with lower-body injury
85adc31ba3c7a40e69578047039588903cbd1f0d.summary: Ahead of Saturday’s preseason finale in Buffalo, the Penguins assigned Avery Hayes, Atley Calvert, Tanner Howe, and Mikhail Ilyin to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton, returned the Ruck twins to Medicine Hat, released Collin Delia from his PTO, and listed Oliver Okuliar as injured non-roster. Justin Brazeau missed practice while being evaluated for a lower-body injury; Blake Lizotte and Ben Kindel remain week-to-week. Coach Dan Muse ran Crosby–Malkin–Karlsson–heavy lines and special-teams looks with Tommy Novak on PP1.

91b4b3cfc2ce1a101e80c91869705f540ca95116.headline: Insta360, sitting on 73% of 360 cameras, eyes smart glasses and mirrorless
91b4b3cfc2ce1a101e80c91869705f540ca95116.summary: In a Verge interview tied to Insta360’s 10-millionth camera and new Times Square flagship, cofounder Max Richter says the company — with 73% worldwide 360-camera share — is experimentally building smart glasses and two mirrorless cameras aimed at creators between phones and pro bodies. Founder JK Liu previously confirmed an unconventional mirrorless form factor. The piece also covers X6 AI highlight reels, free Gaussian-splat quotas, DJI rivalry, and U.S. policy risk after Insta360 distanced its Antigravity drone brand.

2e117dd4d6917658f242e75c44fa50dd241a877f.headline: Canon demos live volumetric MR sports viewing over NTT’s IOWN network
2e117dd4d6917658f242e75c44fa50dd241a877f.summary: Canon announced a Sept. 18 demonstration that streamed a basketball game at Aichi International Arena during the 2026 Asian Games as live 3D volumetric video to about 60 participants in Tokyo using MREAL mixed-reality devices. Roughly 100 cameras fed a remote 3D-generation server at Canon’s Kawasaki office over NTT’s IOWN All-Photonics Network — billed as a world-first for recreating a competition venue as live 3D spatial data for freely chosen viewpoints. Canon says it will push practical sports-fan deployments with partners.

243538775748e7d7e80bf80ebda8f213bd5eb43d.headline: macOS 27 Golden Gate brings Apple Intelligence into Photos, Safari, Shortcuts, Finder
243538775748e7d7e80bf80ebda8f213bd5eb43d.summary: Apple’s public macOS 27 Golden Gate release layers Apple Intelligence across core Mac apps beyond Siri AI: Photos gains Spatial Reframing, Extend, and a stronger Clean Up; Safari can auto-group tabs, Notify Me of site changes, and build extensions from natural-language prompts; Shortcuts can be created and iterated in plain English; Finder suggests file and folder names from content. The update is available on all Apple Silicon Macs.

1da167c72a3b5ec981924804661189e1f5a93cc2.headline: Danbury police and DEA Bridgeport arrest two after weeks-long crack and gun probe
1da167c72a3b5ec981924804661189e1f5a93cc2.summary: Danbury Special Investigations detectives working with the DEA Bridgeport Field Office arrested Patricia Saunders and Ronald Reiske Jr. after a monthlong narcotics probe that ended Sept. 22. Police say Saunders allegedly sold drugs from a Danbury Housing Authority unit on Fairfield Ridge; after watching a South Street parking-lot sale, officers found crack on Reiske and recovered crack cocaine, a scale, and a firearm in a search of the apartment. Both were booked at headquarters.

7bc26b8c15d94df3c4d1d6f2cbb33ffe9c5496ac.headline: AP: CNN, MS NOW, Politico back at White House — but the media-ban fight isn’t over
7bc26b8c15d94df3c4d1d6f2cbb33ffe9c5496ac.summary: Associated Press reports journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are back on White House grounds after Judge Timothy Kelly’s 14-day TRO restored credentials Trump revoked over unfavorable coverage. Kelly focused on Fifth Amendment due process — fair notice and a chance to respond — not yet a full First Amendment ruling; preliminary-injunction filings loom. The piece also notes the TV pool resumed Friday after sister networks refused to shoot alone while CNN was banned, and recounts Trump’s earlier fights with the pool and the AP “Gulf of America” dispute.

ac72f195884337d86a47e232401c875bf0fe3e37.headline: ICE seeks modular detention, interview, and virtual-court units for ~50 field offices
ac72f195884337d86a47e232401c875bf0fe3e37.summary: ICE posted Friday market-research asking contractors to lease prefab Field Detention Units (~900 sq ft), interview rooms, and 60-sq-ft Virtual Immigration Court Units at about 50 continental U.S. field offices, citing arrests that have outpaced holding space. The draft sets no occupancy limit or max stay and omits beds; responses are due Oct. 6. File metadata reviewed by Project Salt Box lists GEO Group on the source Word document. The ask follows a June 2025 waiver extending hold-room stays to 72 hours and comes as courts move some hearings into DHS space.

7930b45200d1dc93efdb793a88819132774b7218.headline: UVU’s 158-page report details security failures before Charlie Kirk assassination
7930b45200d1dc93efdb793a88819132774b7218.summary: Utah Valley University released a 158-page independent after-action review of Charlie Kirk’s Sept. 10, 2025 assassination on campus, finding inconsistent policy application, insufficient outdoor-event security, and no assigned camera monitor in university police. Reviewers said no one acted in bad faith but flagged key decision points from Aug. 25–Sept. 10, including approving the courtyard without a documented security plan. Kirk family attorney Brett Parkinson said the report reaffirms UVU was understaffed and unprepared; UVU’s president pledged to act on the recommendations.

bebdae94eb6fb02c781345dec4cbb79b1797fce0.headline: Xi and Trump schedule November China meeting and December G20 follow-up
bebdae94eb6fb02c781345dec4cbb79b1797fce0.summary: Associated Press reports Chinese President Xi Jinping wrapped his Washington state visit Friday by locking in two more meetings with President Trump before year-end — at APEC in Shenzhen, China, in November (with an invitation for Melania Trump) and at the G20 at Trump National Doral in Miami in December. Trump confirmed both on social media after Red Room tea and a National Archives stop. Analysts noted limited trade breakthroughs beyond a short truce extension; Trump said they discussed the Iran war and Ambassador Perdue said he again warned Xi against aiding Tehran.

05595d1757744d62d8b5717e727367068e4149c2.headline: CT DOT worker Elvin Hernandez killed on I-95 in Fairfield; driver charged with manslaughter
05595d1757744d62d8b5717e727367068e4149c2.summary: Elvin Hernandez, 60, a CTDOT worker since 2010 based at the Stratford garage, was killed Friday morning while picking up debris on southbound I-95 near Fairfield Exit 20 — a commute corridor for Trumbull and Fairfield County. Police say Edward Myers of Derby drifted onto the shoulder and struck him; Myers allegedly appeared impaired, admitted heroin use, had cocaine on him, and was driving without a required interlock after an April DUI conviction. He is jailed on manslaughter and related charges with a Monday court date. Gov. Lamont will lower flags for funeral services; DOT trucks escorted Hernandez’s body in procession.

1923dba4ce6a90f31323c07e5639b2b7b83ac121.headline: CT activates Emergency Operations Center as nor’easter hits Fairfield County
1923dba4ce6a90f31323c07e5639b2b7b83ac121.summary: Gov. Ned Lamont ordered Connecticut’s Emergency Operations Center into enhanced monitoring Friday night and partial activation at 7 a.m. Saturday for a weekend nor’easter bringing heavy rain, strong winds, and coastal flood warnings for Fairfield and New Haven counties — the corridor that includes Trumbull. The EOC at Hartford’s O’Neill Armory will run 24/7 with municipal and utility partners; wind advisories cover the whole state through Sunday morning. Officials warn of downed trees, outages, and never driving flooded roads; CT Alert and CTroads.org are the state’s update channels.

29219beab3bc0dc8f05d3d747dad23158bc24dcc.headline: Trump posts ‘Trump Strait’ map as Iran says Hormuz reopen choice rests with U.S.
29219beab3bc0dc8f05d3d747dad23158bc24dcc.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Friday a concrete seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz — contingent on U.S. steps already sketched in the collapsed June MoU — now “rests with the United States.” A U.S. official said mediated talks are constructive but Washington is “not in a rush,” citing control of the waterway and nearly 40 million barrels of oil moved in 48 hours. Early Saturday President Trump posted a Truth Social map labeling the waterway the “Trump Strait,” after earlier UN remarks about annihilating Iran or cutting a deal after the midterms.

ca433df6262d32fcb8405735a037c6d04e784067.headline: White House leaves CNN off Air Force One, slots Real America’s Voice for Knoxville trip
ca433df6262d32fcb8405735a037c6d04e784067.summary: AP reports the White House signaled Friday night that CNN is off Air Force One for President Trump’s Saturday Knoxville college-football trip, with conservative Real America’s Voice taking the seat long reserved for a network video-pool member. The move follows Judge Timothy Kelly’s TRO restoring CNN, MS NOW, and Politico hard passes to White House grounds — an order that did not expressly cover Air Force One pool slots. Sister networks had resumed pool video Friday after refusing to shoot alone during the ban; plaintiffs’ counsel argues the ruling should cover pool access as well.

bcb00c157fdb41526aeb34c273ae8edd66df994c.headline: Meatpacking groups: ICE ops in Texas, Kansas, Oklahoma delay cattle and may lift beef prices
bcb00c157fdb41526aeb34c273ae8edd66df994c.summary: AP reports Texas Cattle Feeders, Oklahoma Cattlemen’s, and Kansas Livestock associations warned Friday that heightened ICE operations prompted absences, delayed thousands of cattle shipments, and millions in lost revenue at feedlots, dairies, and transport hubs. DHS confirmed a Kansas presence but denied worksite raids; Secretary Markwayne Mullin said ICE is targeting “heinous criminals.” Some Dodge City–area plants briefly shut lines and returned cattle to yards. Sens. Marshall and Moran urged coordination with locals as beef prices already sit near records on a 75-year herd low.

ffdf10d17441d0eb5b91bd9ca2c55d85e82b3295.headline: UVU review: TPUSA insisted on outdoor courtyard despite security concerns before Kirk shooting
ffdf10d17441d0eb5b91bd9ca2c55d85e82b3295.summary: KSL’s read of UVU’s independent after-action review finds no bad faith by university staff but says key security decisions — including keeping Charlie Kirk’s Sept. 10, 2025 event in the outdoor Fountain Courtyard — were deferred to a Turning Point USA field representative after UVU raised concerns about attendance, protests, access, and rooftops. The report faults missing written plans, line-of-sight work, joint walkthroughs, and real-time camera monitoring; Kirk family attorney Brett Parkinson said it backs their notice of claim that UVU was understaffed and unprepared.

53569e2abc188a9881f6951e9ec611e25f0a3f96.headline: Trump’s Knoxville Vols–Texas visit brings TSA-style Secret Service screening at Neyland
53569e2abc188a9881f6951e9ec611e25f0a3f96.summary: University of Tennessee Police Chief Sean Patterson said fans at Saturday’s noon Tennessee–Texas game should arrive far earlier than usual: stadium perimeter opens 8 a.m., gates 9 a.m., with Secret Service TSA-style screening, no re-entry after ticket scan, and heavy campus traffic controls. Prohibited-item rules follow Secret Service game-day guidance — including a ban on Flipper Zero devices — and there is no stadium storage for confiscated gear. Vol Walk and Band March remain on the pre-game clock; Patterson’s message was patience as President Trump attends.

44b5e40bd26281bede663418d74fd99b07e7fcd7.headline: DHS: assaults on ICE officers up 1,649% since Trump immigration crackdown began
44b5e40bd26281bede663418d74fd99b07e7fcd7.summary: DHS told Fox it logged 647 assaults on ICE personnel from Jan. 20, 2025, through Sept. 20, 2026 — versus 37 in a comparable early Biden window — a 1,649% jump Secretary Markwayne Mullin blames on “vicious lies” from sanctuary politicians and anti-ICE rioters. The agency cites shootings at Prairieland Detention Center, Molotovs and rocks, a Houston officer needing 13 stitches, and a Tren de Aragua suspect charged with attempted murder of an agent in Nebraska. Mullin urged Democrats to stop comparing ICE to historical terror units and start cooperating on removals.

ce2009a36d1dcd416da5cb0f365ef4139321959a.headline: Apple’s October slate: iPhone Duo Oct. 23, rumored HomePad, Macs, and iOS 27.2
ce2009a36d1dcd416da5cb0f365ef4139321959a.summary: 9to5Mac maps Apple’s packed October: iPhone Duo pre-orders Oct. 16 with availability Oct. 23 in more than 70 countries, plus rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro/Ultra, M6 iMac and MacBook Pro, Apple TV 4K, HomePad hub, HomePod mini 2, and OLED iPad mini. On software, Duo ships on iOS 27.1 while iOS 27.2 — already in testing with Apple TV profiles, Dual Capture FaceTime, and Siri AI language expansions — is expected the same month for the broader iPhone lineup.

29bc8a66f7b15288f2245f2dc3d1b096ea6482e7.headline: Clutch announces 14th album Wasted Lands, drops title track with Machine back producing
29bc8a66f7b15288f2245f2dc3d1b096ea6482e7.summary: Maryland’s Clutch set Jan. 22, 2027, for Wasted Lands on Weathermaker Music and released the riff-driven title track and video — reuniting with producer Gene “Machine” Freeman for the first time since 2015’s Psychic Warfare. Written at the Doom Saloon, the 12-song set leans live-first after scrapping two studio-bound batches; Neil Fallon even keeps a rough banjo demo on “Beware The Fever.” A 16-date U.S. headline run with Slomosa and Blood Vulture starts Oct. 16 in Charlotte before an Australia Wasted Lands tour with Corrosion of Conformity in January.

fca0887cd7c26533b1c569cd84152f85321ebe45.headline: Eastern Sierra foliage: Mono County’s Sagehen, Rock Creek, Virginia Lakes near peak this weekend
fca0887cd7c26533b1c569cd84152f85321ebe45.summary: California Fall Color’s Sept. 24 Mono County report flags Sagehen Summit, Rock Creek’s upper canyon, Virginia Lakes, and Green Creek at 50–75% near-peak — go-now for this weekend — with Sonora and Monitor passes patchy and June Lake Loop still mostly green. Mono County Tourism says the next 3–5 weeks should keep delivering aspen color down the elevation ladder along US 395. High-elevation Eastern Sierra typically peaks around the equinox; valley floors follow into October for West Coast leaf-peeping trips.

a07d0a2cc6016bd42cb810e61657d86d47cd7673.headline: Jets’ Garrett Wilson eyes first game vs ex-teammate DJ Reed as Detroit visit looms
a07d0a2cc6016bd42cb810e61657d86d47cd7673.summary: Ahead of Sunday’s Week 3 road game at Ford Field, Jets WR Garrett Wilson said he will face former teammate DJ Reed for the first time and planned to text him to “set the stage.” Wilson (11 catches, 136 yards, one TD through two games) called Detroit’s 31st-ranked defense still “really good at what they do” with pressures and shells, and wants the offense to make a statement after the overtime Packers loss. He and Adonai Mitchell are one of four WR tandems with 50-plus yards each in Weeks 1–2.

c8f22c668d95308f80128c09b42e6d11eb81fa56.headline: Penguins notebook: Lapierre centers third line; McGroarty, Broz, Pickering on chopping block
c8f22c668d95308f80128c09b42e6d11eb81fa56.summary: With Ben Kindel and Blake Lizotte sidelined, Dan Muse’s Friday dress rehearsal put Hendrix Lapierre at third-line center between Ville Koivunen and Bryan Rust, slid Nick Robertson onto the PK, and kept Koivunen on PP2 ahead of Saturday’s preseason finale in Buffalo. Rutger McGroarty, Tristan Broz, and Owen Pickering skated in a separate group as Muse said final roster decisions are imminent; Sergei Murashov appears to have beaten Joel Blomqvist for the backup crease. Crosby–Malkin–Karlsson veterans still anchor the top units.

c4d324c21ee58e7a832be411360c2a1d0faf29e7.headline: SpaceX aims for Starship’s first orbit Monday — 26 Starlink V3s and a 10-hour mission
c4d324c21ee58e7a832be411360c2a1d0faf29e7.summary: Space.com’s Saturday deep dive says SpaceX is targeting a Sept. 28 Flight 14 window opening 8:15 a.m. EDT for Starship’s first orbital attempt: Ship 41 would climb to ~170 miles, deploy 26 operational Starlink V3 satellites, complete about six orbits over roughly 10 hours, then splash down in the Pacific while Booster 21 aims for a Gulf soft splashdown. Orbit insertion fires only if deorbit redundancy checks out; NASA’s Artemis lander timeline and Starlink V3 scale-up both hinge on clearing this milestone a decade after Musk’s 2016 ITS unveil.

f57e5af9970c22403705befa7d77ae0ed6e8116f.headline: Turtle Beach Vulcan II XP Air keyboard: 2,000-hour battery, AirTrack gestures
f57e5af9970c22403705befa7d77ae0ed6e8116f.summary: Turtle Beach’s Vulcan II XP Air wireless mechanical keyboard lands Oct. 25 at $199.99 with hot-swappable TITAN HS Red linear switches, an AirTrack touchless gesture sensor, and triple connectivity (2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, USB-A) across five devices. A 6,000 mAh pack claims up to 95 hours with RGB/AirTrack on — or up to 2,000 hours with both off — plus full N-key rollover and 50-million-keystroke-rated switches. A cheaper wired Vulcan II XP variant ships around the same window for players who skip wireless.

6fd4175b58f1ce7fc703dd83b0599819d3bc0abb.headline: Jets at Lions: Glenn’s return, Fitzpatrick and Taylor OUT for Sunday
6fd4175b58f1ce7fc703dd83b0599819d3bc0abb.summary: Sunday’s 1 p.m. ET FOX kickoff at Ford Field brings Aaron Glenn back to Detroit against Jared Goff’s Lions, with both clubs at 1-1. New York is without safety Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) and tight end Mason Taylor (thumb); Adonai Mitchell and Joseph Ossai are questionable. The Jets’ third-down defense (23.8% allowed) is the tactical key against a Lions offense that just hung 327 yards and four TDs on Buffalo but couldn’t get off the field. Geno Smith has been efficient (70.8%) if not explosive; Garrett Wilson remains the clear WR1.

2a4e545291381e1ba8718fab7c7f5abf6c1afab6.headline: Penguins preview: Murashov vs Silovs, Karlsson, McGroarty among big questions
2a4e545291381e1ba8718fab7c7f5abf6c1afab6.summary: Tim Benz’s Saturday six-pack frames Pittsburgh’s 2026-27 opener around whether Sergei Murashov can seize the No. 1 crease over Arturs Silovs, whether Erik Karlsson repeats last year’s 66-point form after Parker Wotherspoon was dealt, and whether Rutger McGroarty (and Ville Koivunen’s $32M deal) can produce from middle-six roles behind Crosby/Malkin. Defense depth after Letang/Karlsson and rebounds from Chinakhov and Kindel round out the list. Benz pegs even making the playoffs as roughly a coin flip — and a first round win since 2018 as unlikely.

f1e0b71f94d3ce795d899d4b3239f1b0848e19d9.headline: Fall foliage map: Rockies, Tetons, North Shore peaking this weekend
f1e0b71f94d3ce795d899d4b3239f1b0848e19d9.summary: GetOutdoors’ week-of-Sept. 22 foliage board says color is peaking now in Colorado’s high aspens (Kebler, Independence, Dallas Divide), Grand Teton valley stands (Oxbow Bend, Gros Ventre), and Minnesota’s North Shore maples (Oberg, Gunflint, Hwy 61). Peaking this weekend: Adirondack High Peaks around Lake Placid/Keene and northern New England high country (upper Kanc, Vermont’s Northeast Kingdom, Maine’s Height of Land). Drought may shorten Colorado’s show; UP Michigan, North Cascades larches, and West Virginia highlands are still early-October plays.

8ade95831425fedbf51d85816d2bbf5ad19d3894.headline: GM PIP6131: 2026 Duramax L5P tick/grind may mean rocker oiling failure
8ade95831425fedbf51d85816d2bbf5ad19d3894.summary: GM Preliminary Information PIP6131 (NHTSA MC-11036220) flags abnormal upper-engine tick, screech, or grinding — sometimes with misfire or shake — on some 2026 Silverado/Sierra HD trucks with the 6.6L L5P Duramax. Technicians are told to check lubrication to the rocker shaft/arms; if lack of oiling is confirmed, the listed correction is engine and turbocharger replacement, not a simple rocker swap. The bulletin is PI for dealers, not a recall; HD owners are advised to document symptoms and stop hard towing until a dealer inspects under warranty.

ce204bf4b7a7527fd8a846e088d886e77ec07e80.headline: Canon EOS R7 Mark II pushed to Q1 2027, stacked 39MP rumor intact
ce204bf4b7a7527fd8a846e088d886e77ec07e80.summary: Industry updates now say Canon’s next APS-C flagship — the EOS R7 Mark II — will miss 2026 entirely and target a Q1 2027 announcement ahead of Japan’s CP+ show. Rumored specs still point to a 39MP BSI stacked sensor, DIGIC X + Accelerator dual processing, ~40 fps blackout-free electronic burst, neural pre-capture, and a mixed SD + CFexpress Type B slot layout at a premium ~$2,000-plus price. Birding and sports shooters who need reach now are steered to the original R7; waiters get a fuller APS-C overhaul next year.

f275899957908fa5ff70af3cbb3f8daef8999834.headline: Apple code confirms iPad 12: A19, 8GB RAM, C1X modem, Wi-Fi 7 N1
f275899957908fa5ff70af3cbb3f8daef8999834.summary: MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris pulled iPad 12 specs from Apple’s own code: A19 chip (vs A16 on iPad 11), 8GB RAM (the Apple Intelligence floor), Apple’s C1X 5G modem, and the N1 chip for Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. The jump enables full Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features missing from the current entry iPad. Timing still looks like spring 2027 at a likely $449 start; October’s nearer Apple slate remains the iPad mini refresh plus HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K.

7844649b6c005ebaeb5395e4eae85f823a14c780.headline: LEGO unveils 40899 Astro Bot GWP alongside October PlayStation set
7844649b6c005ebaeb5395e4eae85f823a14c780.summary: Brickset confirms LEGO’s 276-piece 40899 Astro Bot gift-with-purchase, timed with the Oct. 1 early access of 72306 PlayStation. Full spend thresholds are not yet official; current rumor points to a ~$150 purchase threshold rather than locking the bot solely to the console SKU. The build includes alternate eye tiles for expressions and is positioned as a companion to the classic grey PlayStation model — one of the stronger GWPs of the year for robot and PlayStation fans.

6a4cb798924180051ae9af1bb92e4ead44e5f133.headline: Megadeth plays Grammy Museum rooftop set after No. 1 self-titled album
6a4cb798924180051ae9af1bb92e4ead44e5f133.summary: Megadeth sat with MTV alum Matt Pinfield at the Grammy Museum’s Ray Charles Rooftop Terrace Thursday, then ripped a seven-song set spanning new cuts (“Tipping Point,” “I Don’t Care,” “Let There Be Shred”) and classics (“Sweating Bullets,” “Symphony Of Destruction,” “Peace Sells,” “Holy Wars”). The appearance follows the band’s self-titled seventeenth studio album becoming its first Billboard 200 No. 1. Fan video of the LA performance is circulating; the thrash pioneers continue marking five decades since Dave Mustaine founded the band in 1983.

f0d17c6384e62dc0510939b1e0e2859d86827e70.headline: Starship Flight 14 targets 8:15 a.m. Monday for first orbital attempt
f0d17c6384e62dc0510939b1e0e2859d86827e70.summary: Space.com’s Saturday mission guide sets SpaceX’s Starship Flight 14 launch window opening 8:15 a.m. EDT Monday, Sept. 28, from Starbase Pad 2 — a 75-minute window with Sept. 29–30 backups. Unlike past ~1-hour suborbital tests, the nearly 10-hour flight aims for a ~171-mile orbit, six revolutions, a Pez-style deploy of 26 Starlink V3s (~26 Tbps capacity claimed), Super Heavy splashdown in the Gulf, and Ship splashdown off Chile. SpaceX’s webcast starts about 30 minutes before liftoff; NASASpaceflight offers earlier pad cams.

71f7ccd850f9ed5e3c043667d1c282cb5a5c32ab.headline: CT Renaissance Faire closed as nor’easter cancels festivals statewide
71f7ccd850f9ed5e3c043667d1c282cb5a5c32ab.summary: WFSB’s storm cancelation roundup lists the Connecticut Renaissance Faire closed for the weekend as the coastal nor’easter rolled in, scrubbing Faerie Ring Revels days on the Lebanon grounds. Also off or postponed: Bristol Mum Festival, Plainville America 250, Milford Oktoberfest’s Saturday slate, Hamden’s Brooksvale Fall Festival, and several town birthday bashes pushed to early October. Organizers cite wind, rain, and coastal flood risk; faire fans are pointed to later season weekends through late October if weather cooperates.

3874e90796f60787dd43424273b5232873f890f9.headline: Coaches warn Trump’s Knoxville visit can cut headset comms mid-drive
3874e90796f60787dd43424273b5232873f890f9.summary: AP reports Texas coach Steve Sarkisian saying Secret Service protocols can kill coach-to-coach and coach-to-player headsets “anytime” President Trump enters, leaves, or moves inside Neyland Stadium — with no warning — during Saturday’s No. 1 Texas vs. No. 14 Tennessee noon kickoff. Coaches cited brief blackouts when Trump left last season’s College Football Playoff title game; the White House denies that exit caused problems. Fans were told gates open early with enhanced screening as Trump watches Arch Manning play where uncle Peyton made his name.

f042eb8620f77f019e5fbbbf6729a3b0aa7f80da.headline: China, U.S. agree $30 billion reciprocal tariff cut and AI dialogue after Xi visit
f042eb8620f77f019e5fbbbf6729a3b0aa7f80da.summary: Beijing said Saturday that Presidents Xi and Trump locked in an eight-point consensus from this week’s Washington state visit, including a $30 billion reciprocal tariff-reduction arrangement on non-sensitive goods, a new trade council, and an extension of earlier Kuala Lumpur talks. The sides also agreed to launch a U.S.–China dialogue on AI risks and benefits — with the next round by November — plus a bilateral channel for AI-related incidents. Officials framed the package as implementation steps rather than a full trade deal; Xi has already returned to Beijing.

fccb8ce0702b4dda2dee8934c63e2ad4943a9a01.headline: Nearly 15,000 without power as nor’easter hits Fairfield County coast
fccb8ce0702b4dda2dee8934c63e2ad4943a9a01.summary: Patch’s Saturday live updates put roughly 14,000 Connecticut homes and businesses offline by mid-morning as the weekend nor’easter delivered leafed-tree wind gusts and heavy rain bands. Eversource alone reported about 12,900 outages (Guilford, Ledyard, Wilton among the hardest hit) with UI adding another 1,200-plus. Coastal flood warnings remain for Fairfield and New Haven counties through Sunday evening with 2–3 feet of inundation possible on high tides — the shoreline corridor that includes Trumbull’s neighbors — and a statewide wind advisory runs into Sunday morning.

4eef5cabf2fc509efee5037e2ae60f6439abf8e5.headline: UI restores most Trumbull-area power as nor’easter knocks out 4,800
4eef5cabf2fc509efee5037e2ae60f6439abf8e5.summary: United Illuminating said Saturday that about 4,800 customers across its Greater Bridgeport/New Haven territory — which includes Trumbull — lost power in the weekend nor’easter, with roughly 730 still out as of 11 a.m. as crews cleared trees and downed lines. Spokesperson Angela Baccaro urged residents to stay clear of debris that may hide dangling wires, report outages at 800-722-5584 or uinet.com, and drive slowly through work zones while UI works with towns through the storm.

56f5f422fcdbeeb54c8f7d48f7b949cc42315a41.headline: Trump rejects Iran’s Hormuz reopen offer before college football trip
56f5f422fcdbeeb54c8f7d48f7b949cc42315a41.summary: President Trump told reporters Saturday outside the White House that he is rejecting Iran’s conditional offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restart nuclear talks within seven days — after Tehran demanded an end to the U.S. naval blockade, oil-sanctions waivers, and a ceasefire that would include Lebanon. The AP notes Trump also posted a Truth Social map labeling the waterway “Trump Strait,” while mediators continue shuttle diplomacy and analysts warn a hard no could push oil higher into the midterms.

b98d3bf4a26804f7a5c7274c7ccc3ce7a43bf4a4.headline: SCOTUS lets Trump SAVE voter-citizenship checks resume — midterm purge limited
b98d3bf4a26804f7a5c7274c7ccc3ce7a43bf4a4.summary: The Supreme Court’s Friday emergency order stays a lower-court block so states can again run voter rolls through DHS’s expanded SAVE citizenship database — a win for Trump’s election-integrity push. Votebeat stresses the National Voter Registration Act’s 90-day ban on systematic mass removals still blunts November impact, though individualized checks can continue and bulk use can restart after the midterms. DHS says 25 mostly Republican states already used SAVE; liberals dissented citing Texas false positives.

34a4adec27192ad8b301e531a745f4e42dc0ac2a.headline: House Democrat files 26 impeachment articles against Trump
34a4adec27192ad8b301e531a745f4e42dc0ac2a.summary: Rep. Steve Cohen (D-Tenn.) introduced 26 articles of impeachment covering Iran war powers, ICE/deportation policy, press access fights, tariffs, pardons, and alleged emoluments — nine days after the House tabled Al Green’s narrower immigration-focused push. Cohen concedes the GOP majority will not advance the package; Democratic leaders stayed largely hands-off after 18 Democrats helped shelve Green’s resolution. The White House had not commented; filing alone is not an impeachment without a House vote.

bf868f8a79980b3d864fabb7dddc099203e4c273.headline: ICE deports eight Somali men from Guantanamo, including St. Paul mechanic
bf868f8a79980b3d864fabb7dddc099203e4c273.summary: U.S. immigration authorities on Thursday flew eight Somali men held about a month at Guantanamo Bay to Mogadishu, including Adam Abdullah, a 31-year-old St. Paul auto mechanic arrested in December during Operation Metro Surge while his asylum case was pending. Abdullah described chains, a hunger strike, and solitary cold-room punishment; DHS called the group “the worst of the worst” without citing U.S. crimes. His attorney said final removal orders make the transfer legally defensible even as an ACLU suit challenges Guantanamo immigration detention.

4835ad572d05c726fa55ac412f16512e76e6d8a8.headline: Tesla’s Texas Robotaxi + Cybercab fleet tops 500 registered vehicles
4835ad572d05c726fa55ac412f16512e76e6d8a8.summary: As of Saturday, Texas AV trackers show 420 Model Y robotaxis and 126 Cybercabs registered for Tesla’s unsupervised ride-hail geofence — 546 combined, with Cybercab counts nearly tripling in days. Most of the fleet still runs Austin’s large geofence, while Cybercab sightings in Houston hint at expansion. Tesla fans noted the 420 Model Y tally echoes Musk’s infamous “funding secured” tweet; production continues at Giga Texas feeding the Lone Star rollout.

c2b4eb0852a7789e738787a738c7641a6ff49666.headline: Starship Flight 14 clears wet dress rehearsal ahead of Monday orbit try
c2b4eb0852a7789e738787a738c7641a6ff49666.summary: SpaceX finished a full propellant-load launch rehearsal Thursday for Starship Flight 14 — still targeting Monday’s 75-minute window opening 7:15 a.m. CT for the vehicle’s first orbital attempt with 26 operational Starlink V3s. Ship 41 is planned for roughly six Earth revolutions and a Pacific splashdown off Chile after a ~10-hour mission; Booster 21 aims for a Gulf splashdown. The company still needs final FAA mission authorization even after stacking and the wet dress.

591d771fd2814a2795bb01265ce8d7a4c99378fb.headline: Apple Siri AI settlement claims open: ~$25 per eligible iPhone through Dec. 21
591d771fd2814a2795bb01265ce8d7a4c99378fb.summary: Eligible U.S. buyers of iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max and iPhone 16-family models purchased June 10, 2024–March 29, 2025 can file claims now through Dec. 21 in Apple’s $250 million settlement over delayed personalized Siri AI features. Per-device payouts start around $25 and could rise toward $95 if claim volume is low; a final approval hearing is set for Feb. 24, 2027 before payments. Apple denies wrongdoing; Siri AI shipped with iOS 27 as a beta-labeled feature after WWDC 2026.

c0638b62937a59c5eb8a242f6a3ea35f036f5c83.headline: Canada bill would ban courts from weighing parental-alienation claims
c0638b62937a59c5eb8a242f6a3ea35f036f5c83.summary: A new paper linking “pro-contact culture” and parental-alienation accusations to eight child murders in Ontario and Quebec custody fights is fueling Liberal MP Lisa Hepfner’s Keeping Children Safe bill, which would bar courts from considering alienation evidence and block forced reunification therapy. Queen’s law professor Nicholas Bala warns an absolute ban would silence real alienation cases and miss child-protection failures; NAWL’s Suzanne Zaccour argues alienation claims systematically deflect from abuse. The bill cleared second reading and is before the justice committee.

ce9df9643a60e28e462924609d6e26ffc777044b.headline: Jets take No. 1 defense into Ford Field for Glenn’s return vs. Lions
ce9df9643a60e28e462924609d6e26ffc777044b.summary: Sunday’s 1 p.m. ET FOX kickoff in Detroit pits Aaron Glenn’s Jets — NFL’s No. 1 total defense at 197 yards allowed per game — against Dan Campbell’s 31-ppg Lions in Glenn’s first trip back as a head coach. Both clubs are 1–1 after OT/high-scoring Week 2 losses; Fitzpatrick, Mauigoa, and Taylor were early OUT candidates while Detroit’s secondary has allowed 310+ pass yards per game. Keys: Geno Smith finishing drives and whether New York’s aggressive front can force Detroit’s first turnover-starved defense to blink.

22def7b3feda2b3ca636f94f11467336f424efda.headline: GWAR founding member Chuck Varga, aka Sexecutioner, dies of cancer
22def7b3feda2b3ca636f94f11467336f424efda.summary: Chuck Varga, GWAR co-founder and the performer behind The Sexecutioner from 1985–2022, died after a cancer fight, bandmate Casey Orr (Beefcake the Mighty) announced Friday night. Orr said Varga passed peacefully with wife Bambi at his side and imagined a Valhalla welcome from late frontman Dave Brockie and guitarist Cory Smoot. GWAR had raised funds this summer for treatments and hospice; Bob Gorman credited Varga’s underground art aesthetic with helping define the Slave Pit universe across four decades of theatrical thrash.

4658b1793abd4fa3805aa4b370d5519bf51c743b.headline: Illinois judge acquits woman in hotel shooting as self-defense
4658b1793abd4fa3805aa4b370d5519bf51c743b.summary: Cook County Judge Tiana Blakely found Kennisha Laing not guilty of murder in the 2023 South Holland hotel shooting of 16-year-old Daysha Cazley, ruling the facts showed self-defense after Cazley and a friend allegedly planned to rob Laing and broke a window to force re-entry. Public defender Samuel Goldberg said texts and testimony made the charge unjustified; Laing spent a year jailed then two years on electronic monitoring with no violations before walking free. Illinois dwelling-defense and self-defense statutes both figured in the bench verdict.

ed5d1a9fbc2ce601a3cfa4d07a0754dc1b34fa55.headline: Tesla Robotaxi app 26.8.2 adds Stop Now latch and native X Money pay
ed5d1a9fbc2ce601a3cfa4d07a0754dc1b34fa55.summary: A decompile of Tesla’s Robotaxi iOS build 26.8.2 (stamped Sept. 21) surfaces a geofenced Stop Now pickup latch, cellular door-unlock backup when Bluetooth/UWB fails, cabin brightness control, referral confetti, and native X Money as a wallet payment type alongside Apple/Google Pay. Tracker Tesla App Updates posted the strings as Austin’s Cybercab fleet grows; none of it is an official Tesla changelog, and strings can ship or vanish before riders see them. Directionally, the phone app is becoming the Cybercab’s key, dashboard, and wallet.

754fbeb0722f9ea11a246414b35c72454955b8ac.headline: Eversource: 21,000 still dark as Fairfield coast floods; Westport parks shut
754fbeb0722f9ea11a246414b35c72454955b8ac.summary: As of 4 p.m. Saturday, Eversource said it had restored power to about 43,000 Connecticut customers while roughly 21,000 remained without electricity in the weekend nor’easter. Westport kept parks, beaches, and athletic fields closed through Sunday, Bridgeport streets and the ferry terminal flooded under high tide and storm surge, and nearby Redding reported more than 400 homes dark — a corridor that includes Trumbull and other Fairfield County towns still clearing trees and wires.

f9873b241ba6d7ead865a73afb3d650cfb5f0b81.headline: Trump uses pocket rescission to cancel $810M for migrant and DEI programs
f9873b241ba6d7ead865a73afb3d650cfb5f0b81.summary: The White House said Saturday it is canceling $810 million in congressionally approved spending via a pocket rescission, with about $567 million aimed at HHS grants that support refugees, asylees, and other noncitizens, plus cuts to migrant-student education, “Woke International Education,” and race-focused Justice and HUD programs. OMB Director Russ Vought argues the Impoundment Control Act allows the move near the Sept. 30 fiscal-year end; Sen. Susan Collins and the GAO call pocket rescissions unlawful.

816fedda33ef5a61a8d09da0c0b2826c0ae1f52b.headline: Trump’s Air Force One flyover and Neyland visit wrap without headset blackouts
816fedda33ef5a61a8d09da0c0b2826c0ae1f52b.summary: President Trump landed in Knoxville at 11:28 a.m. ET Saturday, drew a low-altitude Air Force One flyover over Neyland Stadium, pumped his fist on the videoboard beside Tennessee’s senators, and left at 2:07 p.m. in the second half of Texas–Tennessee. Coaches had warned Secret Service movements can mute headset play-calling; ABC/ESPN reported both schools coordinated audio channels with the Secret Service, and the visit did not appear to cut communications on the field.

c315d573afc8401d654d5668bfb1a6e3624868b0.headline: ICE roundup: child predators, trafficker, and armed carjacker among arrests
c315d573afc8401d654d5668bfb1a6e3624868b0.summary: DHS said ICE arrested several criminal illegal aliens in a recent sweep, including a Jamaican man convicted of aggravated sexual battery of a child under 13 in Virginia, an El Salvadoran convicted of sexual exploitation of a minor and child-pornography distribution in Boston, a Mexican national convicted of human trafficking/forced labor in Oakland, and another Mexican national convicted of armed carjacking in San Francisco. Secretary Markwayne Mullin said the agency will keep prioritizing “heinous” offenders under Trump’s enforcement mandate.

599ff358b77e7d189434dd3559db6069da6297a5.headline: Cincinnati jury acquits Shake Shack shooter after fiancée admits victim had a gun
599ff358b77e7d189434dd3559db6069da6297a5.summary: A Hamilton County jury found Antwoine McCants not guilty of murder and felonious assault in the June 2025 Shake Shack shooting near the University of Cincinnati after the state’s key witness — the victim’s fiancée — recanted and admitted Christopher Stallworth was armed. Surveillance showed her removing a handgun from Stallworth’s pocket as he lay dying; McCants’s wife testified Stallworth threatened to kill him, and the coroner said Stallworth’s blood-alcohol level was more than twice the legal limit.

fd881a68c8c0372a45bf7d96e10f3a9d280a1d8f.headline: Utah judge finds prima facie self-defense in funeral-lot double killing
fd881a68c8c0372a45bf7d96e10f3a9d280a1d8f.summary: A Salt Lake City judge ruled John Vea Uasike Jr. has a prima facie self-defense claim in the Jan. 7 funeral parking-lot shooting that killed two and injured six, raising prosecutors’ burden to clear-and-convincing proof that the force was not justified. His brother testified he was shot from behind before Uasike returned fire; prosecutors say other witnesses claimed Uasike drew first. Arguments continue toward a Nov. 16 ruling that could dismiss the murder counts.

bbdb3043a2661a282d648847a14df64d251548dc.headline: SpaceX flies classified USSF-385; trackers tie West Coast cadence to Starshield
bbdb3043a2661a282d648847a14df64d251548dc.summary: SpaceX lofted the classified USSF-385 mission from Vandenberg at 7:00 a.m. PT Saturday, and Falcon 9 booster B1100 stuck its tenth landing on Of Course I Still Love You. Independent trackers note the fourth Space Force launch from the same pad in about six weeks, with prior flights cataloging satellite counts that match Starshield buses, while SpaceX holds $1.6 billion in Vandenberg Falcon 9 task orders through 2027 — and Starship Flight 14’s first orbit try is still targeted for Monday.

a796aee0ab7b523cb944e752453e3d4164372692.headline: Tesla builds first Cybertruck with lithium refined at its Texas Gulf Coast plant
a796aee0ab7b523cb944e752453e3d4164372692.summary: Tesla said a Cybertruck rolled off the Gigafactory Texas line Sept. 22 using 4680 cells with lithium hydroxide refined at its more-than-$1 billion Robstown, Texas, Gulf Coast refinery — the company’s first vehicle tied to its own refining step. The acid-free alkaline leach process, Tesla claims, cuts carbon about 30% and reagent costs about 60%; Cybertruck production has passed 100,000 units, though new dual-motor orders still show April 2027 delivery estimates.

39181d19250ab0762e8107918fd8a1eccaed9e96.headline: Penguins’ Bryan Rust leaves Sabres preseason early in empty-bench scare
39181d19250ab0762e8107918fd8a1eccaed9e96.summary: Bryan Rust left Pittsburgh’s Saturday preseason game at Buffalo after roughly 20 seconds of a shift and did not return, with the Penguins confirming the empty bench spot before offering a reason. The 34-year-old posted 65 points in 72 games last season on a $5.125 million cap hit through 2027-28; Pittsburgh opens the regular season Wednesday in Philadelphia, so any multi-game absence would hit a veteran who has scored 20-plus goals in seven straight seasons.

a101255e36c36c058a93f2eff5b265fcf0489da2.headline: Aaron Glenn returns to Detroit as Jets’ No. 1 defense faces Lions’ leaky secondary
a101255e36c36c058a93f2eff5b265fcf0489da2.summary: Aaron Glenn brings the Jets (1-1) back to Ford Field on Sunday to face Dan Campbell’s Lions (1-1), a reunion of former Detroit staffmates now on opposite sidelines. New York ranks No. 1 in yards allowed and has held its first two foes under 200 yards; Detroit ranks 31st in points, yards, and pass defense and is without several safeties, while Geno Smith has torched Detroit for about 348 yards per game in three prior visits.

6356530e2f32c86949e0fcec1b6708579d256260.headline: Stryper drops 18th album Throne of Thorns with Shadowbreaker visualizer
6356530e2f32c86949e0fcec1b6708579d256260.summary: Christian metal pioneers Stryper released their 18th studio album, Throne of Thorns, on Friday via Frontiers Music, pairing the launch with a visualizer for closer “Shadowbreaker.” Michael Sweet called the track a “full throttle banger” that shows the band’s heavier 2026 side; Oz Fox and Perry Richardson praised the record’s heart and refusal to quit after decades of classic-metal harmony guitars and anthemic choruses.

a5d452c4dc7d6c48d09d797d9c66f27716ddaaac.headline: Apple Watch Ultra 4, Mac mini, and Mac Studio see first launch-week discounts
a5d452c4dc7d6c48d09d797d9c66f27716ddaaac.summary: MacRumors’ Friday deals roundup flagged the first cash discounts on Apple’s brand-new Mac mini and Mac Studio (up to $50 off at Amazon), plus Apple Watch Ultra 4 at $779.99 ($19 off) and AirPods Pro 3 at $199 ($50 off). Beats 360 cushion kits also dropped to $9.99 from $49.99 for a limited window, giving Ultra and Mac buyers early markdowns in the first week after launch.

5640bb707deec2bcd806bc1b0d8778706804df23.headline: Bullet For My Valentine announce Social Apocalypse album, first song in four years
5640bb707deec2bcd806bc1b0d8778706804df23.summary: Welsh metallers Bullet For My Valentine will release Social Apocalypse on March 19, 2027, via Spinefarm, unveiling the title track — their first new song in four years — with a Chris Wade video. Matt Tuck says the record stares down a world of conflict and rapid change; guests include Against The Current’s Chrissy Costanza and Lorna Shore’s Will Ramos, with producer Carl Bown back and a 2027 European arena tour on sale Sept. 30.

6890fde52a5bcf1d550de1e9e292117812ffe7cf.headline: Trumbull soccer falls 3–2 to undefeated Stamford; Simsbury next Sunday
6890fde52a5bcf1d550de1e9e292117812ffe7cf.summary: Trumbull’s Eagles dropped a 3–2 decision to ranked Stamford in a top-of-the-state clash, ending a stretch that had slipped to 0-2-1 since a three-game winning streak and moving the team to 5-3-1. Stamford improved to 6-0 and extended an eight-game home winning streak dating to last season. Both sides hit the road Sunday — Trumbull at Simsbury at 1:30 p.m., Stamford at South Windsor at 3:20 p.m.

aa6de74f43e8c10727ad61a12fa814d5c5a0e88e.headline: Trump says he approved new fuel economy rules to end Biden EV pressure
aa6de74f43e8c10727ad61a12fa814d5c5a0e88e.summary: President Trump posted Saturday that he has approved new fuel economy standards ending what he called the Biden-era electric-vehicle mandate, arguing Democrats forced unwanted cars and wasted billions on chargers that were never built. He said the reset will lower new-car prices, invites GM, Ford, and Stellantis to build more in America, and credits Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Ford CEO Jim Farley previously hailed a similar CAFE reset as a win for affordability; Trump also ended EV tax credits in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

2a0fe484e0db0fdf25c36ecae0ec4ef2ef0b27c7.headline: Homan: ICE can break Obama’s 409,000 deportation record next year
2a0fe484e0db0fdf25c36ecae0ec4ef2ef0b27c7.summary: Border czar Tom Homan told The Epoch Times on Saturday that ICE arrests should climb further next year as thousands of newly trained agents enter the field, after three straight monthly records capped by 50,925 arrests in August. He separated arrest totals from removals — saying September already produced the highest single-month deportation count — and predicted the administration can surpass Barack Obama’s 409,000 fiscal-year removal record. The White House cites more than 605,000 deportations since Trump returned to office, while Homan notes ICE is still setting records despite more than 100 nationwide injunctions.

a3874e3128a64ea3b1ea3d2ad85873d307830197.headline: DHS: ICE has deported more than 2,000 known or suspected terrorists
a3874e3128a64ea3b1ea3d2ad85873d307830197.summary: Ahead of the 25th anniversary of 9/11, DHS said ICE arrested more than 2,150 known or suspected terrorists and deported 2,015 of them between Jan. 20, 2025 and Sept. 9, 2026. Secretary Markwayne Mullin framed the removals as “never forget” vigilance, citing cases that include a Mexico national charged as ringleader of a failed UFC Freedom 250 plot who had received DACA, a Brazilian PCC/CV commander arrested in North Carolina, and four Tren de Aragua members who pleaded guilty in a Bronx double murder after Biden-era releases.

da21c456c886affba8173fe4af20123bb7de6ad3.headline: Musk: Grok trails Anthropic for now; Grok Bot growing ~100% a month
da21c456c886affba8173fe4af20123bb7de6ad3.summary: In a China Media Group interview, Elon Musk called Grok 4.7 a “solid workhorse” that still lags Anthropic’s latest Opus-class models, blaming xAI’s shorter three-year head start versus Anthropic’s six and saying he expects to catch the frontier sometime next year. He said agentic Grok Bot — framed as a personal digital assistant — is growing about 100% month over month, and argued SpaceX and Tesla engineering data can push Grok past software-only rivals into real-world engineering AI. Musk also estimated China could close lithography and chipmaking gaps in roughly two to three years.

35c3771d8e2dc84a47ec4f715afe533802f00374.headline: Penguins close preseason 3–1 in Buffalo; Rust exits, Silovs rebounds
35c3771d8e2dc84a47ec4f715afe533802f00374.summary: Pittsburgh beat Buffalo 3–1 in Saturday’s preseason finale as Sidney Crosby opened with a vintage slap shot, Ville Koivunen scored off a Bryan Rust feed, and Nick Robertson sealed it with an empty-netter beside Rickard Rakell — after two other Penguins goals were wiped by coach’s challenges. Rust left in the second period with no update from coach Dan Muse, testing a forward depth already thinned in camp. Arturs Silovs bounced back from a rough Detroit outing with a strong finish; the club practices Sunday before the 23-man roster is due Monday at 5 p.m.

ac9baf4d82c9551e1efc4d5d69b4f7da7623f97a.headline: Jets–Lions Sunday: Glenn’s return, No. 1 defense vs. 31st, 1 p.m. FOX
ac9baf4d82c9551e1efc4d5d69b4f7da7623f97a.summary: Both clubs sit 1–1 heading into Sunday’s 1 p.m. ET FOX kickoff at Ford Field, where Jets coach Aaron Glenn faces the Lions offense he coordinated against as Detroit’s defensive coordinator from 2021–24. Dan Campbell said he has “tremendous” respect for Glenn and a clear read on New York’s style after Buffalo lit up Detroit 41–31 on Thursday Night Football.
