Jared Goff threw four touchdowns in that loss while Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs kept stacking dual scores; Lions.com notes fans can stream the local FOX feed free on phones via the club site and app.

5fbe3c7d57e48ddb8d745377c5a4dc3582e75124.headline: watchOS 27.0.1 patches unexpected restarts on Series 12 and Ultra 4
5fbe3c7d57e48ddb8d745377c5a4dc3582e75124.summary: Apple released watchOS 27.0.1 limited to Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, with release notes saying it fixes bugs including unexpected restarts that owners reported while editing faces, using Siri AI, Maps, workouts, and even idle. The update installs from the watch Settings app or the iPhone Watch app only when the watch is on the charger above 50% battery. It arrives about a week after watchOS 27’s public launch brought Siri AI and other system changes to the new hardware.

138add2e6c9ed2e9f905f30a31412d597819b372.headline: Amon Amarth’s The Allfather Awakens lands Oct. 2 with new Golden Hall stage
138add2e6c9ed2e9f905f30a31412d597819b372.summary: Johan Hegg told Germany’s Rock Antenne the band is anxious to share The Allfather Awakens, due Oct. 2 on Metal Blade, after writing only the songs they meant to keep and shelving one unfinished cut for the first time. Producer Jacob Hansen tracked the 13th album across two Denmark sessions ending March 2026, with a less-modern Marshall guitar tone and Odin-centric lyrics that are not a full concept album. Fall shows will unveil a new Golden Hall–inspired production as the North American tour with Dethklok and Castle Rat builds pre-release buzz.

d13f10f510faafdf17c76f1e7456ddc4b9b6b30e.headline: Jeep recalls ~202,000 SUVs after TPMS software goes silent on low tires
d13f10f510faafdf17c76f1e7456ddc4b9b6b30e.summary: Stellantis filed NHTSA campaign 26V559 covering 201,976 Jeep and Wagoneer SUVs from the 2024–2026 model years after Valeo Radio Frequency Hub software can lose reference pressures and never light the low-tire warning. The recall spans Grand Cherokee, Grand Cherokee L, Wagoneer, Grand Wagoneer, and related PHEVs; NHTSA warns a silent TPMS can cause a crash without prior warning and violates FMVSS 138. The free fix is a dealer reflash — no parts — with owner letters phased Sept. 29–Oct. 21; until then Stellantis says check tires with a gauge.

c75375ce07ea8135627e6c61ad2aa97a2d7dbffc.headline: LEGO Jurassic Park Jeep Wrangler 77984: 1,924-piece 1:10 display icon
c75375ce07ea8135627e6c61ad2aa97a2d7dbffc.summary: LEGO’s 18+ Jurassic Park Jeep Wrangler (77984) rebuilds the modified 1992 Sahara at 1:10 scale with 1,924 pieces, functional rear-spare steering, liftable hood, and modular canvas/roll-bar setups that echo Jeeps #18/#29, Nedry’s #12 escape, and the T. rex chase. A Dennis Nedry minifigure arrives with the shaving-cream embryo canister and island map, plus the classic “objects in mirror” T. rex sticker. Reviewers flag the winch and windshield as fiddly but praise the set as a display-first AFOL tribute that bridges Jeep and Jurassic collectors.

33b01c93ef18fab500a95c989f6622f441246554.headline: Musk: Cybercab expanding beyond Texas; Optimus could hit a billion robots
33b01c93ef18fab500a95c989f6622f441246554.summary: In the same China Media Group interview, Elon Musk said Cybercab is already operating commercially in Texas and will soon expand to Arizona, Nevada, and several other states, with broader commercial coverage targeted by mid-next year. He also projected Optimus could scale to at least one billion humanoid robots in less than a decade as Tesla pairs manufacturing with AI and robotics. Musk separately praised Tesla Shanghai’s Chinese team as the “magic” behind a factory he called “a gem,” while noting China’s AI models deliver strong performance per unit of compute.

e204e6a23f48eddb9703bebf533998a2166e2d47.headline: Trumbull Fall Flu Clinics open Sept. 30 with walk-ins through Nov. 9
e204e6a23f48eddb9703bebf533998a2166e2d47.summary: Trumbull’s Health Department posted its 2026 Fall Flu Clinic schedule, starting with walk-in hours Wednesday, Sept. 30 from 10 a.m.–noon and 2–4 p.m., then continuing through Nov. 9 with evening sessions and an Oct. 28 Superhero Theme Clinic. Pediatric nasal and standard shots plus adult and senior doses are offered while supplies last; bring insurance cards and ID, and print the consent form ahead if you can. Patients whose plans aren’t on the accepted list pay out of pocket, and residents without coverage are still welcome.

597705daad8df8f4f14bc8d326267263d2ad8e5e.headline: Banks: Indiana ICE sweep of 426 arrests shows why Congress must lock in Trump’s crackdown
597705daad8df8f4f14bc8d326267263d2ad8e5e.summary: Sen. Jim Banks (R-Ind.) told Fox News Digital that Operation Safe Community: Indiana’s five-day ICE push — 426 arrests tied to sex crimes, assault, domestic violence, drugs, and weapons — is exactly why voters chose mass deportation in 2024. He argues executive enforcement alone won’t survive a future Democratic administration and is pressing a seven-bill package covering birthright citizenship, H-1B, noncitizen CDLs, and TPS limits. Banks also dinged Senate Republicans for still not passing the SAVE Act’s proof-of-citizenship voting rules.

3c709fba5b47556cdbd031180e8fb09abaedcb74.headline: DHS: ‘No one is off the table’ after rumor ICE paused non-criminal arrests
3c709fba5b47556cdbd031180e8fb09abaedcb74.summary: After anonymous sources told The Daily Wire that ICE was ordered to stop collateral and non-criminal arrests ahead of the midterms, DHS fired back on X Saturday night: the claim is false and “no one is off the table.” The department said agents will keep arresting anyone in the country illegally and framed a nationwide surge around sanctuary-city criminals. Conservative critics had already blasted DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin; the quick denial aims to shut down talk of a quiet enforcement pullback.

c9483f89017de15d541abb78aeb8ceb3e41a32cc.headline: ICE lodges detainers on two men charged in New Braunfels crash that killed a father
c9483f89017de15d541abb78aeb8ceb3e41a32cc.summary: DHS says ICE placed immigration detainers on Rafael Alejandro Arreguin-Ramirez, 25, and Alejandro Aguillen-Acosta, 23, after a Sept. 12 head-on crash on FM 725 in New Braunfels killed 27-year-old Alejandro Nunez and injured his 3-year-old daughter. Both men entered illegally from Mexico and face intoxication manslaughter, aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, and evading arrest; the passenger fled on foot before police found him in a nearby garage. ICE asked Texas partners to hold them for removal after local prosecution.

76767239400c30f3c8ca1e9514bf484400fea1cf.headline: Trump stumps for Protect College Sports Act at Texas–Tennessee; Senate vote next week
76767239400c30f3c8ca1e9514bf484400fea1cf.summary: At Neyland Stadium on Saturday, President Trump pressed the Protect College Sports Act, claiming roughly 78 Senate votes and calling the bipartisan margin rare in recent years. He said the House still needs to act and praised Speaker Mike Johnson as “fantastic,” with a Senate vote expected Monday or Tuesday. Trump framed the bill as a fix for college athletics’ financial and competitive mess after NIL and transfer upheaval, using the Texas–Tennessee spotlight to lobby both lawmakers and fans.

445485dd0933c276287b8598298293f397e3957b.headline: Penguins cut six more, waive Caleb Jones as Monday roster deadline looms
445485dd0933c276287b8598298293f397e3957b.summary: Pittsburgh trimmed camp again, assigning Owen Pickering, Jake Livanavage, Chase Pietila, Rafael Harvey-Pinard, and goalie Cam Johnson to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton and placing defenseman Caleb Jones on waivers for the same destination. Jones’s 2025-26 season unraveled after early top-six promise — injuries, a mid-year setback, then a PED suspension left him with just seven games. The club still has to get down to 23 by Monday’s 5 p.m. deadline after closing preseason 3–1 in Buffalo.

2ba50401e9f3ce24ab8349ec01beea56e63aca41.headline: Jets preview: Glenn returns to Detroit in “attack mode” vs. Campbell’s Lions
2ba50401e9f3ce24ab8349ec01beea56e63aca41.summary: Official Jets preview frames Sunday’s Ford Field rematch as Aaron Glenn bringing the NFL’s top-ranked defense into a 60-minute brawl with Dan Campbell’s 31-point-per-game offense. Campbell called it no trap game after Buffalo’s 41–31 Thursday thrashing; Glenn said his unit is disciplined, limiting explosives, and “attacking in our way” without blitzing every snap. Geno Smith (70.8% completions) shrugged off scoreboard pressure, saying the job is to give the defense leads so it can hunt.

a0594ad4881be361333fdcbb95fbe3d4fd0b5a84.headline: Ritchie Blackmore: Deep Purple reunion felt like coming back from the dead
a0594ad4881be361333fdcbb95fbe3d4fd0b5a84.summary: In a new Now Spinning interview series published Sunday, Ritchie Blackmore likened his Aug. 12 Jones Beach cameo — one song, “Smoke on the Water,” after 33 years away — to a soldier everyone thought was dead walking home. Candice Night emailed the ask; Ian Gillan welcomed him for that single track, ticket sales jumped, and front-row fans sat in bay water as the crowd erupted. Blackmore called it playing with old friends and “well worth doing,” knowing it might be the last time they share a stage.

cec56dd471a1a834b4fb93e75b93e504c64ab1ea.headline: Napalm Death’s Shane Embury: next album ‘probably’ not before late 2027
cec56dd471a1a834b4fb93e75b93e504c64ab1ea.summary: Bassist Shane Embury told Pod Scum the grind pioneers are demoing album No. 17 with Russ Russell at Parlour Studios — guitars and bass tracked as “bare bones” for Danny Herrera to reshape — but touring means a late-2027 release is more likely than a summer drop. Mark “Barney” Greenway may start lyrics on the November run, and Embury joked a fan’s ask for a 12–13-minute weird track might actually happen. He’s still checking whether there’s enough blast-beat material for Herrera.

a7e2ce85c07312437fdfb8d901ddf86251e8fec2.headline: Minnesota Renaissance Festival hits 55 years with Art Affair weekend through Oct. 2
a7e2ce85c07312437fdfb8d901ddf86251e8fec2.summary: The country’s largest Ren Fest in Shakopee is celebrating 55 years and draws up to 300,000 visitors a season, with Sept. 26–27 themed as an “art affair” of Shakespeare, murals, and cosplay contests before the Oct. 2 finale. Full-contact jouster Sam Kuecker of The New Riders of the Golden Age says Minnesota’s crowd is louder than most stops on the circuit. College students can shave $7 (and get a free beer if of age) on the Friday closer with a student ID; A/B report cards unlock a free ticket any day.

c4cd0f6a2abe9c1da6e4085a01ae6bd9b9c9d379.headline: Triumph stop-ride recall: TF450 rocker arms can seize — dealers replace cylinder heads
c4cd0f6a2abe9c1da6e4085a01ae6bd9b9c9d379.summary: CPSC’s Sept. 10 notice covers about 1,560 U.S. and 171 Canadian 2025–26 Triumph TF450 dirt bikes (C, E, X, and RC; not the TF250) after rocker arms seize or stick, leaving exhaust valves open or broken and stalling the bike mid-ride. Triumph logged 12 reports and one crash with a broken bone; the free fix is a full cylinder-head swap, not a bolt tweak. Owners should park the bike, check the VIN on Triumph’s recall tool, and call 1-888-284-6288.

561b53d898dde7c5f5c441daf0b38a37aefe82a0.headline: Apple Watch Series 12 vs. Ultra 4: same health stack, $400 gap for most buyers
561b53d898dde7c5f5c441daf0b38a37aefe82a0.summary: MacRumors’ buyer’s guide says Series 12 and Ultra 4 share the S11 chip, 4GB RAM, and the new Health Sensing System with five-second heart-rate samples, Readiness, Recovery HRV, and hypertension alerts — so Ultra’s $799 sticker doesn’t buy better everyday health tracking than the $399 aluminum 12. Ultra wins on ~50-hour battery, satellite SOS, dual-frequency GPS, 100m dive rating, and Action button; Series 12 wins on weight, ceramic/titanium finishes, and price. Try the bulky 49mm Ultra on-wrist before paying the premium.

9a3cf2451435cfe109ac56ff829eba7078a3a414.headline: Trumbull adds third textile recycling bin at TEaM Transfer Station
9a3cf2451435cfe109ac56ff829eba7078a3a414.summary: Trumbull expanded Bay State Textile drop-off with a third bin at the TEaM Transfer Station, 101 Spring Hill Road near the exit, alongside existing bins at Hillcrest and Madison middle schools. Clean, bagged clothing, shoes, accessories, and linens go for reuse or recycling; mattresses, foam, and large rugs are out. Residents who prefer pickup can still schedule free Helpsy home collection online, part of the town’s push to keep textiles — nearly 5% of U.S. landfill space — out of the trash.

82efe7885369b992a73c86b3f16fb95ce845c252.headline: Trumbull closes Reservoir Road at White Plains for downed tree and wires; parks shut Sunday
82efe7885369b992a73c86b3f16fb95ce845c252.summary: Trumbull’s Emergency Management team posted a Sunday update: Reservoir Road is closed at White Plains Road after a tree came down on wires, with no ETA from UI for reopening, while White Plains itself stays open. Multiple other roads are partially blocked but none fully closed, and drivers are urged to proceed with caution. All town parks and the Rails to Trails corridor are closed for hazard clearing; crews plan to start cleanup Monday morning and reopen once hazards are gone.

17c0b5e2001fffc7d51064070b7b9ee9ba3e072f.headline: Trump admin denies ICE was told to limit arrests to criminals; Melugin: policy unchanged
17c0b5e2001fffc7d51064070b7b9ee9ba3e072f.summary: The Trump administration on Saturday night denied reports that ICE had temporarily ordered agents to arrest only illegal immigrants with criminal records, saying a “worst first” verbal guidance was a miscommunication rather than a policy change. Fox’s Bill Melugin, citing Trump and nine ICE/DHS sources, reported new guidance went back to field offices reaffirming the crackdown. Trump told Fox that ICE can still arrest and deport anyone here illegally, including “collaterals” encountered during other operations.

442699ae0ddbcf24c45e2e5eea3a350feb7fcd9d.headline: Lindsay Clancy back in court Tuesday for mistrial status conference and retrial fight
442699ae0ddbcf24c45e2e5eea3a350feb7fcd9d.summary: Lindsay Clancy appears Tuesday for her first court date since the Sept. 4 mistrial in the Plymouth County triple-murder case, where one holdout juror blocked a not-guilty-by-insanity verdict after she admitted killing her three children while arguing postpartum psychosis. Defense motions seek dismissal on double-jeopardy grounds, a directed not-guilty finding, and investigation of the holdout’s phone use; prosecutors have not yet said whether they will retry. Experts and jurors publicly split on whether another trial would end differently.

86553f3fa3603a4664b248cc7d367cfdc3746073.headline: White House bars CNN from Air Force One for Trump’s Tennessee trip despite court order
86553f3fa3603a4664b248cc7d367cfdc3746073.summary: CNN was left off the media travel roster for President Trump’s Saturday Air Force One trip to Knoxville, continuing a White House fight with outlets it calls “fake news” even after a federal judge ordered credentials restored for CNN, Politico, and MS NOW. Networks that paused White House coverage in solidarity had resumed Friday after reporters regained building access, but the administration still blocked some CNN and MS NOW reporters from a state-dinner arrival. Trump posted that “FAKE NEWS SHOULD NOT BE ALLOWED IN THE WHITE HOUSE.”

108359de19e41ff6715d7036fe6fc793000189f1.headline: Anthrax packs the Roxy between Iron Maiden LA dates with thrash classics set
108359de19e41ff6715d7036fe6fc793000189f1.summary: Anthrax squeezed an intimate Sept. 26 club show into the Roxy in West Hollywood between Iron Maiden support dates at BMO Stadium, running a 14-song thrash set from “It’s For The Kids” and “Madhouse” through “Indians.” Fan video is circulating as the band promotes new album Cursum Perficio—their first studio record in a decade since For All Kings—and the black-and-white video for the Latin title track. The Queens Big Four veterans continue supporting Maiden in Los Angeles through Sunday.

e77ffdc51a01a8c2810f56e439f0f8754902ee82.headline: Judas Priest closes Faithkeepers tour without Ian Hill as Uriah Heep’s Rimmer fills in
e77ffdc51a01a8c2810f56e439f0f8754902ee82.summary: Judas Priest finished the 2026 Faithkeepers tour at London’s Eventim Apollo without founding bassist Ian Hill, who sat out with a badly damaged left-arm tendon in what reports call his first missed Priest show since joining in 1970. Uriah Heep’s Davey Rimmer—also of Richie Faulkner’s Elegant Weapons—covered a 17-song classics-heavy set including “Breaking The Law” and “Panic Attack.” The band’s next confirmed dates are Tons Of Rock in Oslo and Tuska in Helsinki in mid-2027.

1f932ac469c906d2e1f234d9a389ef4d03dae8d3.headline: Tesla switches on in-car Grok Bot: Connectors for all, agent tasks behind SuperGrok Heavy
1f932ac469c906d2e1f234d9a389ef4d03dae8d3.summary: Tesla launched Grok Bot and Connectors in vehicles on Sept. 22, letting the cabin assistant move from Q&A to delegated errands like inbox cleanup, calendar edits, and ordering coffee. Connectors that link Gmail and Google Calendar are available to all users; the multi-step Grok Bot agent itself requires an xAI SuperGrok Heavy subscription reported around $300 a month. European availability is still unconfirmed because an agent that signs into third-party accounts raises separate data-protection and liability questions.

1dfda5935eccaedaec490a2cbf60789684fe27fa.headline: FAA issues Starship Flight 14 license; Monday 8:15 a.m. ET orbital window still a target
1dfda5935eccaedaec490a2cbf60789684fe27fa.summary: A Sept. 27 update confirms the FAA launch license for Starship Flight 14 was issued late Saturday, clearing the last regulatory gate after Booster 21 and Ship 41 finished wet dress rehearsal. SpaceX still targets Monday’s roughly 8:15–9:30 a.m. ET window from Starbase for the first orbital attempt with 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though weather and vehicle checks can scrub. October “no earlier than” markers for Flight 15 and a first LC-39A Florida flight remain planning-slide dates, not SpaceX announcements.

4ac6f34306d2ef2c3f3e1be4132b67194bc9e3b9.headline: King Richard’s Faire hits 45 years in Carver — weekends through Oct. 25, Gamers Guild next
4ac6f34306d2ef2c3f3e1be4132b67194bc9e3b9.summary: New England’s largest Renaissance faire is in its 45th season on 200 acres in Carver, Mass., open Saturdays and Sundays through Oct. 25 (plus Columbus Day) with jousts, 70-plus daily shows, and more than 110 artisan shops. USA Today readers ranked it among America’s top 10 Ren faires; this weekend’s Love & Companionship theme yields to Gamers Guild Oct. 3–4. Adult tickets run $40–$46 depending on date, parking is free, and organizers hope to push attendance past 110,000 toward 125,000.

7039bc9a3e453e8b7c84184d8b6566a374a417a9.headline: iPhone Duo pre-orders hit Oct. 16 at 5 a.m. PT — how to stack the odds for day-one stock
7039bc9a3e453e8b7c84184d8b6566a374a417a9.summary: MacRumors walks through prep for Apple’s first foldable: pre-orders open Friday, Oct. 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific, with U.S. and 70-plus country availability starting Oct. 23 and more markets Oct. 30. Tips include using the Apple Store app “Get Ready” configuration, locking payment and trade-in quotes early, opening the app and store web simultaneously, avoiding last-second basket changes, and preferring in-store pickup if offered because inventory pools differ. Initial stocks are expected to be extremely tight.

2cfdbaaf654171a27d66394f5c32fa241e3e71a0.headline: Penguins at 32 with roster deadline Monday — Kindel, Lizotte IR likely as nine more must go
2cfdbaaf654171a27d66394f5c32fa241e3e71a0.summary: After cutting six players Saturday, Pittsburgh still sits at 32 names with NHL opening rosters due Monday, meaning nine more must clear via cuts, waivers, or injured reserve. PensBurgh’s Sunday rundown flags Ben Kindel and Blake Lizotte as likely IR candidates, with Justin Brazeau, Bryan Rust, and Ryan Graves also banged up, while waiver-exempt options include Rutger McGroarty and Harrison Brunicke. Projected opening lines still center Crosby–Rakell and Malkin with Arturs Silovs and Sergei Murashov in net if Rust is healthy enough.

48da6e78a6ef0a7faba637d52477a0b778cec827.headline: Jets injury report: Mitchell (finger) and Ossai questionable; Fitzpatrick, Taylor, Mauigoa out
48da6e78a6ef0a7faba637d52477a0b778cec827.summary: The Jets’ final Week 3 report lists WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) and EDGE Joseph Ossai (foot) as questionable for Sunday’s 1 p.m. FOX game at Detroit, while S Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin), TE Mason Taylor (thumb), and LB Kiko Mauigoa (quad) are out and RB Kene Nwangwu is doubtful. Mitchell was limited after catching a finger on a jersey Thursday; Ossai returned to full practice Friday. Detroit rules out G Ben Bartch and S Thomas Harper, with several offensive linemen back to full participation.

84026ab0fbfc111ca365c8b8e7cc033927cf26d7.headline: Insta360 opens Times Square flagship as worldwide camera shipments top 10 million
84026ab0fbfc111ca365c8b8e7cc033927cf26d7.summary: Insta360’s first company-owned flagship outside Asia opened Sept. 19 at 1515 Broadway in Times Square, timed with the brand passing 10 million cameras shipped and claiming nearly 70% of global 360-camera shipments in Q1 per IDC. The demo-heavy store stocks Luna Ultra, Luna Pro, X6, GO wearables, and mics, with co-founder Max Richter cutting the ribbon alongside Casey Neistat. For U.S. creators it is a rare chance to hands-on test stitching workflows and the Luna telephoto before buying.

bd5d10fb07ba4e95b065896ee227401a46d9f560.headline: Trumbull girls soccer blanks Stamford 1–0; boys face Simsbury in Sunday Soccer Challenge
bd5d10fb07ba4e95b065896ee227401a46d9f560.summary: Trumbull’s girls soccer team beat Stamford 1–0 on Saturday in FCIAC play, a bounce-back result after midweek losses and a bright spot in a storm-shortened sports weekend. The boys, who fell 3–2 to undefeated Stamford on Friday, were scheduled for a 1:30 p.m. Sunday kickoff against Simsbury in the Connecticut High School Soccer Challenge. Several other Saturday FCIAC games were postponed by the nor’easter, so coaches and families are watching Sunday results and weather closely.

2513ac7b8c278ad93b63a477273717039d1184af.headline: Lions edge Jets 31–24 as Gibbs scores three; Geno Smith throws for 321 and three TDs
2513ac7b8c278ad93b63a477273717039d1184af.summary: Aaron Glenn’s return to Detroit ended in a 31–24 Week 3 loss as Jahmyr Gibbs ran for two scores and caught another, putting the Jets at 1–2. Geno Smith was sharp (31-of-37, 321 yards, three touchdowns), finding Garrett Wilson, Kenyon Sadiq, and Jeremy Ruckert, and the Jets tied it at 24 in the fourth before Goff’s late TD pass to Gibbs. Minkah Fitzpatrick, Adonai Mitchell, and Mason Taylor were among the inactives on Glenn’s first trip back to Ford Field.

4f7de3d170d4e5da60e044636e22fed365479b7d.headline: Penguins put Kindel, Lizotte, Brazeau, Graves on IR ahead of Monday roster deadline
4f7de3d170d4e5da60e044636e22fed365479b7d.summary: Pittsburgh cleared four roster spots Sunday by placing Blake Lizotte, Justin Brazeau, Ben Kindel, and Ryan Graves on injured reserve before Monday’s 5 p.m. NHL deadline. Bryan Rust and Tristan Broz skipped practice and are being evaluated after Saturday’s preseason finale; if both land on IR the Pens would sit at the 23-man maximum. Earlier Sunday the club also sent Bill Zonnon, Harrison Brunicke, and Joel Blomqvist to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton, with opening night set for Wednesday vs. Philadelphia.

fcb037d463f8ebbb59aaa6746701ae889a0279d5.headline: Watch live: Starship Flight 14 targets Monday 8:15 a.m. ET first orbital try
fcb037d463f8ebbb59aaa6746701ae889a0279d5.summary: SpaceX aims to send Starship to Earth orbit for the first time Monday in a 75-minute window opening at 8:15 a.m. ET from Starbase, with webcast coverage starting about 30 minutes before liftoff. Flight 14 would deploy 26 operational Starlink V3 satellites, circle Earth six times, then splash down in the Pacific nearly 10 hours after launch—a sharp break from prior suborbital Indian Ocean missions. Super Heavy is still planned for a Gulf of Mexico splashdown about seven minutes after liftoff while return-to-pad catch attempts wait for a later flight.

f7656d113ba5c19592b865bb753bfa054835e49a.headline: Waltz: Iran asked for sanctions relief ‘up front’; Trump still expects talks this week
f7656d113ba5c19592b865bb753bfa054835e49a.summary: UN ambassador Mike Waltz told CNN’s State of the Union that Trump rejected Tehran’s Hormuz reopen plan because negotiators wanted ‘billions and billions’ of sanctions relief first and ‘were not coming in good faith’ on the nuclear file. Trump separately told Axios he still expects indirect talks this week but said Iran ‘overplayed their hand.’ Waltz also said Trump pressed Xi on alleged Chinese help to Iran’s shipping attacks and rejected Wall Street Journal reports that U.S. bombing would automatically resume after the midterms.

e5bdef0078276fa7735a5e94925e5d4376c51f22.headline: AG Blanche: White House access is a ‘privilege … not a right’ amid CNN ban fight
e5bdef0078276fa7735a5e94925e5d4376c51f22.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche told ABC’s This Week that Trump has not ‘denied access’ so much as grown ‘sick and tired’ of outlets he says refuse to report accurately, calling White House presence a privilege rather than a right. A judge’s TRO restored CNN, MS NOW, and Politico credentials Thursday, but CNN said it was still blocked from Air Force One for Saturday’s Tennessee trip. Blanche framed inaccurate coverage as a ‘national security problem,’ while Judge Timothy Kelly’s ruling noted the record emphasized alleged negativity, not security, when the ban was announced.

b8fc166a2964fdb335d7ede8dc3f6fc15b576a44.headline: ICE spotted at Gurnee Mills after Waukegan, Woodstock, Vernon Hills arrest reports
b8fc166a2964fdb335d7ede8dc3f6fc15b576a44.summary: Community rapid-response teams reported ICE activity across Lake and McHenry counties, including a Friday arrest in Waukegan and agents later seen near Kohl’s at Gurnee Mills. Earlier in the week, witnesses described detentions in Vernon Hills and Woodstock; ICE confirmed it had arrested six illegal aliens in Woodstock on Sept. 11, including one man with a 2024 weapons conviction. ICE did not immediately comment on the newer mall and street reports as suburban Chicago enforcement remains in the spotlight.

746ca7701609051378f8f673a8341c0d01071d28.headline: Tesla quietly enables in-car Grok across Israel, UAE and more with update 2026.32.7
746ca7701609051378f8f673a8341c0d01071d28.summary: Software update 2026.32.7 is unlocking Tesla’s cabin Grok assistant in several Middle East markets, with owners in Israel and the UAE already confirming the icon in the App Launcher. Regional support pages list Israel, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Jordan for the rollout; cars need AMD Ryzen infotainment plus Premium Connectivity or Wi-Fi, and no separate Grok subscription is required. Drivers can navigate, manage climate and media, pull owner’s-manual answers, and—where enabled—reach newer Grok Bot agent features hands-free.

f17efceb0677f933071ef96052b90259da8b029e.headline: Tesla stages Cybercabs in Houston as NHTSA demands sworn answers by Sept. 30
f17efceb0677f933071ef96052b90259da8b029e.summary: Video and local reporting put roughly 45 Cybercabs plus Model Y Robotaxis at a new Houston hub while Tesla still runs paid robotaxi service in Austin. NHTSA’s Cybercab audit (AQ26002) and a Special Order require sworn answers by September 30 on how a vehicle without a steering wheel, pedals, or mirrors meets federal standards—penalties cited up to about $139 million. The piece frames Houston staging as confidence colliding with a self-certification fight Waymo has largely avoided by building on conventional vehicle architecture.

16bb600595ad7f564936531ae850ede6efc34fd2.headline: Karen Woodall: Diana–Spencer ‘whose side’ fight shows public-scale parental alienation
16bb600595ad7f564936531ae850ede6efc34fd2.summary: In a Sept. 21 essay tied to her forthcoming book The Journey of the Alienated Child, therapist Karen Woodall uses Earl Spencer’s disputed memoir claim that Charles said Diana would be ‘forgotten’ as a case study in psychological splitting. She argues media and audiences are recruited into hero/villain alignments that mirror divorce dynamics—where loving one figure seems to require rejecting another. Woodall’s closer asks whether remembering Diana (or any contested parent) can hold complexity without forcing the public, or a child, to pick a side.

68e804984e6154767e3104fa4ea2cf4f35a7b673.headline: Five Finger Death Punch packs Long Beach for 20th-anniversary tour; Fieldy joins onstage
68e804984e6154767e3104fa4ea2cf4f35a7b673.summary: FFDP’s 20th Anniversary World Tour hit Long Beach’s F&M Bank Amphitheater with Eva Under Fire and Cody Jinks opening, then a set spanning Welcome to the Circus through Lift Me Up, Jekyll and Hyde, Wash It All Away, and Bad Company. Ivan Moody brought Korn co-founder Fieldy onstage for a public thank-you that drew a huge crowd reaction amid the usual mosh-ready peaks like Burn MF. The band continues through Texas and Midwest amphitheater dates into early October.

40b6f00194f6265a06b3579f2dc594aa65e69159.headline: Trumbull: call UI and police non-emergency to report downed trees, wires, outages
40b6f00194f6265a06b3579f2dc594aa65e69159.summary: With the nor’easter still dropping limbs onto lines, Trumbull Emergency Management reminded residents to report power outages and downed wires to United Illuminating at 800-722-5584 and to call Trumbull Police non-emergency at 203-261-3665 when trees or lines block roads. The town stressed staying away from downed wires. The guidance pairs with Sunday’s separate alert closing Reservoir Road at White Plains and shutting parks until Monday hazard clearing.

634a357c1ea6f9e92ecd9f6d375c5e84e4e86738.headline: UI and Eversource restore tens of thousands after nor’easter; shoreline hit hardest
634a357c1ea6f9e92ecd9f6d375c5e84e4e86738.summary: Tens of thousands of Connecticut customers woke up without power Sunday after the nor’easter’s wind gusts toppled trees and lines across Fairfield County and the shoreline. United Illuminating crews worked neighborhoods in Milford and elsewhere after some customers lost power more than once, while Eversource said it had restored more than 120,000 customers by mid-morning. UI officials hoped most remaining outages would be cleared Sunday night — a continuing recovery story for Trumbull and other UI towns still clearing trees and wires.

2853779a9d68ef5a6a9d93ca7133d62498207023.headline: Westport: 262 still dark Sunday morning; parks, beaches and fields closed after nor’easter
2853779a9d68ef5a6a9d93ca7133d62498207023.summary: Westport’s Sunday roundup put 262 local customers without power at 7 a.m. (about 2% of town), with Weston harder hit at 547 outages and more than 28,000 dark statewide. Parks & Recreation closed all town parks, athletic fields, beaches and racquet facilities while staff assess storm damage, urging residents to avoid downed trees, flooding and barricades. The same post notes CraftWestport returns Nov. 7–8 at Staples and lists Staples football Wall of Fame inductees — practical Fairfield County recovery and community notes for the EMS always-search lane.

138abd297da41a11912b00718e6ab7fbdbea935e.headline: Jets fall 31–24 in Glenn’s Detroit return after late Geno fumble ends comeback
138abd297da41a11912b00718e6ab7fbdbea935e.summary: Aaron Glenn’s return to Detroit ended 31–24 after the Jets clawed from a 24–10 fourth-quarter hole to tie at 24, then watched Jahmyr Gibbs take Jared Goff’s game-winning score with 2:25 left. Geno Smith threw for 321 yards and three touchdowns; Garrett Wilson (10-107-1) and rookie TE Kenyon Sadiq (7-105-1) each topped 100 receiving yards before a late sack-fumble sealed it. Breece Hall (thigh) and Dylan Parham (knee) left injured; Wilson cleared a head evaluation as New York dropped to 1–2 ahead of next week at Chicago.

74be918e674e5b599c78e1df746920c65c808051.headline: Penguins send Zonnon, Brunicke, Blomqvist to AHL with Monday roster deadline looming
74be918e674e5b599c78e1df746920c65c808051.summary: Pittsburgh assigned forward Bill Zonnon, defenseman Harrison Brunicke and goaltender Joel Blomqvist to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton on Sunday as the club closes in on its 23-man roster before Monday’s deadline. None of the moves were surprises after solid camps; Brunicke is expected to pair with Owen Pickering in the AHL while Blomqvist starts in WBS and Sergei Murashov remains the NHL backup behind Arturs Silovs. The Penguins open Wednesday at Philadelphia with more injury-driven call-ups still possible.

c8a57cd58cc9565ee228484f29d4d88f0e042a57.headline: Starship Flight 14: first orbital try Monday with 26 Starlink V3s and Pacific splashdown
c8a57cd58cc9565ee228484f29d4d88f0e042a57.summary: NASASpaceFlight’s Sunday deep dive lays out Flight 14’s first orbital plan: Booster 21 and Ship 41 lifting from Starbase at 7:15 a.m. CDT Monday in a 75-minute window, aiming for a ~275 km orbit, deployment of 26 Starlink V3 satellites, then an ~10-hour mission ending with a Chile-coast Pacific splashdown. Conservatives abort paths keep Indian Ocean and Hawaii splashdowns available if health checks fail, and the FAA’s revised Part 450 license now splits launch and reentry orders for this flight only. Booster catch is deferred; success would clear the path toward reuse and Flight 15.

ec34cfcc6db1de32615e4aff243c015ceba89bec.headline: Araghchi on Meet the Press: Iran ‘fully prepared’ for war resume but still open to diplomacy
ec34cfcc6db1de32615e4aff243c015ceba89bec.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told NBC’s Meet the Press that Tehran is ready to resume fighting with the United States while still pursuing diplomacy after President Trump publicly rejected a seven-day Hormuz reopen plan. He said Trump’s rejection had not yet been formally delivered through mediators and that Iran wants frozen assets and oil sales restored under terms Iran says track the collapsed June MOU. UN Ambassador Mike Waltz, also on MTP, called the offer a cynical bid for sanctions relief and said Trump will keep all options on the table.

b0539216881f557ba755ae9aa063d9e82ea7e1aa.headline: Judge Kelly’s TRO restores CNN, MS NOW and POLITICO hard passes for 14 days
b0539216881f557ba755ae9aa063d9e82ea7e1aa.summary: A detailed free legal write-up of Judge Timothy Kelly’s Sept. 24 TRO in Cable News Network v. Trump explains why the White House must reinstate hard passes for CNN, MS NOW and POLITICO for 14 days — on Fifth Amendment due process, not a First Amendment merits win. The court found no notice, no hearing and only a vague “professionalism and decorum” standard, and it carved President Trump himself out of the injunction’s binding language. Preliminary-injunction briefing runs through early October as the Air Force One access fight continues in parallel.

972cdbd8126e91dc0909c8ac4a5b358ad0d48bc3.headline: Fort Lauderdale Airbnb renter shoots teen in alleged home invasion; probed as self-defense
972cdbd8126e91dc0909c8ac4a5b358ad0d48bc3.summary: Fort Lauderdale police say an Airbnb renter shot 18-year-old Dareon Pubien in the chest after two armed men allegedly broke into the rental on Sept. 24. Pubien fled wounded, was found nearby in critical but stable condition, and now faces attempted murder and home-invasion charges along with 25-year-old Sean Thompson, who was held without bond. The renter has not been publicly identified while detectives investigate the shooting as self-defense and whether the break-in was random or targeted.

58b6f7051eaf3f30b52f42c779c6b2875eae0b2d.headline: Kane County clears Aurora officers in January knife-and-fuel fatal shooting
58b6f7051eaf3f30b52f42c779c6b2875eae0b2d.summary: Kane County State’s Attorney Jamie Mosser ruled Sunday that two Aurora officers were justified when they fatally shot 27-year-old Temesgen Welendreyas in January after he advanced with a knife and what proved to be a diesel fuel can. Officers spent about 17 minutes trying to de-escalate, then fired four rounds when he swung the knife close enough to strike a shield on entry. Mosser found no state-law or department-policy violations after a Fox Valley Major Crimes Task Force investigation.

0882bcfd6d0e62fe191651d86769655e03115c44.headline: iPhone Duo hands-on: crease nearly gone, IP68 and Pencil — still $1,999 and heavier than Fold 8
0882bcfd6d0e62fe191651d86769655e03115c44.summary: Tom’s Guide’s Mark Spoonauer says Apple’s first foldable feels polished in early hands-on use: a hard-to-feel crease on the 7.6-inch inner display, IP68 durability, grade-5 titanium, MagSafe and Apple Pencil support that Samsung’s Fold 8 lacks. Trade-offs remain — $1,999 starting price, thicker/heavier than the Galaxy Z Fold 8, dual rear cameras without a true telephoto, and two-app multitasking versus Samsung’s three. Pre-orders open Oct. 16 for an Oct. 23 launch.

2ef679a1ad299d1d9eda9b8cdd0c6d3b718dee8c.headline: Tesla engineers say Grok 4.7 overnight agents are shipping FSD and Cybercab features
2ef679a1ad299d1d9eda9b8cdd0c6d3b718dee8c.summary: Elon Musk highlighted a Tesla AI staff engineer’s note that Grok 4.7’s Build harness helped ship multiple FSD and Cybercab features overnight after weeks of harness tuning for longer-running agents and better multimodal performance. The piece frames Grok as moving from chatbot to real engineering tool inside Tesla while the same assistant expands in-car for email, calendars and work tasks. Specific features weren’t named, but the overlap between Tesla product work and xAI tooling keeps growing.

e44485406aa7d537701063deb63ec0fbf37d9d16.headline: Metallica maps Sphere fringe events for Life Burns Faster Las Vegas takeover
e44485406aa7d537701063deb63ec0fbf37d9d16.summary: Metallica’s Life Burns Faster Sphere run starts Oct. 1 with no-repeat Thursday/Saturday weekends through Halloween, and the band detailed fan extras across the Strip: a Venetian Summit pop-up, Friday Black Box memorabilia rooms, Art of Squindo Q&As, a SiriusXM takeover, Blackened cigar events and a Red Cross blood-drive merch experience. The shows lean on Sphere’s wraparound LED, immersive audio and 4D effects for a career-spanning set unlike a standard arena night. Tickets and fringe details are live ahead of the October opening.

b1a755a24b6d29c4599ca6d943877d71cd1f3756.headline: CT Renaissance Faire guide: Lebanon weekends through Oct. 25, new jousts and Merry Macabre
b1a755a24b6d29c4599ca6d943877d71cd1f3756.summary: The CT Beacon’s free 2026 guide covers the Lebanon Country Fairgrounds Faire through Oct. 25 — $18 adults, 40+ daily shows on 13 stages, new Roundtable/Equus Nobilis jousts, and the new Merry Macabre weekend Oct. 24–25. Practical notes include $10 advance premium parking (525 spots), free shuttle lots, a broad pet policy and same-day re-entry with a handstamp. Useful planning copy for remaining fall weekends after the nor’easter scrambled late-September outdoor events.

cebd7ceb0135c2baaa8e7044951a4f55f163446e.headline: CT Patch: ~22,000 still dark Sunday afternoon — Fairfield County towns and UI pockets listed
cebd7ceb0135c2baaa8e7044951a4f55f163446e.summary: Patch’s Sunday town-by-town outage tracker put more than 20,000 Connecticut customers still dark by mid-afternoon as the slow-moving nor’easter kept dropping trees on lines. Eversource listed heavy hits in New Canaan, Weston, Westport, Wilton, Stamford and Ridgefield; United Illuminating still showed outages in Milford, Orange, Shelton, Fairfield and Bridgeport — UI territory that includes Trumbull. Crews said they had restored more than 71,000 since the storm began while coastal flood warnings and leaf-heavy winds kept fresh damage coming.

3dd84662ab3a5c7abf4320e36aa1ccc79afd8f41.headline: Westport: burning wires shut Easton Road as nor’easter closes roads from Wilton to Putnam
3dd84662ab3a5c7abf4320e36aa1ccc79afd8f41.summary: A coastal-storm roundup details how Westport fire officials closed Easton Road between the Berkeley Road entrances after downed wires ignited, urging drivers to stay clear while crews worked the hazard. Wilton reported four roads fully closed and eight partially blocked; Groton, Montville, Old Saybrook, Killingworth and Putnam logged tree-and-wire closures as PowerOutage.us briefly showed ~31,000 Connecticut customers dark. Officials repeated the same EMS-adjacent safety line: treat every downed line as live and never drive around barricades.

6c81986ff2a1e8f25255660f340df9f211b4e7f7.headline: Bridgeport: masked pair tries Butler Avenue home invasion, then fires at people outside
6c81986ff2a1e8f25255660f340df9f211b4e7f7.summary: Bridgeport police say two masked men jumped a fence and tried to force a side window on Butler Avenue around 10:30 p.m. Friday before being scared off. As they fled to a car, the pair fired at people outside; no one was hit, but bullets struck a targeted resident’s vehicle and officers recovered shell casings. Detectives call the home a targeted attempt, have made no arrests, and ask tipsters to contact Det. Francis Santoro — a Fairfield County public-safety story next door to Trumbull.

7d198fafd980017ac25e5632cc90f44d6a7b3f76.headline: Trump: five men arrested near RAF Fairford were looking to do ‘big damage’
7d198fafd980017ac25e5632cc90f44d6a7b3f76.summary: British counter-terror police arrested five men near RAF Fairford on Sunday after a tip about three vans heading toward the U.S.-used air base that has staged strikes on Iran. President Trump told reporters the suspects had been under long-term U.K.–U.S. watch and were “looking to do big damage,” praising the joint takedown. About 85 homes were evacuated under a 400-metre cordon while bomb disposal examined the vans; Iranian-linked, Russian sabotage and Islamist motives are all being examined, Reuters reported.

1488eba3684a098c619352905e337a92a2e9fce0.headline: Lee’s SAVE Act unanimous-consent push blocked again by Padilla as midterms loom
1488eba3684a098c619352905e337a92a2e9fce0.summary: Sen. Mike Lee took the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act back to the Senate floor, arguing citizenship proof at registration and photo ID at the polls match how Americans already live — and that an “honor system” must not govern elections. Sen. Alex Padilla blocked the unanimous-consent request, calling a mid-election rules change chaotic and pivoting to tariffs and Iran costs. Lee said Democrats once claimed the bill was racist and now simply “secured the delay,” with the chamber still short of 60 votes.

c5d40ff43ddd5aeb9d83b1404a6f580df41bbf20.headline: Glenn after Lions loss: Jets are ‘right there’ — Davis says no moral victories
c5d40ff43ddd5aeb9d83b1404a6f580df41bbf20.summary: After New York’s 31–24 defeat in Detroit, Aaron Glenn held up a thumb-and-index gap and told reporters the Jets must close that coaching-and-player margin. Geno Smith (31-of-37, 321 yards, 3 TDs) and Garrett Wilson fueled a fourth-quarter rally that tied the game before Jahmyr Gibbs’ late score; Demario Davis said he believes Glenn’s blueprint and rejects moral victories. The club heads to Chicago at 1–2 after in-game injuries to Breece Hall and Dylan Parham.

221208453f8b41ca3a07c66ce4a2d705b99d3e76.headline: Penguins: three to AHL, four on IR — still short of Monday’s 23-man limit
221208453f8b41ca3a07c66ce4a2d705b99d3e76.summary: Pittsburgh assigned Bill Zonnon, Harrison Brunicke and Joel Blomqvist to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton and listed Blake Lizotte, Justin Brazeau, Ben Kindel and Ryan Graves on IR as the Monday roster deadline arrives. Bryan Rust and Tristan Broz were being evaluated after missing practice; Andrei Kuzmenko remains on personal leave. Yahoo’s Sunday count still sat above 23, with Hallander–Lapierre–Koivunen the emerging “opportunity” third line before Wednesday’s opener in Philadelphia.

de7583d0d2e5b85cb8decb94ca1f346efcea7bf2.headline: Ars: Tesla workers balk at training Optimus robots meant to replace them
de7583d0d2e5b85cb8decb94ca1f346efcea7bf2.summary: Ars Technica’s read of The Information’s Optimus reporting says Fremont is building hundreds of V3 humanoids a week after killing Model S/X production — yet hands still need 100+ manual fasteners, sensors fail, and AI can’t generalize. Factory workers who wore motion-capture suits complained they were training their replacements, so Tesla shifted capture to dedicated hubs. The company still aims for 1,000+ robots a week by year-end while leasing early units only into factories that look like its own.

fecdde6f95086f9883d58b5a07a70cc047e2f97a.headline: Apple 3D-prints iPhone Duo’s recycled titanium hinge cover — 100+ parts inside
fecdde6f95086f9883d58b5a07a70cc047e2f97a.summary: Additive-manufacturing outlet 3Dnatives highlights the engineering story behind Apple’s first foldable: a 3D-printed Grade 5 recycled-titanium hinge cover and a 100-plus-component hinge scanned by confocal laser, then leveled with up to 25 AI-matched photopolymer micro-layers. Johny Srouji framed the process as a decade of waiting until print quality hit Apple’s scale bar, following LPBF titanium Watch cases and the iPhone Air USB-C port. Honor and OPPO shipped printed hinges earlier; Samsung’s Fold 8 still has not.

995b3d07b8d05d82e68fdfaeabf628dce3cf5d81.headline: Unitree Dex5-S five-finger robot hand: 22 DOF, ~620g, from $6,500
995b3d07b8d05d82e68fdfaeabf628dce3cf5d81.summary: Hangzhou’s Unitree added the Dex5-S dexterous hand — roughly human-hand sized, 22 degrees of freedom (up from 20 on the Dex5-1), about 620 grams, with external back-drivability and impact protection on every joint. Dollar list starts near $6,500 after tax and shipping; Chinese coverage cited ~39,900 yuan domestically. The hand is not yet in Unitree’s global store with country shipping dates, and the company published no independent durability or task-success benchmarks.

278b308554c61eedec5467ef81331f6f37eb55fb.headline: Trumbull boys soccer blanks Simsbury 1–0 in Sunday Soccer Challenge
278b308554c61eedec5467ef81331f6f37eb55fb.summary: Trumbull kept a clean sheet Sunday and edged Simsbury 1–0 in the Soccer Challenge matchup that had been waiting on a final overnight. MaxPreps has the Eagles at 6–3–1 (1–2–1 since a three-game win streak ended) and ranked 21st in Connecticut, well ahead of the Trojans (1–5–4, ranked 112th). Both sides hit the road next — Trumbull at McMahon Wednesday at 5:30 p.m., Simsbury at Conard Thursday.

06796e0f666c8ede01f231c5a36b9ad1583b3dc2.headline: Westport: Jesup Road bridge out 12–18 months; EMS tests say only slight delay
06796e0f666c8ede01f231c5a36b9ad1583b3dc2.summary: Westport’s Jesup Road bridge, wrecked by the Sept. 13 flash flood, must be replaced rather than repaired — Public Works estimates 12–18 months even with expedited permitting. Police say patrol response is unaffected, but EMS and Volunteer EMS dispatch from the Jesup Road headquarters; First Selectman Kevin Christie said EMS Chief Patrick Riddle’s timed runs found roughly 30 seconds to one minute extra only for calls on Imperial Avenue south of the closure. The town is seeking state and federal help and may demolish the compromised span soon.

15e0979f7ff5cf2314c17b48902a8b432e53bfc7.headline: Breece Hall headed for Monday MRI after thigh injury ends Jets’ late collapse
15e0979f7ff5cf2314c17b48902a8b432e53bfc7.summary: Breece Hall left Sunday’s 31–24 loss in Detroit clutching his right thigh and told reporters he felt something while running, then again when he planted — and that an MRI is likely Monday. Garrett Wilson cleared concussion protocol after a late hit; left guard Dylan Parham (knee) did not return. Geno Smith’s 321 yards and three touchdowns fueled a 24–10 comeback before Jahmyr Gibbs’ late score and a strip-sack sealed New York’s second straight late defeat at 1–2.

993ef8ed9e75ff1875117eb45b156ae9abc2cbd6.headline: Penguins: Lizotte back at full-contact practice — IR may not block opener
993ef8ed9e75ff1875117eb45b156ae9abc2cbd6.summary: Blake Lizotte (upper-body, day-to-day) returned to full-contact practice Sunday in his usual fourth-line center spot even as Pittsburgh listed him, Justin Brazeau, Ben Kindel and Ryan Graves on IR ahead of Wednesday’s opener in Philadelphia. Pro Hockey Rumors notes the IR move may not keep Lizotte out of the Flyers game if he keeps progressing; Brazeau and Kindel are week-to-week and Graves (knee) is out indefinitely while Bryan Rust, Tristan Broz and Andrei Kuzmenko remain cloudy.

c2a00db581e1f5ebb35e6beecba0701fe87299d5.headline: Trump: White House ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban as prices soar
c2a00db581e1f5ebb35e6beecba0701fe87299d5.summary: Speaking Sunday at the Presidents Cup, President Trump told Fox the White House is still “thinking about it very seriously” and “may do” a diesel export restriction as U.S. retail diesel hovers near record highs around $6.50 a gallon ahead of the midterms. Energy Secretary Chris Wright has floated limits rather than a full ban; analysts and the American Petroleum Institute warn refiners could cut runs and lift gasoline prices, while Europe — which has leaned on U.S. cargoes for roughly half its recent diesel imports — would face a sharper squeeze.

d7dd56c5c0f698126039f4fe28b944dd526f53fd.headline: DHS: assaults on ICE up more than 1,700% vs Biden’s first 21 months
d7dd56c5c0f698126039f4fe28b944dd526f53fd.summary: Homeland Security data cited by The Center Square count 647 assaults on ICE officers in the first 21 months of Trump’s second term versus 37 in the same Biden window — more than a 1,700% jump — with death threats up even more sharply. Secretary Markwayne Mullin blamed “vicious lies” from sanctuary politicians; the roundup lists finger-biting and Molotov attacks from Minneapolis to Los Angeles, vehicle-dragging and Tren de Aragua assaults, white-powder mailings, and Texas facility shootings, as Sen. John Cornyn’s ICE Protection Act seeks tougher penalties.

d447011211d3274019ce3ba84b1b77678a561882.headline: Matt Walsh: ‘Good for Jonathan Majors’ for refusing to cave on Infidels role
d447011211d3274019ce3ba84b1b77678a561882.summary: After Jonathan Majors defended starring in Daily Wire’s campus-terror thriller Run Hide Fight: Infidels, Matt Walsh praised the actor for “refusing to cave” amid backlash over the film’s portrayal of Islamist violence at a protest encampment. Majors told Daily Wire subscribers he reads scripts for character responsibility, director vision, and whether the material asks questions he cannot already answer — and said he wanted the Clay Saunders role to grow as an artist. The sequel landed Sept. 16 on Daily Wire’s platform to polarized reviews.

bc442f6bd460680d115d11ef4de71a5cf1a40172.headline: Jeep recalls ~97,000 Wagoneer SUVs after roof crossbars can detach
bc442f6bd460680d115d11ef4de71a5cf1a40172.summary: FCA US is recalling 97,349 Jeep Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer models (2022–2026, including L variants) because under-torqued roof-rack pivot bolts can let a crossbar detach and become a road hazard. NHTSA’s report cites rattling or a missing bolt as owner clues; FCA found 15 related warranty claims worldwide and no known crashes or injuries as of late August. Dealers were notified around Sept. 17; owners get interim notices starting Oct. 8 while redesigned remedy bolts are prepared — check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

d6a18f44485cab3aeea3bda2d18e5b1cc9d9f2c2.headline: Starship Flight 14: Monday window open for first orbital try with 26 Starlink V3s
d6a18f44485cab3aeea3bda2d18e5b1cc9d9f2c2.summary: Spaceflight Now’s Monday live coverage frames Starship Flight 14 (booster B21 / Ship 41) as the program’s first attempt at a sustained Earth orbit, with a 75-minute window opening 8:15 a.m. ET from Starbase. If the ~25-minute insertion burn succeeds, Ship 41 would deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites starting about 34 minutes after liftoff, complete roughly six orbits, then splash down off western South America — with no recovery of either stage and a possible Ship catch deferred to Flight 15.

e887929a76d8ecf7a94199c39c3ce597453ee12b.headline: Inmo Air3 smart glasses recalled after overheating temples cause burns
e887929a76d8ecf7a94199c39c3ce597453ee12b.summary: Inmo is recalling more than 1,600 Air3 smart glasses sold in the U.S. and Canada after the left temple can overheat in extended use — a burn hazard the CPSC ties to 10 reports of burning on the face and left ear. Units sold Dec. 2025–Aug. 2026 for $900–$1,300 via Inmo, Amazon and Kickstarter carry an Air3/Inmo label on the right temple. Owners should stop using them immediately and contact Inmo for a free firmware update; earlier reviews had already flagged the heat and a protective sleeve bundled with the glasses.

fa54d592a0e35bdc008d0a3c4d9cbaf1cc05bb9c.headline: Long Hill Fire contains lithium-ion battery blaze in Trumbull bedroom
fa54d592a0e35bdc008d0a3c4d9cbaf1cc05bb9c.summary: Long Hill Fire and mutual-aid crews snuffed a lithium-ion battery pack that was actively burning inside a Trumbull bedroom Monday morning, then checked the room so residual battery hazards were clear. The fire stayed limited to the pack and the bedroom where it started, the department said. Earlier the same storm cycle, Long Hill also covered an Easton house fire on mutual aid and logged 18 total calls for service.

477a4e2e40ebff3d5b592ad7226bfc8d2bfc8680.headline: Starship Flight 14 reaches orbit for the first time — then comes home early
477a4e2e40ebff3d5b592ad7226bfc8d2bfc8680.summary: SpaceX’s Starship hit Earth orbit Monday for the first time after controllers briefly called off the insertion burn when Ship 41 lost one Raptor, then pressed ahead and confirmed “Starship is orbital.” Ship deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites and linked to each of them, while Super Heavy completed its cleanest V3 splashdown simulation in the Gulf. About 1.5 hours in, SpaceX cut the planned ~nine-hour, six-orbit flight short and said it would deorbit Ship safely into a cleared Pacific zone after roughly three hours.

92dad350e4ef1afb7fb6864a1bc2e258fbf22d18.headline: Trump to MAGA: ‘Pretend I am on the ballot’ for the midterms
92dad350e4ef1afb7fb6864a1bc2e258fbf22d18.summary: On Truth Social Monday, President Trump praised Heritage Foundation President Kevin Roberts’ Fox hit on midterm polling, vowed to spend and campaign for Republican candidates, and told supporters: “MAGA, pretend I am on the ballot.” He argued he carried many of the contested states and districts “often by a landslide,” tied turnout to keeping borders closed and crime down, and closed with “KEEP AMERICA GREAT!!!” The pitch lands as Republicans defend narrow majorities in a classic midterm headwind.

e1cf4bc7d3323b75808a0fba4a9ca7ba68b21c68.headline: White House press ban lifted after TRO — legal fight with CNN, MS NOW, Politico rolls on
e1cf4bc7d3323b75808a0fba4a9ca7ba68b21c68.summary: Journalists from CNN, MS NOW and Politico are back on White House grounds after Judge Timothy Kelly’s temporary restraining order restored credentials Trump revoked over “fake news” coverage. Kelly focused on Fifth Amendment due process — fair notice and a chance to respond — more than a broad First Amendment right to the complex, and the 14-day TRO tees up a preliminary-injunction fight. The AP roundup notes the video pool had refused to shoot while CNN was barred, then resumed once the ban was lifted.

3ee492e04c929d2c110458fe83b387f734533f7d.headline: Bose’s first wired earbuds in 11 years add active noise canceling for $99
3ee492e04c929d2c110458fe83b387f734533f7d.summary: Bose is back with wired earbuds for the first time since 2015: Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds at $99 with USB-C, lossless-capable audio, IPX4 sweat resistance, and QuietControl ANC modes (Quiet, Aware, or off) on an inline remote. Preorders opened Monday in black, white smoke, and limited dewdrop mint, with shipping expected around Oct. 13–15. The pitch is simple — no battery anxiety — while still borrowing a decade of earbud mic and ANC progress for calls and commute use.

9f5dade0406c6c2d8a3182ec448054d6e89ec906.headline: Jeep/Ram 3.6L rocker-arm warranty settlement: CT owners face Oct. 12 claim deadline
9f5dade0406c6c2d8a3182ec448054d6e89ec906.summary: FCA’s proposed Regueiro settlement automatically extends coverage on valve rocker arms, stem oil seals, and tappets to seven years or 70,000 miles for 2015–2020 3.6L Ram, Jeep, Dodge and Chrysler models bought or leased in California plus ten Section 177 states — including Connecticut. Separate uncapped reimbursement for out-of-pocket repairs needs a claim by Oct. 12, 2026 (same day as opt-out/objection), with a final approval hearing set for Oct. 28. Many high-mileage trucks are already past the extension window, so the reimbursement half is the live money for most owners.

88bc7a4fef69bca813f6ba1fb59d78ac9d137270.headline: Harley-Davidson teases Road King ST return for 2027 — plus non-CVO Glide STs
88bc7a4fef69bca813f6ba1fb59d78ac9d137270.summary: Harley’s parts site has spun up 2027 accessory landing pages for a Road King ST — the clearest signal yet that the Road King nameplate is coming back after the Special exited in 2025 and the base King left in 2022. Motorcycle.com also flags non-CVO Street Glide ST and Road Glide ST pages, implying performance-leaning tourers below the carbon-heavy CVO trims, likely on the Milwaukee-Eight 117 platform. Formal styling and pricing still await the first 2027 color/model dump.

2a3a1cdf851ed49ca4b627512aab8f1f353c390c.headline: Insta360 X5 firmware adds AI Director that edits 360 highlights while it charges
2a3a1cdf851ed49ca4b627512aab8f1f353c390c.summary: Insta360’s X5 firmware 1.13.21 (noted Sept. 16, covered mid-month) turns charging time into an on-camera edit pass: AI Director scans your 360 footage, picks highlights, and leaves a finished clip ready when you reopen the app — no cloud fee. It also unlocks the Foldable Selfie Stick Remote Kit’s joystick for gimbal-like flat video out of camera. Catch: no I-Log support, keep the card footage until you review the cut, and you need app 2.33.6+ (Android 2.34.0 lists the feature).

600e268fad3e0b613c07244c6db393bfeb7cf63d.headline: Fall colors in U.S. parks are getting harder to time as climate swings widen
600e268fad3e0b613c07244c6db393bfeb7cf63d.summary: Outside’s late-September briefing walks through 2026 phenology research showing warmer eastern summers can push color later while western drought can brown aspens early — so historical “peak week” calendars are less reliable. Park-by-park notes cover Rocky Mountain, Yellowstone/Teton, Cuyahoga, the Smokies, Shenandoah, and Acadia (where one study puts peak almost two weeks later than 1950). Practical takeaway for leaf-peepers: treat old averages as a starting point, watch drought/foliage reports, and use elevation bands instead of one locked weekend.

4ff9a8913a042153b53a9d83d6e1b2f18a412a18.headline: Penguins: AHL cuts and four on IR leave Monday roster crunch before Flyers opener
4ff9a8913a042153b53a9d83d6e1b2f18a412a18.summary: Beyond Sunday’s IR paperwork, PensBurgh’s Monday-facing roster board shows Zonnon, Brunicke and Blomqvist already in Wilkes-Barre while Brazeau, Graves, Kindel and Lizotte sit on IR — and Pittsburgh still needs at least two more moves by the NHL’s Monday afternoon opening-roster deadline. Rust and Broz are being evaluated after the Sabres preseason finale; Kuzmenko remains a non-roster candidate on personal leave. That shuffle opens a real look for a Hallander–Lapierre–Koivunen “opportunity line” heading into Wednesday’s opener in Philadelphia.

9033f5be22021ece4f87bd9159b0045eb3c654c2.headline: Trumbull Halloween Costume Swap: donation drop-off ends today; free swaps Oct. 8 and 10
9033f5be22021ece4f87bd9159b0045eb3c654c2.summary: Sustainable Trumbull’s Halloween Costume Swap wraps its library lobby donation window Monday, September 28, after accepting clean, complete costumes for all ages since Sept. 12. Free first-come shopping is set for Thursday, Oct. 8 (5–7:30 p.m.) in the Trumbull Library Community Room and Saturday, Oct. 10 (9 a.m.–noon) at Trumbull High School on Strobel Road. The town frames the reuse drive as a way to cut textile waste from costumes that rarely get worn a second year.

55fa76362a0546ce0cdbd190237bd2095ddf3485.headline: Apple ships iOS 27.0.1 — Face ID restart bug on iPhone 18 Pro gets the promised fix
55fa76362a0546ce0cdbd190237bd2095ddf3485.summary: Apple released iOS 27.0.1 on Monday, two weeks after iOS 27 launched, with the Face ID software fix it previewed last week for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Release notes also call out a 2x photo color-artifact bug on a small number of those phones and a touchscreen freeze when Notification Center and Control Center open together. Matching 27.0.1 builds landed for iPadOS and visionOS, plus 26.7.1 patches for devices still on the prior generation.

e4f7a67d7162406ecbee99bdf2023afdb332d0c9.headline: LaCivita: Trump will hit the campaign trail for 30 days to turn out midterm voters
e4f7a67d7162406ecbee99bdf2023afdb332d0c9.summary: In a Breitbart exclusive, Trump 2024 co-campaign manager Chris LaCivita said the president plans roughly 30 days of trail stops plus telephone rallies to mobilize casual 2024 voters as Republicans defend Congress. He dismissed midterm doomcasting as “bedwetting,” argued Democrats in Congress poll worse than Republicans, and warned GOP candidates not to distance themselves from Trump. LaCivita also stressed favorable/unfavorable ratings over ballot tests and said shifting turnout a few points in each district is the House path.

90701ee424b0d6d28c0fc6242886185f1df43982.headline: Starship Flight 14 splashes down near Hawaii after first orbit and Starlink V3 deploy
90701ee424b0d6d28c0fc6242886185f1df43982.summary: Aerospace America’s Monday debrief puts Starship’s Pacific splashdown near Hawaii at 10:58 a.m. Central — about three hours after the 7:48 a.m. Starbase liftoff — after controllers cut a planned ~10-hour mission short when a Raptor Vacuum shut down early. Ship still reached ~275 km, deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites (three carrying heatshield-scan cameras), and completed a single-Raptor deorbit burn; Super Heavy splashed in the Gulf about seven minutes after launch. SpaceX called the orbital milestone the start of rapid-reuse development, with $2.9 billion in NASA lunar-lander contracts still on the books.

1cfc3a82f8d443bfe037f0f97788c82edfbb3ace.headline: Jeep recalls 328,381 Grand Cherokees after rear coil springs can detach — letters ~Sept. 29
1cfc3a82f8d443bfe037f0f97788c82edfbb3ace.summary: FCA US recall 89D / NHTSA 26V-562 covers about 328,381 2021–2023 Grand Cherokee L, 2022–2023 Grand Cherokee, and 2022–2023 4xe models whose rear coil springs may sit out of position and detach after earlier recall repairs. Dealers will replace both rear lower spring isolators on every affected VIN; air-suspension trucks are excluded, and FCA estimates only ~0.1% may have the defect with no accidents reported. Interim owner letters are slated roughly Sept. 29 through Oct. 7 — check NHTSA or Mopar VIN tools if you drive a coil-spring WL.

8cc60ecdf903ad52c6ef5f3d13693933d7fe54b1.headline: Metallica and adidas drop Sphere ‘Life Burns Faster’ merch capsule ahead of Oct. 1 residency
8cc60ecdf903ad52c6ef5f3d13693933d7fe54b1.summary: Metallica and adidas announced a Trefoil-meets-band-graphic capsule for the Las Vegas Sphere “Life Burns Faster” residency, on sale Wednesday, Sept. 30 at the venue, a Vegas pop-up, metallica.com, and adidas.com. The 24-date Sphere run opens Thursday, Oct. 1 and stretches into March 2027, with adiCLUB/CONFIRMED giveaways for signed merch and select tickets. Fringe extras include a Black Box memorabilia experience, SiriusXM ‘Tallica Talk, a Drew Estate cigar collab, and — closer to home — two special Mohegan Sun Arena dates in Uncasville, Connecticut for the venue’s 25th anniversary.

d6e8ba900ffe42073aab2dab76b0b29f5cb820ec.headline: Insta360’s $298M memory-chip bill in six months now rivals GoPro’s entire cash sale price
d6e8ba900ffe42073aab2dab76b0b29f5cb820ec.summary: The Next Web’s Times Square opening debrief puts Insta360’s first-half “strategic” memory buy at nearly 2 billion yuan (~$298M) — roughly the same cash GoPro shareholders are taking in the Starman Optical deal — while half-year profit fell 94% even as revenue rose 50%. AI data-center demand is starving consumer DRAM; Insta360 stayed barely profitable and opened 1515 Broadway after shipping 10 million cameras, while DJI’s new U.S. product pipeline stays frozen on the FCC covered list. Europe (Munich or Amsterdam) is next on the store map if the memory crunch doesn’t swamp the growth.

1d9ea7488cb0e9c7bb1075ae22692e178d78c35b.headline: Westport: free flood cleanup and mold help for Sept. 13 storm homeowners
1d9ea7488cb0e9c7bb1075ae22692e178d78c35b.summary: Westport is pointing Sept. 13 flood victims to free Southern Baptist Disaster Relief help arranged through state emergency management and Connecticut VOAD — damage assessments, debris removal, cleanup, and mold mitigation. Homeowners should call 203-628-6978, leave name, phone, address, and a short needs note; the town also posted the resource on its storm-recovery page. The offer sits alongside ongoing Jesup Road bridge and EMS routing questions after the flash flood that drove roughly 130 emergency calls and multiple water rescues.

eb7faf9721538085f950e49f10d2dfdfba0b7406.headline: Penguins open Wednesday at Flyers on NHL on TNT — Gretzky studio from Philadelphia
eb7faf9721538085f950e49f10d2dfdfba0b7406.summary: TNT Sports’ Opening Week slate puts Sidney Crosby’s Penguins at Philadelphia on Wednesday, Sept. 30 at 7:30 p.m. ET — the Battle of Pennsylvania lead-in to a Kings–Avalanche nightcap — across TNT, truTV, and HBO Max. A 90-minute NHL on TNT Face Off from Stateside Live! beside the arena starts at 6 p.m. with Wayne Gretzky, Henrik Lundqvist, Paul Bissonnette, Anson Carter, and Liam McHugh. Kenny Albert, Eddie Olczyk, and Brian Boucher have the Penguins–Flyers call as Pittsburgh finishes Monday roster trimming ahead of the opener.

738165abeda05d00242ca9436a385b2bbee04801.headline: LEGO’s October wave lands Thursday: UCS Executor, Downton Abbey, PlayStation and GWPs
738165abeda05d00242ca9436a385b2bbee04801.summary: Stonewars’ Monday October roundup lists 24 sets, nine of them 18+, with most hitting LEGO.com on Oct. 1 — headlined by the 6,130-piece UCS Executor Super Star Destroyer ($799.99) and its Darth Vader lightsaber GWP, plus Ideas Downton Abbey, the buildable PlayStation with Astro Bot GWP, Bookshop Book Nook, and Wallace & Gromit. Marvel Avengers Doomsday sets wait until Oct. 4. Adult-fan density is the story of the wave: big display pieces first, seasonal Winter Village and Pokémon Trainer Moments filling out the rest of the cart.

f775f479609c7152732d72916d0f2934b7d6427a.headline: Trumbull Household Hazardous Waste Collection returns Saturday, Oct. 3 at Indian Ledge
f775f479609c7152732d72916d0f2934b7d6427a.summary: Trumbull, Monroe, and Easton residents can drop household hazardous waste Saturday, October 3, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at 307 Indian Ledge Park Drive next to the BMX facility — bring a Connecticut driver’s license. The town wants oil- and latex-based paints, solvents, pesticides (including restricted neonicotinoid products toxic to bees), pool chemicals, fluorescent bulbs, and mercury thermometers in original closed containers; do not mix chemicals. Asbestos, ammunition, medical sharps, propane tanks, and commercial waste are refused; tires, antifreeze, motor oil, and car batteries go instead to the TEaM Transfer Station on Spring Hill Road.

99c06c6ac398930d3d6b9a6bf94c2109ce484b5c.headline: Apple’s October slate: iPhone Duo, iOS 27.1/27.2, 512GB Mac Studio — and rumored iPad mini 8
99c06c6ac398930d3d6b9a6bf94c2109ce484b5c.summary: MacRumors maps a crowded Apple October: foldable iPhone Duo pre-orders Friday, Oct. 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific for an Oct. 23 launch; iOS 27.1 expected before Duo ships and iOS 27.2 later for five more Siri AI languages; plus the high-end Mac Studio with M5 Ultra and 512GB of RAM due late month. Rumored unveilings include an OLED iPad mini 8 with A20 Pro, refreshed HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K with Wi-Fi 7, M6 iMac and MacBook Pro options, and a new home hub that may run “homeOS.”

10d87d018ef8cbcd3578946c541552e10301ea55.headline: Trump airs taxpayer-funded ‘final battle’ TV ad ahead of Nov. 3 midterms
10d87d018ef8cbcd3578946c541552e10301ea55.summary: President Trump rolled another taxpayer-funded black-and-white TV spot during Sunday NFL games, warning of a “final battle” to demolish the deep state and cast out communists, Marxists, and fascists. The White House calls it an educational “public service announcement” because it does not urge a vote and Trump is not on the November ballot; Democrats and Public Citizen say it violates appropriations bans on propaganda and the Hatch Act. Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.) said no public official should spend public money on private ads for themselves.

c31f2c50456cc41466148f4ecf555cf91c99fa68.headline: Penguins lock 22-man opening roster — five on IR ahead of Wednesday at Flyers
c31f2c50456cc41466148f4ecf555cf91c99fa68.summary: General manager Kyle Dubas finalized Pittsburgh’s 2026-27 opening roster Monday: 13 forwards, seven defensemen, and goaltenders Sergei Murashov and Arturs Silovs — 22 players total for Wednesday’s 7:30 p.m. opener at Philadelphia. Justin Brazeau, Ben Kindel, Blake Lizotte, Bryan Rust, and Ryan Graves are on injured reserve; Tristan Broz, Melvin Fernstrom, Oliver Okuliar, and Gabriel D’Aigle are injured non-roster. Sixteen of the 22 dressed last season; newcomers include Gustafsson, Lapierre, Robertson, Carlile, Korczak, and van Riemsdyk.

8e7433f60dd821c4a7155fdb2e79936b908a3502.headline: Jets’ Breece Hall week-to-week after MRI brings better-than-feared quad news
8e7433f60dd821c4a7155fdb2e79936b908a3502.summary: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reported Monday that Jets running back Breece Hall is week-to-week with a quad injury after an MRI that delivered “good news” versus the longer timeline feared when he left Sunday’s Lions loss grabbing his outer thigh. He is not expected for Week 4 at Chicago, but may avoid injured reserve if New York thinks he can return inside four weeks. Braelon Allen figures to lead the backfield with Isaiah Davis also in the mix after mainly special-teams work.

56d325eb4fa6c1919139b2ce57eda39669d718df.headline: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2 get Auracast and LE Audio in beta firmware
56d325eb4fa6c1919139b2ce57eda39669d718df.summary: Firmware 10.12.12 for Bose’s $449 QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2 adds Bluetooth LE Audio and Auracast as beta features — the first Bose headphones to join the broadcast-audio club already used by some Sony, JBL, Samsung, and Sennheiser gear. Auracast lets a phone, TV, or venue transmitter stream to many headphones at once for gate announcements, lectures, or quiet late-night TV. The update also improves wired USB audio balance for gaming chat and web-conferencing compatibility; Bose says the non-Ultra QC Headphones Gen 2 should get the beta next.

58dc2e36c15fdd4ca1657e04ba3de9a91211d266.headline: Lenovo’s 15-inch Googlebook opens preorders at $1,149.99 — $150 under earlier hints
58dc2e36c15fdd4ca1657e04ba3de9a91211d266.summary: Preorders opened Monday for Lenovo’s largest first-wave Googlebook at $1,149.99, $150 below the $1,299 starting price that had circulated. The 15-inch Chromebook-class machine packs an Intel Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB of RAM, 512GB of storage, and an HDMI port, and The Verge says units ship from October 4. It is the biggest of the first five Googlebook models aimed at Google’s refreshed laptop push.

9ee492ff4dbcb01f92a9ca62c40c76fe8f0c80aa.headline: Every 2026 Harley Softail now ships with cornering ABS and a Milwaukee-Eight 117
9ee492ff4dbcb01f92a9ca62c40c76fe8f0c80aa.summary: Harley-Davidson’s full 2026 Softail line — Street Bob, Fat Boy, Heritage Classic, Breakout, Low Rider S, and Low Rider ST — now carries the Rider Safety Enhancements suite that once stayed on tourers and CVOs: lean-sensitive ABS, traction control, drag-torque slip control, TPMS, ride modes, cruise, USB-C, and LCD gauges. Every Softail also runs the Milwaukee-Eight 117 in Muscle, Torque, or Classic tunes (up to 114 hp / 128 lb-ft on the Low Rider S/ST). Retro-leaning Deadwood and Solo Trim packages keep the bar-hopper look while the electronics ride underneath.

2589ec316965c66c2f3132216ba56da7be7cc18f.headline: Great Smoky Mountains unseats Acadia as America’s top-ranked fall national park
2589ec316965c66c2f3132216ba56da7be7cc18f.summary: A Sudoku Bliss study cited by OutKick ranks Great Smoky Mountains National Park first for fall travel with a 94.7 score versus Acadia’s 86.6, using September–November NPS visits (2021–2025) plus Google review signals. The Smokies logged nearly 19 million fall visits across those years to Acadia’s roughly 6.5 million; Shenandoah, Rocky Mountain, and Grand Teton round out the top five. Peak color in the Smokies runs mid-October into early November at lower elevations, but October is the park’s busiest month — expect Cades Cove, Kuwohi, and Roaring Fork congestion and try Foothills Parkway or early/late windows.

bc5f81cf6744a8e7c62db06bace407f119e9dfc9.headline: Anthrax drops Cursum Perficio — first full album in a decade — amid Maiden tour
bc5f81cf6744a8e7c62db06bace407f119e9dfc9.summary: Anthrax released Cursum Perficio, the thrash veterans’ first studio album in ten years, with 11 tracks spanning political thrash (“It’s For the Kids”), blastbeat-leaning metal (“The Edge of Perfection”), and AOR-tinged hard rock (“Everybody’s Got a Plan”), plus a title-track video starring London May. Charlie Benante has said it is not necessarily the final record; Scott Ian is less sure. The band is on Iron Maiden’s Run For Your Lives North American dates with Megadeth as the run winds down.

5b1c6d048c7b8049c50ad12b9d858caba4b84b6b.headline: Trumbull High ranks 23rd among Connecticut public high schools in Niche 2027 list
5b1c6d048c7b8049c50ad12b9d858caba4b84b6b.summary: Niche’s 2027 Best Schools rankings put Trumbull High School 23rd among Connecticut’s top 100 public high schools, drawing on federal and state data, school stats, and more than 3 million reviews nationwide. The firm also separated public and private lists for arts, diversity, college prep, and teachers this year. Connecticut private schools Choate Rosemary Hall and The Hotchkiss School landed No. 5 and No. 9 on Niche’s national private high school list.

7990e184ba1e716bb908e0cd961128f87e05d578.headline: LEGO Dragon Ball leak: 1,764-piece Shenron & Goku Icons set eyed for Nov. 1 at ~$180
7990e184ba1e716bb908e0cd961128f87e05d578.summary: Leaked images shared Monday by Brick Tap appear to show LEGO Icons 11390 Shenron and Goku — Dragon Ball’s first official set — with the wish-granting dragon coiled above all seven Dragon Balls and young Goku on the Flying Nimbus. Reports peg a November 1 shelf date, about 1,764 pieces, and roughly $180, revising earlier $199.99 / 1,760-piece tip sheets. Fans still treat the specs as provisional until LEGO unveils; separate chatter still points to a broader Dragon Ball Z theme in 2027.

b40950e4b0561d082dec0e82babdc236e4d3f854.headline: Trump unveils $15B Mesabi Metallics Iowa steel mill — billed as America’s largest
b40950e4b0561d082dec0e82babdc236e4d3f854.summary: President Trump on Monday announced a roughly $15 billion Mesabi Metallics integrated steel plant in Iowa that the White House calls the largest ever built in the United States, with about 1,750 permanent jobs and 5,000–6,000 construction jobs in the first phase. The mill is slated to make 7.5 million tons a year initially and up to 10 million using iron ore from Mesabi’s Minnesota mine — first steel not expected until 2030. Officials cast it as a tariff-backed, defense-grade domestic supply chain win ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms.

e921116189fc41eab2aa130ae638f9db57f3d0c1.headline: Dubas: Penguins are mid-pack — Rust week-to-week, Lizotte could dress Wednesday
e921116189fc41eab2aa130ae638f9db57f3d0c1.summary: After locking the 22-man opener roster, GM Kyle Dubas said Pittsburgh still sits in the Metro’s middle of the pack and must close the gap on Cup-champion Carolina with younger help around Crosby, Malkin, and Letang. Injury notes: Bryan Rust is week-to-week (upper body), Blake Lizotte’s IR is retroactive to Sept. 19 so he could be available for Wednesday at the Flyers, and Ryan Graves’ dual-knee issues leave him indefinite. Dubas also said Crosby extension talks are open-ended and that Andrei Kuzmenko remains non-roster after his father’s funeral.

2cc2e8fb9d75cabd9a406733ad053824c0dff29f.headline: Jets takeaways: Glenn praises fourth-quarter fight; Demario Davis leads No. 2 defense
2cc2e8fb9d75cabd9a406733ad053824c0dff29f.summary: After Sunday’s 31–24 road loss in Detroit left the Jets 1–2, coach Aaron Glenn said he won’t take moral victories but liked the late fight — two fourth-quarter TD drives and a fourth-down stop before Geno Smith and Garrett Wilson briefly tied it at 24. Wilson finished with 7 catches for 107 yards and a score; Demario Davis led the defense with 10 tackles and a sack as New York ranks No. 2 in total defense. Rookie CB D’Angelo Ponds made his NFL debut (4 snaps) after a calf rehab, with Chicago next on the road in Week 4.

d064bb0e7bc4cc8cd7b7f9332e054a8d66840439.headline: Tesla pushes Roadster hover demo from Oct. 1 to Oct. 15 over Texas weather
d064bb0e7bc4cc8cd7b7f9332e054a8d66840439.summary: Tesla officially moved its next-gen Roadster outdoor demo from October 1 to October 15, citing severe central Texas weather for an event that can only be held outdoors at SpaceX’s McGregor rocket test site. The plan still centers on a remotely operated cold-gas thruster “hover” with spectators kept hundreds of yards back. Forecasts show heavy rain and thunderstorms Thursday then clearing by the weekend; Electrek notes the two-week slip continues a long delay chain, with production still guided for 2027 or 2028.

71fb752cf44efc38ca387ab7aecd8621015573a4.headline: Honor Magic 9 Pro Max debuts in China with Arri cinema tools and 8,800mAh battery
71fb752cf44efc38ca387ab7aecd8621015573a4.summary: Honor’s Magic 9 Pro Max launched in China Monday with an Arri-inspired three-lens turret camera island, Arri LogC3 recording, 14 Arri Look LUTs, and a 200MP main plus 200MP 3.5x telephoto. A huge 8,800mAh silicon-rich battery sits behind Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 silicon, and the phone supports Honor’s G200/G500 teleconverters plus a SmallRig video kit. An international launch is confirmed but undated.

6efa9ff647e8a9a5907f4e4625da964f20834f2d.headline: watchOS 27.0.1 expands beyond Series 12 and Ultra 4 to all eligible Apple Watches
6efa9ff647e8a9a5907f4e4625da964f20834f2d.summary: Apple on Monday released watchOS 27.0.1 for every eligible Apple Watch — Series 9 and later, Ultra 2 and later, and SE 3 — after last week’s build targeted only Series 12 and Ultra 4 for unexpected restart bugs. Release notes only say the update “provides bug fixes,” with no listed security patches, so it is unclear what older models gain. Owners still hope it also steadies indoor/outdoor run distance tracking that has been erratic since watchOS 27 shipped September 14.
