c477a10ff9a869fcf115c19540a555fb535c4023.headline: Acadia fall 2026: peak color forecast Oct. 12–15 lands as free bus and ships exit
c477a10ff9a869fcf115c19540a555fb535c4023.summary: A Sept. 28 foliage model puts Acadia peak color around October 13 (aim Oct. 12–15), the same stretch when the Island Explorer free bus ends (operator date Oct. 12), Seawall and Schoodic Woods close, and Bar Harbor’s last two big cruise ships call. Cadillac Mountain still needs a $6 vehicle reservation through Oct. 25; Blackwoods camps through Oct. 18 and Jordan Pond House through Oct. 26. Part of Beech Mountain Loop Trail has been closed for repairs since Sept. 21, with three alternate summit routes still open.

64d05223dda34afe510ac1ac693aac2f7e7ddbe0.headline: Canon EOS R6 V firmware 1.1.0 unlocks external flash, BR-E2 remote, and movie grids
64d05223dda34afe510ac1ac693aac2f7e7ddbe0.summary: Canon’s EOS R6 V firmware 1.1.0 finally delivers external-flash firing with E-TTL II controls, Wireless Remote Controller BR-E2 support, and a composition grid that stays visible while recording — plus EDSDK/CCAPI hooks and fixes for interval timer, smartphone USB, and Slow & Fast Motion Digital IS metadata. Flash still syncs only at 1/60 second on the electronic shutter, so the update helps controlled hybrid stills more than sunlit action. Owners should verify the exact regional package and retest flash, remote, and cards before paid work.

c77c77052f1a20fd8b986e5bedadfca7a27408c1.headline: Trumbull hazmat scare: 1940s fridge leaks sulfur dioxide during home removal
c77c77052f1a20fd8b986e5bedadfca7a27408c1.summary: Long Hill Volunteer Fire Company was called about 11:30 a.m. Monday for an unknown leak; crews found a homeowner had cut the refrigerant line while dismantling a 1940s-era refrigerator, releasing sulfur dioxide. Initial entry teams backed out after elevated meter readings, then worked with CT DEEP and the Fairfield County Hazardous Incident Response Team to mitigate the leak and ventilate the home. Crews operated about three hours; no injuries were reported.

c0a1b465934a2be9174ddf54e5c149051622db99.headline: Hands-on: LEGO PlayStation (72306) is a 1:1, 1,911-piece PS1 with Gran Turismo dioramas
c0a1b465934a2be9174ddf54e5c149051622db99.summary: GameRant’s early build of LEGO set 72306 PlayStation calls it one of the brand’s strongest video-game sets: a roughly 1:1 scale PS1 with an attachable controller, working power and disc-tray buttons, and about 1,911 pieces for $179.99 on Oct. 1. Hidden slide-in dioramas nod to Gran Turismo and Ape Escape, and a classic PlayStation logo sits under the covers. Reviewer notes miss functional D-pad buttons on the mini controller but still ranks it high for display and play value.

6c680f1b99d32c9a54c154a4ba0f577326bdff73.headline: Iran’s Araghchi meets Qatari mediators as U.S. ties any deal to nuclear steps
6c680f1b99d32c9a54c154a4ba0f577326bdff73.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators in New York Monday on a Hormuz reopen plan and said he hoped for Washington’s reply by Tuesday, after President Trump rejected Tehran’s earlier seven-day proposal as “unacceptable.” A U.S. official told Al Jazeera talks were “positive and constructive” but that there will be no end-of-war deal unless Iran’s nuclear program is addressed, with sanctions relief and frozen funds tied to nuclear timing. Trump told reporters the U.S. will “win” and that gas prices will fall once the war ends.

078b34392fad60f26f12dd5a6ffb600d99826b82.headline: Crosby and Penguins: no pressure to ink extension before Flyers opener
078b34392fad60f26f12dd5a6ffb600d99826b82.summary: GM Kyle Dubas said Monday the Penguins are comfortable opening the season without a new deal for Sidney Crosby, who enters the final year of a two-year, $17.4 million contract. Crosby (39) said he wants to focus on playing while agent Pat Brisson and the club keep talking; Dubas framed late-career extensions as season-long comfort checks, not hard deadlines. Evgeni Malkin (one-year deal) and Erik Karlsson (final year of his Sharks-era contract) are in similar open-ended situations as Pittsburgh opens Wednesday at the Flyers.

1045bfde4478f71e0e4290a8393d8ea22cf18046.headline: Jets must fix the run without Hall — Allen and Davis up vs. Bears
1045bfde4478f71e0e4290a8393d8ea22cf18046.summary: With Breece Hall week-to-week after a quad injury and left guard Dylan Parham also banged up, Aaron Glenn said Monday the Jets will lean on Braelon Allen and Isaiah Davis in Chicago while refusing to blame injuries for a sputtering ground game. New York ranks 26th in rush yards and 30th in yards per carry after just 58 yards against Detroit; Glenn called the run “one area we have to fix.” Geno Smith is tied for third in sacks allowed (nine), and new DE Joseph Ossai saw a quiet debut after missing most of camp.

a2f161f271b0de17fb61cf94cfb42dd513be659c.headline: iPhone Duo StandBy leak: five unannounced faces including Snoopy and Home Camera
a2f161f271b0de17fb61cf94cfb42dd513be659c.summary: Leaker pdfu dug into iOS 27.1 simulator strings for the iPhone Duo’s always-on StandBy mode and surfaced five faces Apple hasn’t shown: Home Camera (up to nine feeds), Home Modular, Flow, Fade, and a Snoopy-themed face. A face editor and five widget layouts (StandBy, Stacked, Top, Middle, Bottom) also appear tied to an internal “Rushmore” app. Duo pre-orders still start Oct. 16 ahead of the Oct. 23 launch.

34d1cf399da52dfc941a21f109cd08a7687dfe44.headline: Apple patches Meta-reported CoreGraphics zero-day used in ‘extremely sophisticated’ attacks
34d1cf399da52dfc941a21f109cd08a7687dfe44.summary: Apple on Monday shipped fixes for CVE-2026-86950, an out-of-bounds write in CoreGraphics that can run code via a crafted file and may have been exploited in highly targeted attacks on iOS before iOS 27. Meta’s product security team reported the bug; patches land in iOS/iPadOS 26.7.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 / Sequoia 15.8.1, while current iOS 27 / macOS 27 lines appear unaffected. Delivery path is unclear — web, email, or messaging previews are all possible for a graphics/PDF parser flaw.

c59b4c957d8335c910b3c326765c298d51df912f.headline: Massachusetts DCR relaunches 2026 interactive fall foliage map for state parks
c59b4c957d8335c910b3c326765c298d51df912f.summary: Massachusetts DCR on Monday brought back its interactive fall foliage map so travelers can track color change at state properties by geography, date, or park, with staff photos of current conditions. Governor Healey and Lt. Gov. Driscoll pitched it as a planning tool from the Berkshires to the North Shore; DCR says mid-October is the statewide peak window, with Western Massachusetts coloring first. The map blends forestry history with current weather and will be updated on social channels through the season.

af2072d7de8468dc61a2e1c8de4dd7cccbc6ae62.headline: Slipknot books 2027 (sic)est Stadium Tour — Wembley to Citi Field; artist presale today
af2072d7de8468dc61a2e1c8de4dd7cccbc6ae62.summary: Slipknot unveiled a Live Nation stadium run for summer 2027, opening July 3 at London’s Wembley then hitting Nationals Park, Citi Field, Soldier Field, Fenway, SoFi, Golden Gate Park, and a South America leg. Bring Me The Horizon supports all North American dates with rotating guests (Lamb of God, Lorna Shore, Polyphia, and others); Marilyn Manson and Hatebreed join select international shows. Artist presale starts Tuesday Sept. 29 at 10 a.m. local, Knotfest at noon, public on-sale Oct. 2 — plus Monday launch pop-ups at Wembley and SoFi.

8467bcb8daa7923e2b79a8422bae19750c832e9c.headline: Canon ships EOS R1 and R5 Mark II firmware 1.3.2 — Dual Pixel RAW restart fix
8467bcb8daa7923e2b79a8422bae19750c832e9c.summary: Canon posted firmware 1.3.2 for the EOS R1 and EOS R5 Mark II with shared fixes for Multi Remote live-view delay and linked-shooting failures when the sender is on FTP, plus general stability work. The R5 Mark II build also stops unwanted restarts when Dual Pixel RAW is enabled — a pain point for high-res stills shooters. Downloads are live for macOS and Windows on Canon’s support sites.

df61c91e7ff84cbc3235500381cf2e052be161bf.headline: State Department weighs sharing passport records to verify voter citizenship
df61c91e7ff84cbc3235500381cf2e052be161bf.summary: The State Department is assessing how to let state and local officials — and some nonprofits — check federal passport records to confirm registered voters are U.S. citizens ahead of the November midterms. A department spokesperson said the goal is sharing that protects Americans’ data, deters fraud, and supports citizenship integrity; DOJ disclosed the plan in a court filing last week. The Privacy Act notice could land in the Federal Register as early as Oct. 22, days after the Supreme Court allowed DHS to share citizenship data for voter checks.

07d7ab6ee56916384287d096cece20e35dbfe507.headline: iPhone Duo assembly yield stuck near 60% — early stock may stay tight
07d7ab6ee56916384287d096cece20e35dbfe507.summary: A supply-chain source told China’s Jiemian News that Foxconn’s final-assembly yields for Apple’s first foldable were only slightly above 60% as of Sept. 17, and that mature yields could take another six months to a year under current quality bars. Samsung Display foldable OLED panels and hinge parts have also seen low yields and redesigns; Apple’s 2026 global stocking target is pegged around six to eight million units. Pre-orders still open Oct. 16 for the Oct. 23 launch starting at $1,999.

860811d981c98d8b650b5404fbde4981e9f78a47.headline: LEGO October 2026 buying guide: PlayStation, Executor GWPs, and Insiders early access
860811d981c98d8b650b5404fbde4981e9f78a47.summary: Jay’s Brick Blog’s Sept. 29 shopping guide walks every major Oct. 1 drop — PlayStation 72306, UCS Executor, Downton Abbey, Wallace & Gromit, Holiday House, Pokémon Trainer Moments, and the Avengers: Doomsday wave — plus Gift-with-Purchase windows. Astro Bot 40899 is expected with qualifying Oct. 1 carts, and Executor buyers from Oct. 1–10 get Darth Vader’s Lightsaber 40897 while stocks last. Insiders early access still unlocks several big sets on the 1st before general release.

c672495346719d9abaf140b694720cfa4d5424e1.headline: Penguins open Wednesday at Flyers in a Keystone playoff rematch
c672495346719d9abaf140b694720cfa4d5424e1.summary: Nearly five months after Philadelphia beat Pittsburgh in a six-game first-round series, the rivals open the 2026-27 season Wednesday for the first time since 2021. Crosby said last year’s playoff run raised expectations and the challenge is to elevate again; Arturs Silovs is expected to start with Sergei Murashov as backup. Coach Dan Muse said Bryan Rust’s absence after a strong camp is unfortunate but day-to-day, with nothing set in stone in net.

ee90a2c4a1ecdc4a12c1e10a9cb3fea18b36cb99.headline: Jets catch a break: Caleb Williams likely out for Week 4 at Chicago
ee90a2c4a1ecdc4a12c1e10a9cb3fea18b36cb99.summary: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports Bears QB Caleb Williams is on a typical three-to-four-week timeline for a Grade 2 hamstring strain suffered in Week 2, making him unlikely to face the Jets at Soldier Field. That would leave Tyson Bagent (if clear of concussion protocol) or Case Keenum under center for Chicago. New York is 1-2 after losses to Green Bay and Detroit and still sorting its own Hall and Parham injuries heading into the NFC North gauntlet.

f6c8d3df2976f63d055c035bd6be55300008a2c5.headline: Trump denies offering to sell U.S. arms to China’s Xi
f6c8d3df2976f63d055c035bd6be55300008a2c5.summary: President Trump on Monday denied asking Xi Jinping whether China wanted to buy American weapons, contradicting U.S. Ambassador to China David Perdue’s Sunday Fox News claim that Trump made the extraordinary offer. “I’ve never heard of that one, I’m going to have to ask him,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office when asked about Perdue’s comments. The denial lands days after the White House hosted Xi for a high-profile Washington visit.

98d61246b39e599c884e088f19a4248a277fac27.headline: Meta’s Muse AI agent is coming to smart glasses — ‘Hey Muse’ for on-device tasks
98d61246b39e599c884e088f19a4248a277fac27.summary: Meta says its Muse AI agent — already topping iPhone App Store charts after a U.S. phone and web launch — will arrive on Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses in the coming weeks or months. Wearers can say “Hey Muse” to book appointments, check flights, log meals, or buy products they see while the agent works in a cloud Linux VM and pings back when done. Payments use Stripe Link single-use cards; Meta says Muse data isn’t used for ads, with an optional Confidential VM later this year.

6ce797f897224a175a7af27c7ca7b9c97ad72f76.headline: Apple ships macOS Golden Gate 27.0.1 — first bug-fix drop for the new Mac OS
6ce797f897224a175a7af27c7ca7b9c97ad72f76.summary: Apple released macOS 27.0.1 on Monday, the first maintenance update to Golden Gate since the mid-September launch, available via System Settings → Software Update. Official notes only say it “fixes unspecified bugs”; companion security updates also shipped for macOS 26.7.1 and 15.8.1. Enterprise docs have pointed to a Platform SSO lock-screen credential glitch among the fixes, while public release notes stay sparse.

be247d648e8cdad865ecddcaa46e2df3a275dfe2.headline: Clemson ecologist: delayed Blue Ridge color could mean a more vibrant fall
be247d648e8cdad865ecddcaa46e2df3a275dfe2.summary: Warm September weather has kept much of the Southeast green later than usual, but Clemson University ecologist Don Hagan says forests that still hold full canopies could put on a richer red-orange-yellow show if storms stay mild. Peak color usually rolls from Blue Ridge high country into foothills from late September through early November. The Blue Ridge Parkway Association tips mid-to-late October drives that change elevation — Caesars Head, Jocassee Gorges, and long Parkway stretches — to catch sections near peak.

47d2592bba01ae3e51de6c5bf073312563dbd54a.headline: UK family courts: ‘alienating behaviour’ is a fact to prove — not a syndrome
47d2592bba01ae3e51de6c5bf073312563dbd54a.summary: A September 2026 England-and-Wales guide walks how courts now treat parental alienation after Family Justice Council guidance and the landmark Re Y ruling. Judges reject ‘parental alienation syndrome’ as unscientific, require domestic-abuse allegations to be tried before assessing alienating behaviour, and will only instruct HCPC-registered or BPS-chartered psychologists. Transfer of residence remains a welfare decision, not an automatic sanction when alienating behaviour is found.

a0ba7e76c5c0410c9dba8d81ec77a300ab41bb73.headline: Trump unveils America.gov as AI-powered hub for passports, Medicare, and more
a0ba7e76c5c0410c9dba8d81ec77a300ab41bb73.summary: President Trump signed an executive order Tuesday launching America.gov, an AI chatbot that searches tens of thousands of federal pages so citizens can ask how to renew a passport, pick a Medicare plan, or chase veterans benefits in one place. U.S. Chief Design Officer Joe Gebbia said forms and status tracking should arrive by 2027, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio said first-passport applications will move onto the site then — including user-uploaded photos instead of drugstore shots. Trump framed it as treating people’s time as if it matters, comparing the interface to Grok, Gemini, or ChatGPT.

143111e456f458da7913f737771dc4c77e8d37ad.headline: ICE confusion ignites MAGA backlash after pullback guidance on non-criminal arrests
143111e456f458da7913f737771dc4c77e8d37ad.summary: Reported verbal guidance telling some ICE offices to ease off arrests of illegal immigrants without criminal records sparked a sharp MAGA backlash before the administration walked it back within hours. Trump told Fox there was no change to a “worst first” posture that still leaves no one off the table, while Mass Deportation Coalition’s Mike Howell said mixed DHS messaging — including a Mullin tweet about skipping Kansas worksite ops — would have drawn impeachment calls under a Democrat. CIS’s Mark Krikorian urged the White House to get interior and worksite enforcement signals straight ahead of the midterms.

18013a78f0349a8bca6fe4c97c37a8e3c93f7a51.headline: CNN, Politico, and MS NOW ask court to keep blocking Trump’s White House press ban
18013a78f0349a8bca6fe4c97c37a8e3c93f7a51.summary: CNN, Politico, and MS NOW asked a federal judge for a preliminary injunction extending White House access beyond an Oct. 8 temporary restraining order, arguing the administration has unpredictably reimposed elements of the Sept. 19 ban — including barring CNN from Air Force One and pool duties. Attorney Theodore Boutrous called the ban viewpoint retaliation; AG Todd Blanche insisted access is a privilege and defended keeping CNN off the president’s plane. Judge Timothy Kelly has already signaled due-process skepticism of the sudden ouster.

86c01aa548e7fbc5f635c80d56b33552eee8bdee.headline: Trump says he’ll rebrand AI as ‘super intelligence’ in all U.S. government documents
86c01aa548e7fbc5f635c80d56b33552eee8bdee.summary: At the America.gov launch Tuesday, President Trump said he would sign an executive order making “super intelligence,” or SI, the official U.S. government name for artificial intelligence — arguing “artificial” undersells the technology. After lunch with Zuckerberg, Jensen Huang, and Elon Musk, he again pushed industry self-regulation and dismissed existential-risk warnings from Anthropic and OpenAI as a “hoax,” saying he will not stifle growth he compares to the industrial revolution.

c7f2d519fcce606a50ae460bc8687674688a4c97.headline: America.gov chatbot runs on Google Gemini and Elon Musk’s Grok, Gebbia says
c7f2d519fcce606a50ae460bc8687674688a4c97.summary: U.S. Chief Design Officer Joe Gebbia told CNBC that the new America.gov chatbot is powered behind the scenes by Google’s Gemini and Elon Musk’s Grok. Google published a partner note saying Gemini will help more than 100 million people reach public resources faster; SpaceXAI/xAI did not comment. Gebbia said the tool scans roughly 29,000 government sites so answers stay tied to official sources rather than stale third-party pages — a notable Grok footprint inside a Trump digital-front-door project.

beb77845d468dcdaad2eba5bdefb968001de5423.headline: Apple targeting 6–8 million iPhone Duo units for 2026 as yields hover near 60%
beb77845d468dcdaad2eba5bdefb968001de5423.summary: Jiemian News supply-chain sourcing, relayed by 9to5Mac, says Apple’s 2026 stocking target for the foldable iPhone Duo is about 6–8 million units — far below the 20–30 million typical for a Pro/Pro Max cycle — while Foxconn final-assembly yields sit just over 60%. Suppliers think mature yields could take another six months or more, and Apple so far will not loosen quality bars that keep early output tight ahead of Oct. 16 pre-orders and the $1,999 starting price.

e9803735de39311e8fcac3286c992e71cecb89a2.headline: Rare clearance: medium black Apple Watch Ultra 3 configs fall up to ~$200
e9803735de39311e8fcac3286c992e71cecb89a2.summary: With Ultra 4 shipping, Amazon is clearing prior-gen black Apple Watch Ultra 3 kits — including hard-to-find medium sizes — with the Milanese Loop large config near $200 off its $899 list and medium Alpine/Milanese and small Trail options around $100 off. Ultra 4 GPS+Cellular 49mm also shows light launch discounts near $780. Useful for readers who want Ultra toughness without paying new-gen sticker.

5fe164408a45ce98cf79ab4562d9d147345abe61.headline: Grok 4.7 goes live on Amazon Bedrock with 500K context and four reasoning tiers
5fe164408a45ce98cf79ab4562d9d147345abe61.summary: AWS added xAI’s Grok 4.7 to Amazon Bedrock with a 500K-token context window, text/image input, and low/medium/high/xhigh reasoning-effort profiles. Artificial Analysis figures cited by AWS show gains versus Grok 4.6 on Intelligence and Coding Agent indexes, with average output tokens per task roughly doubling to ~81K — pitched for long-running coding agents and knowledge work without leaving the Bedrock control plane.

ddb40ae36228060948fe0ed0cc8c511f7cc8ba84.headline: SpaceXAI launches Team Bots — shared Grok teammates with plugins and memory
ddb40ae36228060948fe0ed0cc8c511f7cc8ba84.summary: SpaceXAI opened a public beta of Team Bots for Teams and Enterprise plans: role-based shared Grok agents that combine shared context, plugins (Salesforce, Notion, GitHub), credentials, and memories while keeping each employee’s private chat separate. Internal engineering bots wired to Notion, Linear, Datadog, and Cursor allegedly helped a five-person team ship 100+ PRs a day; bots can also sit in Slack. Pre-built sales, PM, marketing, and data templates ship with the beta.

7c8e6db16e09e14f861d50e96a7e65830e0feeef.headline: Five Finger Death Punch lands 18th Mainstream Rock No. 1 with “Eye Of The Storm”
7c8e6db16e09e14f861d50e96a7e65830e0feeef.summary: Five Finger Death Punch’s “Eye Of The Storm,” the lead single from Legacy, hit No. 1 on Billboard’s Mainstream Rock Airplay chart — the band’s 18th chart-topper and an extension of their record consecutive-No.-1 streak. Fresh RIAA metal includes Gold for “Welcome to the Circus” and “Darkness Settles In,” Platinum for “Jekyll and Hyde” and “Wash It All Away,” and double Platinum for “A Little Bit Off,” as the 20th Anniversary World Tour rolls toward an early-2027 UK/EU leg with Lamb of God.

8736b3b24007f0ea613b1cb4f75e468ad8671fe3.headline: Jets notebook: Geno Smith under pressure sparks confidence; run game still to fix
8736b3b24007f0ea613b1cb4f75e468ad8671fe3.summary: After a 31–24 loss in Detroit, Aaron Glenn said Geno Smith’s poise under pressure — 11-of-12 for 147 yards when pressured, 321 yards and 3 TDs overall — gives the offense something to build on heading to Chicago. Glenn framed Week 4 as a “race to improve,” especially the run game that has stalled since the Titans opener, while Breece Hall (thigh) and Dylan Parham (knee) await Wednesday injury updates; Jordan Meredith already slid in at guard.

2481e817d67b9f77522ae265dd02984ea790d39e.headline: Dubas: Bryan Rust to IR, Lizotte’s Tuesday skate may decide opener status
2481e817d67b9f77522ae265dd02984ea790d39e.summary: In his start-of-season presser, Penguins GM Kyle Dubas said Bryan Rust is headed to IR week-to-week with an upper-body injury, Ryan Graves remains out indefinitely after knee work, and Blake Lizotte’s big Tuesday practice will decide Wednesday’s Flyers opener availability. Dubas called 2026-27 “pivotal” for closing a 15-point Metro gap on Carolina, kept Crosby talks as an open back-and-forth, shut down Malkin extension chatter, and said Murashov effectively won the crease last spring in the AHL.

b0e5903b833df15493639ebd21cc08abc96fd8e5.headline: Missouri man pleads guilty to shooting and torching Tesla Cybertruck at KC dealership
b0e5903b833df15493639ebd21cc08abc96fd8e5.summary: Kevin Harkins, 28, of Barnhart, Missouri, pleaded guilty in federal court to malicious destruction of property by arson and possessing an unregistered destructive device after a Feb. 13, 2025 attack on the Kansas City Tesla Center. Court papers say a Cybertruck was shot about nine times and set on fire, a Model Y took seven hood hits, and an unbroken Molotov cocktail was recovered; the burned Cybertruck had an $81,985 sale price. He faces a five-year mandatory minimum on the arson count.

972b1aa07db270951c6cab89e6994e8f8beec22c.headline: 34 video-game LEGO sets retiring Dec. 31 — Mario, Sonic, Minecraft, Horizon, Fortnite
972b1aa07db270951c6cab89e6994e8f8beec22c.summary: Brick Fanatics’ year-end retirement wave, tallied by VGC, includes 34 video-game LEGO sets spanning Super Mario, Animal Crossing, Fortnite, Horizon, Sonic, and a long Minecraft list, plus the exclusive Arcade Machine (40805). Once stock sells through after Dec. 31, LEGO stops production and secondary-market prices usually jump — a last clean window for collectors before the PlayStation and other October arrivals dominate shelves.

529e27a0e2b216c18873f0831eb41b91d440dd63.headline: Trump and AI chiefs sign ‘morally binding’ super-intelligence safety accord
529e27a0e2b216c18873f0831eb41b91d440dd63.summary: After a White House lunch with Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, Dario Amodei, Jensen Huang, Greg Brockman, Sundar Pichai and others, President Trump said the group signed a voluntary “super intelligence” accord he called “almost like a constitution” and “morally binding.” Speaker Mike Johnson cast it as a joint commitment to robust internal controls; the one-page text Trump posted commits firms to four layers of audits plus regular safety talks, and Trump said he will name an AI czar within days. Critics such as Sen. Mark Warner still want Congress to mandate testing rather than industry self-policing.

d1f5e994eebe3d275b16c7310446bd7604bd85f9.headline: Trump to tout manufacturing boom at surprise Peterbilt stop in Denton, Texas
d1f5e994eebe3d275b16c7310446bd7604bd85f9.summary: FOX Business reports President Trump will make a surprise Thursday stop at Peterbilt’s Denton, Texas factory to sell tariffs, deregulation, and an America First manufacturing pitch ahead of the midterms. The White House credits heavy-truck tariffs with Paccar adding more than 1,000 Denton jobs and 2,000 U.S. jobs; UAW’s Shawn Fain congratulated Trump for delivering for heavy-truck workers. Trump argues pledged investment will reverse manufacturing losses even as BLS still shows a net manufacturing job decline since January 2025.

60c0d0080f736db6ec2269d894b9d721bea9ef85.headline: Supreme Court lets Trump keep third-country deportations running for now
60c0d0080f736db6ec2269d894b9d721bea9ef85.summary: The Supreme Court on Tuesday allowed the Trump administration to keep deporting people to countries other than their own while it weighs whether migrants must get a meaningful chance to object first. The order pauses an appeals-court block that federal lawyers said had already forced cancellation of a flight carrying about 70 people; justices previously let such flights continue last year. Under often-secret deals, the administration says it has sent some 25,000 people to more than two dozen countries — most to Mexico — when home countries will not take them back.

98fd308a3a5160654222d799c9d3a62e2c058d7b.headline: DOJ charges Venezuelan illegal alien shot by ICE after Austin chase
98fd308a3a5160654222d799c9d3a62e2c058d7b.summary: U.S. Attorney Justin Simmons announced that Wilber Rafael Garces-Perez, 28, a Venezuelan illegal alien under a final removal order, made his initial federal appearance Tuesday on one count of assaulting and resisting a federal officer — facing up to 20 years if convicted. The complaint says he ignored park-and-exit orders during a Sept. 20 ICE traffic stop, struck an officer with his side-view mirror while fleeing, led a high-speed chase, then allegedly tried to hit an officer again, prompting the shooting. A detention hearing is set for Oct. 2 under Operation Take Back America.

01f67d43f534c818755714d20fdb343558e46b98.headline: Jewish groups say Mamdani’s antisemitism plan ducks anti-Israel rhetoric
01f67d43f534c818755714d20fdb343558e46b98.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s long-awaited antisemitism strategy pledges $1M for synagogue security and $6.4M for Partners Against the Hate grants, plus Holocaust education and Jewish culture spending — but major Jewish groups including UJA-Federation, AJC NY, and the NY Board of Rabbis say it fails to confront anti-Israel rhetoric they argue fuels attacks. The plan refuses a single antisemitism definition after Mamdani revoked Adams’ IHRA order; ADL and Rabbi Rick Jacobs called that omission serious while Bend the Arc and Brad Lander praised the funding track.

d04accb88b5451be79e133656265198c7543dcc5.headline: Trumbull volleyball stays perfect 4–0 with 3–0 sweep of Ridgefield
d04accb88b5451be79e133656265198c7543dcc5.summary: Trumbull’s volleyball Eagles kept an undefeated season alive Monday with a decisive 3–0 win at Ridgefield (25-12, 25-19, 25-7), extending their streak over the Tigers to six straight and lifting Trumbull to 4–0. Ridgefield fell to 2–5 and has now lost seven straight at home dating to last season. Trumbull hits the road again Wednesday at Stamford at 4 p.m.; the full match is available on the NFHS Network.

4d310a5fd27f4eed382a6a21ed1971c80b6792ec.headline: Falcon Rep brings Mamet’s A Life in the Theatre to Trumbull Library Oct. 15–17
4d310a5fd27f4eed382a6a21ed1971c80b6792ec.summary: Trumbull-founded Falcon Repertory Company will stage a free concert reading of David Mamet’s A Life in the Theatre at the Trumbull Library Community Room on Thursday, Oct. 15 at 6 p.m. and Saturday, Oct. 17 at 2 p.m. Frank S. Petrilli directs Equity actors Raymond Gerard Michaud and Jeffrey F. Wright in the bittersweet two-hander about a veteran and a rookie backstage — a show the trio has already done in New Canaan and at Trumbull’s Pinebrook Theater. Admission is free; suggested for adults at 33 Quality Street.

491ac536b8728b2c0d5471d0e85b99d74b8a3669.headline: iPhone Duo ‘Get Ready’ opens Oct. 12 ahead of scarce Oct. 16 pre-orders
491ac536b8728b2c0d5471d0e85b99d74b8a3669.summary: Apple’s iPhone Duo product page now shows a Get Ready window starting Monday, Oct. 12 — letting buyers lock color, capacity, carrier, AppleCare+, trade-in, payment, and shipping so pre-orders can fire with one tap when they open Friday, Oct. 16 at 8 a.m. ET. With yields stuck near 60% and early stock expected to be tight, MacRumors notes Get Ready could matter more than usual before the $1,999 foldable launches Oct. 23.

e2713ff61dd45712069b9920dff88fea867c6eb8.headline: Amazon expands first Ultra 4 cash discounts — select models at $779.99
e2713ff61dd45712069b9920dff88fea867c6eb8.summary: Amazon widened its first cash discounts on brand-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 to three configs at $779.99 — $19 off the $799 list — including Natural Sand Trail Loop (M/L), Black Ocean Band, and Black Burgundy Trail Loop (M/L). Series 12 GPS also sees light $9 markdowns (42mm $389.99 / 46mm $439.99). Useful for readers who want new-gen Ultra toughness without waiting for deeper clearance.

4ee9f296534caae9371b7bc9cc9a13b1c5791981.headline: Tesla doubles Austin Cybercab Robotaxi fleet to about 125 units
4ee9f296534caae9371b7bc9cc9a13b1c5791981.summary: Tesla’s Robotaxi app notified Austin riders that the Cybercab fleet has doubled, with Teslarati tracking availability from about 58 units early last week to roughly 125 by Friday — expanding the steering-wheel-less, pedal-less two-seater inside the year-old Robotaxi service. Cybercab rides began in early September in Austin only, with wait times previously high; the jump is a confidence signal on FSD handling unsupervised rides even as NHTSA still presses for sworn Cybercab certification answers.

2755e72e4e39234584cc30e6372432c13f897bf0.headline: Jets open as 3-point underdogs at Bears after back-to-back heartbreakers
2755e72e4e39234584cc30e6372432c13f897bf0.summary: After a second straight devastating loss — Geno Smith strip-sacked by ex-Jet Chuck Clark inside the Lions’ 30 with the game tied late — the 1–2 Jets open as 3-point road underdogs at Chicago (+138 ML, 43.5 O/U on FanDuel). Chicago is also 1–2 and may still be without Caleb Williams after Tyson Bagent managed just three points vs. Minnesota; if Williams sits, Gang Green Nation argues the Jets’ path back to .500 gets clearer.

fe7209124007f3db3337c1e515c119cc0da026b8.headline: LEGO officially reveals first Dragon Ball set: Shenron & Kid Goku for $180
fe7209124007f3db3337c1e515c119cc0da026b8.summary: LEGO and Toei Animation officially unveiled Icons set 11390 Dragon Ball: Shenron & Goku — 1,764 pieces, Kid Goku minifigure, Dragon Balls diorama, standing over 12 inches — with Insiders early access Nov. 1 and general release Nov. 4 at $179.99. LEGO’s Federico Begher called it the start of a multi-year Dragon Ball partnership with more sets due in 2027, moving the earlier leak into confirmed shelf reality for adult builders.

b463b09d6639327ba9a9d44824d295fa18ece141.headline: Ohio Supreme Court: no plain error skipping transferred self-defense instruction
b463b09d6639327ba9a9d44824d295fa18ece141.summary: In a 6–1 ruling, the Supreme Court of Ohio upheld Timothy Bradley’s convictions for shooting into neighboring homes even though a jury acquitted him of felonious assault on a self-defense claim after he fired at contractor Zachary Burch. Justice Deters wrote that Bradley never requested a transferred-self-defense instruction, Ohio has never adopted that doctrine, and counsel already told jurors self-defense applied to all counts — so omitting a sua sponte transfer charge was not plain error. Justice Brunner dissented, saying the habitation statute’s “without privilege” element needed an explicit self-defense privilege explanation.

eec2eaa9e2e73fc71ad239f52e0eaefd9d82587f.headline: Jack Smith defends Trump probes as GOP senators grill him for four hours
eec2eaa9e2e73fc71ad239f52e0eaefd9d82587f.summary: Former special counsel Jack Smith spent roughly four hours before the Senate Judiciary Committee defending his two Trump prosecutions while Republican senators accused him of partisanship and mapping the GOP apparatus. Chairman Chuck Grassley said Smith took partisanship to a new level and vowed to keep investigating; Smith insisted the strongest witnesses in the 2020 election case would have been Republicans and that he will not be silenced by threats of prosecution. Tempers flared when Sen. Eric Schmitt briefly accused Smith of attending an Atlanta Hawks game around the Fani Willis scandal, only for colleagues to note Smith had attended an Iowa Hawkeyes women's basketball game featuring Caitlin Clark.

9bc6b2a99da5514437e44c037b45795e0c41121d.headline: CBP put $20 million behind Trump-heavy TV ads ahead of midterms, CNBC reports
9bc6b2a99da5514437e44c037b45795e0c41121d.summary: U.S. Customs and Border Protection funded the taxpayer-backed television spots featuring President Trump that have drawn bipartisan scrutiny weeks before the November midterms, CNBC reported, citing a Wall Street Journal account. Top Democrats say Homeland Security dedicated about $20 million to the effort, including money routed through Republicans' One Big Beautiful Bill Act, and federal records show a $20 million CBP award to Maryland ad firm LMD Agency days earlier. The White House called the spots patriotic public service announcements; watchdog groups asked FCC, FTC, GAO, and the Office of Special Counsel to examine alleged propaganda and Hatch Act issues.

de5ffef9bf07af8d4146f8a89e3fe76a4de667ac.headline: Video: workers scramble as ICE raids Tallahassee food truck
de5ffef9bf07af8d4146f8a89e3fe76a4de667ac.summary: Security footage from Chile & Chili's Taqueria in Tallahassee shows food-truck workers scrambling as Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents rolled up Friday, with one woman detained on camera. The owner told local station WCTV that three Guatemalan nationals in the video had not finished immigration paperwork, and he later closed the truck after remaining staff quit amid safety concerns. Community organizers planned an anti-ICE rally at the Tennessee Street location for Wednesday while a related GoFundMe raised nearly $13,000.

0cfb86088515a74cd2c3ae4be7047972a88e8225.headline: Candace Owens hit with second defamation suit over Charlie Kirk murder theories
0cfb86088515a74cd2c3ae4be7047972a88e8225.summary: Washington State native Robert Hild, a private citizen who was in the crowd when Charlie Kirk was assassinated at Utah Valley University, sued podcaster Candace Owens on Monday for suggesting he helped kill Kirk. The 73-page federal complaint says Owens told millions of listeners that Hild resembled FBI suspect photos, had ties to foreign actors, and belonged to a gothic communist underground, triggering threats, doxxing, and vandalism. Owens already faces an April defamation suit from Kirk's former private security chief over similar alternate theories that reject the case against suspected assassin Tyler Robinson.

e8b80f18b4c103538d0d7996f98c4f447a82028c.headline: Trumbull football drops to 1–2 after 28–21 home loss to Norwalk
e8b80f18b4c103538d0d7996f98c4f447a82028c.summary: Trumbull High's football Eagles fell 28–21 to Norwalk on Friday after a 14–14 halftime tie, dropping to 1–2 and extending a six-game home losing streak dating to last season. Brayden Jagoe rushed for 182 yards and two touchdowns for Trumbull, but Norwalk's Easton Pace ran for 271 yards and four scores. The Eagles host Shelton at 7:00 p.m. Friday; a full game replay is on the NFHS Network.

e70171cd9779c623f26d3343444332a96958f6e6.headline: Tesla locks in $30 billion in credit lines to scale Cybercab, Optimus, and Semi
e70171cd9779c623f26d3343444332a96958f6e6.summary: Tesla announced Tuesday that Citibank agreed to a $20 billion three-year delayed-draw term loan, with Wells Fargo adding an $8 billion five-year revolver and a $2 billion 364-day facility — $30 billion in fresh credit capacity aimed at scaling Cybercab, Optimus, and the Semi. The company said it does not plan to draw on the facilities this year even as it projects at least $25 billion in 2026 capital spending, finishing Q2 with roughly $9 billion in debt and more than $40 billion in cash and investments. All three products require new manufacturing lines, including dedicated factories for Semi and Optimus.

3c58d85c031c7306b3793c753f31cc36c210afa3.headline: Penguins unveil 60th-anniversary logo, giveaways, and Oct. 3 home-opener ceremony
3c58d85c031c7306b3793c753f31cc36c210afa3.summary: The Pittsburgh Penguins will mark their 60th anniversary all season with special events, ticket packages, and giveaways, starting with a pregame ceremony at the Oct. 3 home opener against Montreal. A retro-inspired anniversary logo with five Stanley Cup stars and three-river stripes will appear on helmets all year and on jersey shoulders for that opener. Planned giveaways include lapel pins, a kitchen apron, a poster, and a patterned shirt, plus era-night T-shirts and a limited Zamboni gravy boat for select packages.

5c0494d02ec4abb99762ce461e3c8974403907f1.headline: Jets film room: Geno Smith’s 13.1% explosive-play rate nearly sparked a Lions comeback
5c0494d02ec4abb99762ce461e3c8974403907f1.summary: Official Jets film breakdown credits Geno Smith with seven explosive passing plays and a 13.1% explosive-play rate — ninth-best in the NFL in Week 3 — in the 31–24 loss at Detroit. Smith was 31-of-37 for 321 yards and three touchdowns with no interceptions, hitting Kenyon Sadiq and Garrett Wilson for explosive scores and posting a 146.8 rating on deep balls this season. Coach Aaron Glenn said the late push showed belief the team can win any game; next up is Chicago's 13th-ranked pass defense at Soldier Field.

4dd4971e5c4033ef246a88d8281be6beed326d8f.headline: Apple CEO Ternus pushes faster year-round launches and a leaner engineering org
4dd4971e5c4033ef246a88d8281be6beed326d8f.summary: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple CEO John Ternus wants the company to broaden its device lineup, lean harder on engineering, and loosen the traditional spring/fall release cadence so new products can ship more often through the year. Plans discussed include fewer middle managers, hiring restraint, reduced marketing spend, and more experimental bets for the AI era, with directors and engineering program managers already given weeks to find internal roles or face layoff. Gurman cautions the cultural shift could take years even as product groups feel pressure to deliver more on shorter timelines.

1f9bb6cb1b5636a158a96c95cdbbf3165f1c0b0f.headline: NHTSA closes Jeep Wrangler/Gladiator underhood-fire probe after 1.08M-vehicle recall
1f9bb6cb1b5636a158a96c95cdbbf3165f1c0b0f.summary: Federal safety regulators closed Preliminary Evaluation PE24024 into underhood fires on Jeep Wrangler JL and Gladiator JT trucks after FCA's June recall of nearly 1.08 million 2021–2025 vehicles. Investigators tied the risk to a high-resistance electrical connection at the electric-hydraulic power steering pump that can overheat and ignite nearby materials, sometimes while the vehicle is parked. NHTSA said the recall addresses the defect it was investigating and will keep monitoring the field; unrepaired owners are still advised to park outside and away from buildings.

90b5b79e312be9686f6f01650035897ffa8cb0aa.headline: Fall color wave is rolling south — peak windows still run about one week
90b5b79e312be9686f6f01650035897ffa8cb0aa.summary: America's 2026 fall foliage season is already moving from high country and northern states toward lower elevations and the South, with most destinations near historical peak averages. Planners note peak color at any single spot usually lasts about a week, so timing a Vermont Northeast Kingdom drive versus a Great Smoky Mountains foothills trip can differ by weeks. The piece walks west-to-east and north-to-south windows — Colorado aspens, New England late September openers, Mid-Atlantic mid-October, and Southern Appalachians lasting into November — and urges checking local reports in the final week before travel.

794f63c2b58158d3d2d2faf114f4d5748694aa93.headline: Gun-rights groups sue Jacksonville over venue bans that turned carriers away at EverBank Stadium
794f63c2b58158d3d2d2faf114f4d5748694aa93.summary: Florida Carry Inc. and Gun Owners of America, joined by individual plaintiffs, sued the City of Jacksonville, Mayor Donna Deegan, and Sheriff T.K. Waters over written and unwritten policies that allegedly forced legally armed visitors to disarm, denied them entry, or threatened trespass at EverBank Stadium, the Florida Theatre, and the performing-arts center. The complaint leans on Florida's firearm-preemption statute, which reaches local policies and directives and allows injunctions, fees, and capped damages. The filing follows Attorney General James Uthmeier's separate May suit over City Hall firearm logbooks; the city said it was served and directed questions to counsel.

8209a93d68b5d97b242f2d7c4660400dfe6ba51d.headline: Apple Creator Studio and Final Cut Camera add iPhone 18 Pro aperture tools
8209a93d68b5d97b242f2d7c4660400dfe6ba51d.summary: Apple updated Creator Studio apps and Final Cut Camera to tap the iPhone 18 Pro's variable aperture, with aperture- and shutter-priority modes, cinematic effects, false-color overlays, improved focus peaking, and a tally light for recording. Pages, Numbers, and Keynote gained templates and collaboration tools; Pixelmator Pro on iPad picked up Select and Mask; Freeform added Dark Mode, folders, and Writing Tools for handwritten notes. Creator Studio remains $12.99 a month for the full creative suite, with some Freeform and iWork extras bundled as premium features.

fc3ac5840696aa7b38832c2b2460e39570cc2ac8.headline: Trumbull First Selectman Tesoro to address business community Oct. 1 at Tashua Knolls
fc3ac5840696aa7b38832c2b2460e39570cc2ac8.summary: First Selectman Vicki Tesoro is scheduled to deliver her annual Address to the Business Community on Thursday morning, Oct. 1, at Tashua Knolls Golf Club. The Trumbull Chamber of Commerce hosts the gathering with the Bridgeport Regional Business Council, offering a chance to hear town priorities and network with local and regional business leaders. Patch reported the details Tuesday evening from the town calendar.

c7565b9e9a7d5bc66e6713e3e43c48ecd9521b75.headline: Trump calls Kim Jong Un a ‘friend’ and plays down North Korea’s nuclear arsenal
c7565b9e9a7d5bc66e6713e3e43c48ecd9521b75.summary: Asked why North Korea can keep nuclear weapons while Iran cannot, Trump said Kim Jong Un “happens to be a friend of mine” and that “as long as I’m around, he’s going to be fine.” He described Pyongyang’s arsenal as “pretty large” but “not like us,” contrasting it with his hard line on Iran. South Korea’s defense minister recently estimated 80–120 North Korean warheads; Trump has floated year-end talks though Pyongyang has not committed.

e6ba8b39368c1b59def4f7819ac4b47033e35c8c.headline: ICE’s Operation Safe Community nets 104 arrests in southwest Kansas; U.S. attorney cites criminal aliens
e6ba8b39368c1b59def4f7819ac4b47033e35c8c.summary: The U.S. Attorney’s Office for Kansas said Tuesday that a three-day “Operation Safe Community” arrested 104 people in southwest and central Kansas, focusing on noncitizens with prior convictions including homicide, rape, and aggravated assault. U.S. Attorney Ryan Kriegshauser rejected claims of indiscriminate racial sweeps and named several high-priority targets. Sens. Moran and Marshall said they had pressed the White House over local agencies not being notified beforehand.

48307a7e978bed570446099ae83ea4767ce32291.headline: Charlie Kirk’s mother: family is ‘100% behind’ Erika amid online conspiracy pile-on
48307a7e978bed570446099ae83ea4767ce32291.summary: In a rare Vanity Fair interview excerpted by Fox, Kathryn Kirk rejected claims of a family rift with widow Erika Kirk, saying trauma has brought them closer and that Charlie would be upset by online attacks on his wife. She said the parents are “100% behind her” as Turning Point USA CEO and pushed back on will and succession conspiracies. TPUSA praised Kathryn’s defense and said Erika saw the profile as a chance to tell her own story.

a84f917611ed97cf72154a1de4628315203ff0fe.headline: Crosby, Malkin, and Letang open a record 21st season together vs. Flyers
a84f917611ed97cf72154a1de4628315203ff0fe.summary: Sidney Crosby, Evgeni Malkin, and Kris Letang tip off their unprecedented 21st season as teammates Wednesday night in Philadelphia, extending the longest-tenured trio in major North American pro sports. Crosby enters the final year of his deal; Letang is signed through 2027-28; Malkin, on a one-year pact, says he will only continue if he can still help win. GM Kyle Dubas called the three-Cup core “something that shouldn’t be taken for granted.”

4e4e540bcc7b698dbf96e8470f27f7d906934f46.headline: Jets sign kicker Jason Sanders to active roster; waive Blake Grupe and Jordan Clark
4e4e540bcc7b698dbf96e8470f27f7d906934f46.summary: The Jets elevated practice-squad kicker Jason Sanders to the active roster Tuesday and waived Blake Grupe and cornerback Jordan Clark, also adding offensive linemen Nick Dawkins and Jimmy Morrissey to the practice squad. Sanders leads the team with 20 points and is 5-of-6 on field goals through three games, including makes from 52 and 51 yards. The former Dolphin ranks third in Miami franchise scoring history.

25b30e990deb7ac3181895d9b72de7fbfbaf32f0.headline: Tesla wins SEC nod for retail auto-vote program that follows the board — ahead of any SpaceX deal vote
25b30e990deb7ac3181895d9b72de7fbfbaf32f0.summary: The SEC granted Tesla no-action relief for an “Issuer Voluntary Retail Voting Program” that lets retail holders opt into standing instructions that cast their votes with the board’s recommendations. Electrek notes the timing: Tesla still has not scheduled its 2026 annual meeting while Musk keeps floating a SpaceX combination that could accelerate pay-package vesting on market-cap alone. Participants can override or opt out, but the default path is board-aligned.

7b48ff7e0aa276980efc856a99a269f81851d233.headline: Fifth Circuit strikes federal ban on direct interstate handgun purchases as unconstitutional
7b48ff7e0aa276980efc856a99a269f81851d233.summary: In Elite Precision Customs v. ATF, a Fifth Circuit panel held that federal statutes forcing out-of-state handgun buyers to ship guns to a home-state dealer lack a Founding-era historical tradition under Bruen and therefore violate the Second Amendment. Background checks remain; the ruling covers Texas, Louisiana, and Mississippi for now. The court stressed that the right to keep arms logically includes the right to purchase them without an extra transfer fee tax on the right.

dba6bf61e95280a6d1b23e1661aa3fd3ac5b0f6c.headline: Jeep Recon Moab arrives: 670-hp electric trail rig with removable doors, 222-mile range
dba6bf61e95280a6d1b23e1661aa3fd3ac5b0f6c.summary: Jeep’s Recon Moab electric off-roader is headed to dealers from $65,000 before destination, pairing twin motors (670 hp / 620 lb-ft) with five trail modes and no low-range transfer case. Specs include 9.1 inches of ground clearance, 33-inch tires, 24-inch water fording, and removable doors with optional folding fabric roof. The tradeoff is a 100.5-kWh pack rated about 222 miles — shorter than Rivian or Tesla rivals but built around trail hardware.

3384a8a683d703cbf4f4187413c9f1bd8b156dc9.headline: Apple’s next MacBook Pro rumored with OLED, touchscreen, and hole-punch camera
3384a8a683d703cbf4f4187413c9f1bd8b156dc9.summary: A dpa roundup of 9to5Mac reporting says Apple is preparing a major MacBook Pro redesign that could land in October — possibly under a rumored MacBook Ultra name — with an OLED panel, touchscreen support, and a hole-punch camera cutout that would retire the notch. macOS would stay keyboard-and-trackpad first even if touch arrives. The redesign is framed as part of Apple’s broader autumn hardware and software cycle.

67e3646a2da4ac8d1c3746f45b3f2ae61a4781df.headline: Apple Watch Ultra 4 review: better health sensing and up to 50 hours of battery, same $799 price
67e3646a2da4ac8d1c3746f45b3f2ae61a4781df.summary: Gizmodo’s hands-on calls the Ultra 4 Apple’s best smartwatch yet for iPhone users who want the big rugged case — continuous heart-rate via a new Health Sensing System, a clearer Readiness Score, and advertised battery up to 50 hours (84 in low power) with no price hike from $799. Reviewer Raymond Wong says Ultra 3 owners needn’t rush, but older Ultras and non-Ultras gain the most; Audio Intelligence features still ship later.

4f64eec9faf5238d33bd42347868caaf84201807.headline: Lindsay Clancy’s lawyer now questions whether prosecutors proved she killed her children
4f64eec9faf5238d33bd42347868caaf84201807.summary: After a mistrial, defense attorney Kevin Reddington argued there is no evidence Lindsay Clancy admitted killing her three children and questioned whether prosecutors can prove she did it, seeking to avert a retrial. Prosecutors called the evidence “voluminous.” A Massachusetts judge set a November 2 hearing on motions and possible retrial timing — a new defense posture that will matter to readers following the postpartum-psychosis case.

2ce5f42e2fec8880376719401588ad904592dd29.headline: Trumbull man accused of taking $42,000 for Fairfield home work that never started
2ce5f42e2fec8880376719401588ad904592dd29.summary: Fairfield police arrested Trumbull resident Arthur Arekhau, 44, owner of American House LLC, on Sept. 15 on first-degree larceny and a home-improvement-contract violation after a homeowner paid three deposits totaling $42,333 for siding and window work that never began. Sgt. Jenna Wellington said no materials or refunds were delivered and the town Building Department had no permits on file. Arekhau told Patch he is selling his house to repay the client; his next court date is Oct. 30 in Bridgeport Superior Court.

62bb123f787eb27779059321eb8a456fbd6f63b0.headline: Trump plans a 32-day midterm campaign tour for GOP candidates in Texas, Ohio, and beyond
62bb123f787eb27779059321eb8a456fbd6f63b0.summary: Speaking at the White House Tuesday, President Trump said he will run “literally a 32-day tour” for Republican midterm candidates ahead of the Nov. 3 elections, naming Texas and Ohio among early stops and brushing aside talk that nominees want distance. He argued “they all want me to go campaign” while critics point to slipping approval and cost-of-living anger tied partly to the Iran war. Allies pledged he will “campaign like it’s 2024 again” as House and Senate control hangs in the balance.

1087eb0c3db0f9b61dfcd1fe7ca93c929b0fa486.headline: Newsom signs California ban on electric shock gloves for local, state, and federal officers — including ICE
1087eb0c3db0f9b61dfcd1fe7ca93c929b0fa486.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a law Tuesday barring wearable electric-shock gloves for California local, state, and federal officers, effective 2027 through 2030 while the state DOJ studies their safety. The ban follows ICE’s nearly $17 million contract for 6,000 pairs and sits alongside dozens of other California immigrant-rights bills this year. Legal scholars warn courts may strike the federal application under the Supremacy Clause, echoing the earlier fight over face-covering bans for federal agents.

654abc7e23e7f8ad7c773c3632a8cad5de1206f7.headline: Utah man sues Candace Owens, saying Kirk-assassination theories falsely implicated him
654abc7e23e7f8ad7c773c3632a8cad5de1206f7.summary: Robert L. Hild Jr., a Utah private citizen who was in the UVU crowd when Charlie Kirk was killed, filed a defamation suit alleging Candace Owens repeatedly cast him as tied to foreign actors and a “gothic communist underground.” The complaint says Owens used a friend’s posted photos of Hild near the suspect’s path, refused a retraction, and that followers doxxed him, vandalized property, and forced him into hiding. ABC4 noted Owens had not responded by publish time; Tyler Robinson remains the charged shooter.

dfbc5b0c61e340b209afbcd1c19a01f14c8752e9.headline: NYC Council subpoenas Elon Musk and SpaceXAI for Oct. 5 AI-safety hearing
dfbc5b0c61e340b209afbcd1c19a01f14c8752e9.summary: New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin issued a subpoena requiring Musk or another SpaceXAI representative to testify Oct. 5 before a rare Committee of the Whole on whether AI risks warrant city legislation. The probe cites public-safety, cybersecurity, and consumer harms after lawsuits over Grok deepfake pornography and teen image abuse. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Meta have already agreed to send witnesses; SpaceXAI—the SpaceX/xAI combine that owns X and Grok—is valued near $2 trillion after its June IPO.

215b33268c4064b8454734d23a1769fd275cfc4c.headline: Geno Smith’s historic Jets start: first QB with 700+ yards, 4 TDs, 0 INTs, 70% in opening three
215b33268c4064b8454734d23a1769fd275cfc4c.summary: Despite a 1-2 record, Geno Smith is off to a franchise-unique start: the first Jets quarterback to open a season’s first three games with 700-plus passing yards, four touchdowns, zero interceptions, and a 70% completion rate. PFF has him leading the NFL at 75.5% completions, and his EPA-per-dropback ranks as the best Jets three-game open since Chad Pennington in 2007. Offensive yards and points are mid-pack but a sharp climb from 2025’s bottom-tier attack as Gang Green prepares for Week 4 at Chicago.

be5e176bdadbc76aa2ec9cf5a1e3d50869ccdf17.headline: Harley factory riders sound farewell notes after King of the Baggers finale — 2027 unclear
be5e176bdadbc76aa2ec9cf5a1e3d50869ccdf17.summary: After Kyle Wyman won Sunday’s rain-soaked New Jersey finale, his “one more win” remarks and teammate Bradley Smith’s hint of an “unfortunate situation” fueled speculation Harley-Davidson may exit MotoAmerica King of the Baggers for 2027. Harley has not confirmed a withdrawal; observers note the company already runs a sole-brand MotoGP Bagger World Cup that could absorb factory focus. Indian’s Vance & Hines squad took the 2026 title and has already re-signed Hayden Gillim and Troy Herfoss.

3aadb4e3c395798121b02dcb828cb2edd6f7c23b.headline: 2027 Jeep Grand Wagoneer Build & Price goes live with new Overland trim from $81,000
3aadb4e3c395798121b02dcb828cb2edd6f7c23b.summary: Jeep opened the 2027 Grand Wagoneer configurator, revealing a cleaned-up trim ladder that drops the 85th Anniversary and Limited Reserve while adding Overland 4x4 from $81,000 ($84,000 for the L). Base MSRP rises to $65,000 before the $2,795 destination charge; Summit Reserve still tops six figures. Power stays the twin-turbo 3.0-liter Hurricane I6 (420 hp / 468 lb-ft, up to 10,000-lb towing), with the lineup now Grand Wagoneer, Limited, Upland, Overland, Summit, and Summit Reserve.

56451168c3fb090434e65b0bfc34e78c6bf53a60.headline: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro lands at $399 with glass cups, triple drivers, and 46 dB ANC
56451168c3fb090434e65b0bfc34e78c6bf53a60.summary: Nothing launched the Headphone (1) Pro on Sept. 29 at $399 in black or white—aluminum, titanium, and 9H Panda glass cups aimed at AirPods Max and Sony WH-1000XM6 buyers. Each ear uses three drivers (40 mm bass, mids, and an xMEMS tweeter) tuned with Metropolis Studios, plus up to 46 dB ANC from a 10-mic array and rated battery of 30 hours with ANC (68 without on AAC). USB-C lossless to 24-bit/192 kHz, LDAC, Bluetooth 6.1, and a Flat EQ switch round out the $100 step-up from last year’s model.

7fd55519807dce1a05953c8d99d7ba6bc198e63b.headline: SteelSeries Rival Pro and Sensei Pro mice: 53 g, ultra-wideband, swappable batteries at $179
7fd55519807dce1a05953c8d99d7ba6bc198e63b.summary: SteelSeries’ Rival Pro (ergo) and Sensei Pro (ambi) wireless mice hit preorder for $179.99, shipping Oct. 13 with mini variants at the same price. Each black shell weighs about 53 grams and uses ultra-wideband (6.4–9 GHz) to a base station instead of crowded 2.4 GHz, targeting cleaner 8,000 Hz polling. Swappable puck batteries last ~16 hours at 8K or ~60 hours at 1K, and the GG app adds SuperSync click/sensor decoupling plus a browser-based settings tool.

7718280a54eab6b823482a5d6557c1b48f8800a4.headline: Trumbull third-grader Gabriella Gomez wins Rep. Himes’ America 250 essay contest
7718280a54eab6b823482a5d6557c1b48f8800a4.summary: Town officials congratulated Frenchtown Elementary third-grader Gabriella Gomez after she won the elementary division of U.S. Rep. Jim Himes’ America 250 essay contest, the town announced Sept. 29. Students in Connecticut’s 4th District answered what they value about American democracy and how they will participate in its future. Gomez will receive a congressional certificate, be recognized at a Thursday ceremony in Norwalk, and have her essay displayed in Himes’ office and shared on his social channels.

0b047964a928654f361de5acea70a501dd6d1c9b.headline: Trump targets Fox News: ‘MAGA and REAL Patriots will never like Fox’
0b047964a928654f361de5acea70a501dd6d1c9b.summary: President Trump blasted Fox News on Truth Social Wednesday for giving Chuck Schumer, Hakeem Jeffries, Jessica Tarlov, and other Democrats what he called excessive airtime to attack Republicans and him. “This is why MAGA, and REAL Patriots, will never like Fox,” he wrote, claiming the network repeats a “completely negative narrative.” The jab lands even as Fox remains the top news source for many Republicans and after Fox joined other outlets opposing White House media-access restrictions in court.

f1e2bb2b7aabea35ead8c9f9045264b404f4f8d2.headline: Senate Democrats block GOP package tying stock-trading ban to nationwide voter ID
f1e2bb2b7aabea35ead8c9f9045264b404f4f8d2.summary: Senate Democrats on Wednesday blocked a Republican bill pairing a ban on lawmakers’ stock trading with nationwide voter-ID rules tied to the SAVE America Act, falling short of the 60-vote threshold. Sen. Chuck Schumer called the voter-ID piece a “poison pill,” while House Administration Chair Bryan Steil said 53 senators backed the ethics reform before Democrats filibustered. Polls cited by Fox show overwhelming public support for both a trading ban and photo ID at the ballot box ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms.

a83b4ebaad4e4b056163b3b2847532653f064699.headline: DHS: ICE nets more ‘worst of the worst’ — child predators, sex offenders, violent felons
a83b4ebaad4e4b056163b3b2847532653f064699.summary: Homeland Security on Sept. 30 highlighted fresh ICE arrests of criminal illegal aliens convicted of sex crimes against minors, exploitation-material trafficking, assault, and burglary. Named cases include a Laotian national with five counts of sexual intercourse with a minor under 16 in California, Mexican nationals convicted of home-invasion sex offenses and child-exploitation transport, an Algerian with NYC assault and burglary convictions, and an Ohio felonious-assault case. Secretary Markwayne Mullin said ICE will keep hunting down and removing criminal illegal aliens under President Trump.

b7df85b3195337fe9305a48902305f7947d96a5a.headline: Philadelphia woman fatally shoots masked man breaking into her Crescentville apartment
b7df85b3195337fe9305a48902305f7947d96a5a.summary: A woman in her 20s fatally shot a masked 29-year-old man who broke into her second-floor Crescentville apartment on Castor Avenue around 5 a.m. Wednesday, Philadelphia police said. Chief Inspector Scott Small said she heard windows breaking, found the masked intruder inside, and fired one or two shots striking him in the head; he was pronounced dead at the scene. After responders removed the mask, she said she recognized him. Police believe the shooting followed a break-in; the woman is cooperating and neither person has been publicly identified.

70e6fbadf32827e28504dd53abd9b963d87bf75e.headline: Michigan teen who stopped mall gunman gets probation — for carrying the pistol that saved lives
70e6fbadf32827e28504dd53abd9b963d87bf75e.summary: Martinez Long, 19, received two years’ probation for carrying a concealed pistol without a license after he fatally shot Cameron Watkins during the July 3 Fairlane Town Center attack in Dearborn. Prosecutors accepted that Long’s shooting was lawful self-defense after Watkins killed one person and kept firing in the mall, yet charged Long because Michigan bars concealed-pistol licenses under age 21. The judge asked why Long brought a gun into the mall; conditions bar him from possessing firearms during probation despite a clean prior record.

ff5ea267e692ef6c49db0eac586f1e843cba228d.headline: Penguins open 2026-27 tonight at Flyers; Silovs starts, Malkin one point from 100 vs. Philly
ff5ea267e692ef6c49db0eac586f1e843cba228d.summary: Pittsburgh opens the season Wednesday at 7:30 p.m. ET against cross-state rival Philadelphia on TNT, with Arturs Silovs expected to start in goal. Evgeni Malkin sits one point shy of becoming the sixth NHL player with 100-plus points against the Flyers, joining Crosby, Lemieux, Jagr, Trottier, and Gretzky. Several newcomers — including Nick Robertson, Hendrix Lapierre, Declan Carlile, and Trevor van Riemsdyk — are in line for debuts as the Pens chase points they’ve earned in 13 of their last 15 meetings with Philly.

6af6782bba8df2571de9b0a6e949c6662402eb14.headline: Jets’ Minkah Fitzpatrick has ‘really good chance’ to return Sunday at Chicago
6af6782bba8df2571de9b0a6e949c6662402eb14.summary: Coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday that safety Minkah Fitzpatrick, sidelined since a Week 1 groin injury, has “a really good chance” of playing Sunday at the Bears and will be limited in practice. Glenn confirmed running back Breece Hall remains week-to-week with a quad injury and will not practice Wednesday, alongside Adonai Mitchell (finger), Dylan Parham (knee), Mason Taylor (thumb), and Kiko Mauigoa (quad). Tight ends Kenyon Sadiq and Jeremy Ruckert figure as limited participants on the first injury report of the week.

dc84de9e8f87d9c45462146738920d1fc8c8c6b9.headline: Technics EAH-A1000 flagship headphones: magnetic-fluid drivers, USB lossless, $449
dc84de9e8f87d9c45462146738920d1fc8c8c6b9.summary: Technics unveiled the EAH-A1000 flagship wireless headphones built around a new 40 mm Magnetic Fluid Driver with SST Edge and a pure carbon-fiber diaphragm aimed at lower distortion and a wider soundstage. The $449 pair adds adaptive ANC, LDAC, lossless USB-C audio, three-device multipoint, Dolby Atmos head tracking, AI beamforming calls, and rated battery life up to 45 hours with ANC (90 without). Black and Platinum Greige finishes ship with a folding design and dedicated case.

0b302ca50e8bf587bb723df12272deaa079827a0.headline: LEGO rolls out five Dodge and Jeep builds — Fast & Furious Charger to Jurassic Park Wrangler
0b302ca50e8bf587bb723df12272deaa079827a0.summary: LEGO’s new American-muscle slate spans five sets from $26.99 to $199.99. Headline builds are the 1,516-piece Technic Dodge Charger R/T ($159.99) with a chain-driven V8 and working steering, and the 1,924-piece Jurassic Park Jeep Wrangler ($199.99) at 1:10 with a functional winch. Also arriving: Technic Wrangler Rubicon (723 pcs), Viper GTS-R (805 pcs) with a Forza Horizon 6 unlock, and a Speed Champions Challenger SRT Hellcat (390 pcs) for younger builders.

ad8128cb70cab27a23ef80dc8186e2a885365fe0.headline: Maine foliage report: peak color hits northern and western mountains this weekend
ad8128cb70cab27a23ef80dc8186e2a885365fe0.summary: Maine’s fourth foliage report Wednesday put northern counties and most western mountain regions at or near peak color, with leaf drop still under 30% for most areas. WABI called this the weekend to chase color up north and west under a favorable forecast — only a slight late-Sunday shower chance. Color remains moderate south of Bangor and along the coast, with near-peak expected next week as warm days and cool nights continue and last weekend’s rain eases drought stress.

41de799ba236050c00fe81b4f6326e740235aa99.headline: Apple’s redesigned Vision Pro project reportedly on ‘life support’ as glasses take priority
41de799ba236050c00fe81b4f6326e740235aa99.summary: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple’s next-generation Vision Pro overhaul (internal N224) is on “life support” as engineers shift toward smart glasses with broader mainstream appeal. Apple is still exploring lighter designs — including offloading components to an external pack — but a cheaper “Vision Air” (N100) was already shelved, and even a surviving N224 would not ship before late 2028 or early 2029. First display-free smart glasses are eyed for late 2027 while spatial-computing tech could migrate into smaller wearables.

68c7ac8604f0a2f22505a00367550054c692585e.headline: Old Mill Grocery & Deli closes in Westport as Ricci brothers prep Darien restaurant
68c7ac8604f0a2f22505a00367550054c692585e.summary: Graziano and Maurizio Ricci closed Old Mill Grocery & Deli on Hillspoint Road near Compo Beach this week after three years, Patch reported Sept. 30, as the brothers prepare a new Italian restaurant at Heights Crossing in Darien this fall. Their Railroad Place restaurant in Westport remains open. The Soundview Empowerment Alliance, which owns the 107-year-old property, said it is in talks with prospective operators to keep a grocery at the site.

9986abf6c7db8536ad4afad518f36aa75db2df3d.headline: White House touts 96% drop in legal immigration from Muslim-majority nations
9986abf6c7db8536ad4afad518f36aa75db2df3d.summary: A White House X post highlighting Cato Institute data showing roughly a 96% cut in legal immigration from Muslim-majority countries since 2024 drew cheers from Republicans on Sept. 30. The chart shows monthly admissions that once topped 22,000 falling toward near zero after Trump took office in January 2025. GOP lawmakers and Turning Point figures framed the drop as a midterm-worthy win, while Cato’s David Bier said the policy harms Americans — though courts have not ruled the reduction illegal.

371f943978d237207a2c91c79d4c06d125278020.headline: State Department says it has revoked more than 250,000 visas under Trump
371f943978d237207a2c91c79d4c06d125278020.summary: The State Department told Fox News Digital it has revoked more than 250,000 visas since Trump returned to office, citing crimes, fraud, birth tourism, terrorism support, and national-security threats. Spokesperson Tommy Pigott called the milestone historic continuous vetting; about 2,300 revocations tied to birth tourism. The agency also yanked visas for 27 Latin American officials over corruption allegations this week, and officials have floated broader B1/B2 cuts for asylum claimants.

8d122f0bf8c0a377b73da058892025ea3cae91f1.headline: Trump announces $54 billion South Korean investment in Alaska natural-gas pipeline
8d122f0bf8c0a377b73da058892025ea3cae91f1.summary: President Trump said Wednesday South Korea will invest about $54 billion to export Alaska natural gas via an 807-mile North Slope-to-LNG pipeline long pushed by Sen. Dan Sullivan, who faces a tough reelection fight. The pledge ties to a 2025 trade deal that swapped lower auto tariffs for hundreds of billions in U.S. investment. Officials said pipeline construction could take three years with exports two years later if financing lands — part of a midterm push showcasing foreign-investment wins in contested red states.

4e19beba352019a9dd96187594f127f4434aa754.headline: Navarro warns Canada will ‘pay even more dearly’ if it ‘interferes’ in U.S. midterms
4e19beba352019a9dd96187594f127f4434aa754.summary: Trump trade adviser Peter Navarro told a Washington economic conference Tuesday that Canadian lobbyists should “get the hell out” of the U.S. and that Ottawa would “pay even more dearly” if it interfered in races in Maine or Michigan. He did not detail what interference would look like as new U.S. bans on some Canadian alcohol, dairy byproducts, motorcycles, and molasses took effect. Trump said he expects Canada to return to talks within weeks seeking tariff relief.

892009d0ec38c83bc991e5a96e80090dfdbe4500.headline: GW student groups slam Turning Point ‘Infidels’ screening as Islamophobic
892009d0ec38c83bc991e5a96e80090dfdbe4500.summary: At least 11 George Washington University student organizations, including SJP, MSA, and the SGA, condemned TPUSA’s Monday campus screening of Daily Wire’s “Run Hide Fight: Infidels,” calling the film Islamophobic. Chapter president Ryan Van Slingerland said the backlash proves First Amendment culture has atrophied. The film follows students fighting a radical Islamist takeover of a campus distracted by a pro-Palestinian encampment; SGA passed a nonbinding resolution opposing future funding for similar events.

65773386da549901a2990bb1641377258dd8b6ff.headline: Apple’s smart home hub rumored with iMac G4-style design for Oct. 13 unveil
65773386da549901a2990bb1641377258dd8b6ff.summary: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple’s long-rumored smart home hub will use a square 6-inch display on a rounded metal base recalling the 2002 iMac G4, plus a wall-mount J491 variant, MacRumors reported Sept. 30. The always-plugged USB-C device will handle HomeKit, FaceTime, intercom, recipes, and face/voice personalization with visitor privacy mode. Interface mixes Watch, TV, and iPad cues with StandBy-style clocks; introduction is expected Oct. 13 beside new HomePod mini and Apple TV models.

1dcc5b7ce252338256eef6555292b57cca52e06b.headline: SpaceXAI weighs four-tier Grok and X pricing from free to $100 Ultra
1dcc5b7ce252338256eef6555292b57cca52e06b.summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI is evaluating a unified four-tier subscription for Grok and X, Bloomberg reported via an internal document summarized Sept. 30. Plans reportedly stretch from a capped free tier to a $100 monthly Ultra package that includes Grok Bot agent access, plus an $8 Lite bundle pairing Grok with an X verified badge and lighter ads. The move aims to broaden adoption and monetize heavy compute as SpaceXAI competes with OpenAI and Anthropic.

7ead935c29be0b511b3797a1d4fb2c627efd3050.headline: Jets’ Aaron Glenn preps for Bears’ Ben Johnson — familiar foes from Lions days
7ead935c29be0b511b3797a1d4fb2c627efd3050.summary: Jets coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday his club is ready for Sunday’s Week 4 rematch with Chicago and former Lions colleague Ben Johnson, who coordinated Detroit’s offense while Glenn ran the defense. The Bears (2-1) crushed Philadelphia 27–7 on MNF behind Case Keenum with Caleb Williams still nursing a hamstring; the Jets (1–2) just lost to Detroit 31–24. Both teams rank among the NFL’s top clock-control offenses, setting up a Soldier Field battle of sustained drives.

c4c55f80710e0936c0610dd67aa82c7171c8579a.headline: Oakbrook Center mall shooting leaves man dead, woman wounded; three in custody
c4c55f80710e0936c0610dd67aa82c7171c8579a.summary: Oak Brook police say a man was killed and a woman wounded shortly after noon Wednesday in the Oakbrook Center parking lot outside L.L.Bean after an altercation between two vehicles carrying five people turned into an exchange of gunfire. One vehicle fled and was found in Oakbrook Terrace; three occupants were taken into custody. Police have not named the victim, disclosed a motive, or announced charges; an update is expected Thursday. The mall stayed open amid a heavy police presence.

f602fe60c461704d501946793770108b72725c98.headline: LEGO Pick a Brick Q4 preview: dragon knights, seal, and Classic Space astronaut
f602fe60c461704d501946793770108b72725c98.summary: Stonewars previewed upcoming LEGO Pick a Brick parts shown at Skærbæk, with Q4 2026 drops spanning animals, minifigs, and prints. Highlights include a Medium Brown seal in October, Sea Serpent GWP dragon-knight torso and shield in November, a light-blue Classic Space astronaut completion pack, and Creator pirate figs available as soon as Oct. 1. Printed Hubble tiles, Architecture windows, and new plant colors round out the appetizer ahead of monthly PaB lists.

e990f37cadc511fce6a4405a57dcd57df973da8b.headline: Harley-Davidson revives Super Glide for 2026: Softail, 117 Classic, 2,500 units
e990f37cadc511fce6a4405a57dcd57df973da8b.summary: Harley revived the Super Glide name for 2026 on a modern Softail chassis with the Milwaukee-Eight 117 Classic (98 hp, 120 lb-ft), mini-apes, mid controls, a five-gallon tank, White Onyx Pearl paint, and chrome laced wheels, TopSpeed reported Sept. 30. Production is capped at 2,500 serialized bikes worldwide at a $15,999 U.S. MSRP — about $1,000 over the related Street Bob — packing Road/Sport/Rain modes, cornering ABS, traction control, and TPMS under throwback FX-inspired styling.

8866250ad84cb492e2ac5fdc2b42cca8a650f5df.headline: Westport police charge Brooklyn man in $89,000 bank-fraud wire case
8866250ad84cb492e2ac5fdc2b42cca8a650f5df.summary: Westport police charged 38-year-old Brooklyn resident John Hammonds with first-degree larceny and third-degree identity theft after an alleged $89,000 unauthorized in-person wire transfer from a victim’s M&T Bank account in January 2025, Patch reported Sept. 30. Investigators said Hammonds posed as the victim at a New York branch; he was extradited from New Jersey after an Aug. 20 custody notice and is held on $70,000 bail, with a Stamford Superior Court date set for Nov. 9.

8958f65a83596b5feb552664558705c60f7dfe03.headline: Tim Scott: MAGA Inc. cash means ‘money will not be our problem’ for Senate GOP
8958f65a83596b5feb552664558705c60f7dfe03.summary: Senate Republican campaign chairman Tim Scott told reporters Wednesday that White House chief of staff Susie Wiles assured GOP senators “money will not be our problem” as MAGA Inc. and allied groups pledge millions more for battleground races ahead of the midterms, the Associated Press reported. Scott said “cash is king” and that “President Trump and his agenda are on the ballot,” while acknowledging closer-than-expected fights in Kansas and more work needed to flip Georgia’s Jon Ossoff seat.

fdd76469ac201f82fa64e487a88f056b89abf603.headline: Trump warns midterm loss means ‘open borders,’ urges Michigan voters to reject El-Sayed
fdd76469ac201f82fa64e487a88f056b89abf603.summary: President Trump on Wednesday urged voters to turn out for Republican candidates even if they are not their favorites, warning that a Democratic midterm win would reopen the border and undo his administration’s immigration gains, Just the News reported. Pointing to Michigan’s open Senate race, he asked whether voters would back “a guy who’s a communist,” an apparent swipe at Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, who is locked in a close contest with former Rep. Mike Rogers for the seat Sen. Gary Peters is leaving.

ece0ed6c6e41436a492b14ca2d6a8b2efbba4763.headline: Trump clashes with DHS’s Mullin after leaked ICE call sparks ‘softening’ scare
ece0ed6c6e41436a492b14ca2d6a8b2efbba4763.summary: A leaked weekend ICE leadership call that some officials read as limiting arrests to criminals set off President Trump, who told Fox News ICE would still arrest anyone in the country illegally and privately vented at DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, CNN reported via KVIA on Sept. 30. DHS denied any soft directive and said “no one is off the table,” while sources said Mullin privately favors dialing back “collateral arrests.” The episode lands weeks before midterms as ICE posted a record ~51,000 August arrests.

5261a2a76f82372f480d574cce16ad05a9a96dfc.headline: October 1 immigration reset: Visa Bulletin moves, Medicaid narrows, social-media screening expands
5261a2a76f82372f480d574cce16ad05a9a96dfc.summary: Fiscal year 2027 opens Oct. 1 with a mixed State Department Visa Bulletin—India EB-2 and unreserved EB-5 final-action dates reopen while some EB-2/EB-3 dates for the rest of the world retrogress—plus tighter federally funded Medicaid/CHIP rules and expanded online-presence checks for I, TN, and TD visa applicants, Newsweek reported Sept. 30. Applicants in those visa classes are told to set social profiles public; former USCIS officials flagged the bulletin’s late release and a missing Diversity Visa section as unsettling for DV lottery filers.

c8d7404092a583a94e55914437159e8b067214e5.headline: Oakland County declines all charges against CPL holder in Great Lakes Crossing mall shooting
c8d7404092a583a94e55914437159e8b067214e5.summary: Oakland County prosecutors declined homicide and all other charges against Detroit CPL holder Amuri Chambers-Shannon in the July 11 fatal food-court shooting at Great Lakes Crossing Outlets that killed 20-year-old KeShawn Emery and wounded a 19-year-old woman, defense attorney Nicholas Somberg announced, New Media Detroit reported Sept. 30. Somberg said video showed his client attacked, knocked down, and assaulted by multiple people before firing; Chambers-Shannon stayed on scene, and Michigan’s no-duty-to-retreat rules framed the self-defense review that closed after more than two months.

ad56b104f0a8e6590e92afa2b6534a34b5975c80.headline: SpaceXAI ships Grokipedia v0.3 with refreshed design; site claims 6M+ AI articles
ad56b104f0a8e6590e92afa2b6534a34b5975c80.summary: SpaceXAI launched Grokipedia v0.3 on Wednesday with a refreshed visual design and new features for its AI-generated encyclopedia alternative to Wikipedia, Tesla North reported. The site says it now hosts more than six million articles; readers suggest corrections that Grok reviews rather than editing pages directly, and Elon Musk has said the project may eventually take the Encyclopedia Galactica name once quality is high enough. The drop continues a rapid cadence after v0.1 and v0.2 in late 2025 and follows Grok 4.7’s recent launch.

7330a7b74ccf250b7822c108c39c852390f69549.headline: Tesla’s Cybercab faces NHTSA Special Order deadline: 21 answers or risk huge fines
7330a7b74ccf250b7822c108c39c852390f69549.summary: Tesla had until Sept. 30 to answer a 21-point NHTSA Special Order explaining how the steering-wheel-free, pedal-free Cybercab meets driver-era FMVSS rules—or face civil penalties up to about $27,874 per day, The Auto Wire reported. The audit opened the day Austin commercial service began; Zoox’s similar self-certification path ended in a Part 555 exemption capped at 2,500 vehicles a year, a ceiling that would clash with Tesla’s plan for Cybercab to become its highest-volume robotaxi. As of Wednesday afternoon neither Tesla nor NHTSA had confirmed a filing.

4bc1d5ea86bf9f3485e62418f250827fb935e012.headline: Jets Week 4 injury report: Hall, Mitchell, Parham, Taylor DNPs; Fitzpatrick limited
