4bc1d5ea86bf9f3485e62418f250827fb935e012.summary: The Jets’ Wednesday injury report ahead of Sunday’s Week 4 trip to Chicago listed Breece Hall (quad), Adonai Mitchell (finger), Dylan Parham (knee), Mason Taylor (thumb), and Kiko Mauigoa (quad) as did-not-participate, while safety Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) was limited after Aaron Glenn said he has a “really good chance” to play, Jets.com posted Sept. 30. Chicago listed QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) among its DNPs, underscoring an uncertain Bears quarterback picture opposite New York’s battered skill-position group.

62e508b1c0ed6d70c933479f6a66a2c009f0acec.headline: LEGO October wave hits shelves: UCS Executor, PlayStation, Downton, Pokémon and more
62e508b1c0ed6d70c933479f6a66a2c009f0acec.summary: Seventeen new LEGO sets went on sale Oct. 1 (with reporting dated Sept. 30) including the 6,130-piece UCS Executor Super Star Destroyer ($799.99) with a Darth Vader lightsaber GWP, the first LEGO PlayStation set plus Astro Bot GWP, Ideas Downton Abbey and Wallace & Gromit, Pokémon Poké Ball and Up-Scaled Red, Icons Book Nook and Holiday House, plus seasonal Christmas builds, Brick Fanatics reported. Four Avengers: Doomsday sets follow on Oct. 4; Spain gets a region-exclusive FIFA World Cup trophy Champions Edition.

4a5a0ef62eb4eaf0828327759e50d47d62111221.headline: Maryland Renaissance Festival’s 50th season runs weekends through Oct. 25 in Crownsville
4a5a0ef62eb4eaf0828327759e50d47d62111221.summary: The Maryland Renaissance Festival continues its 50th season in Crownsville’s Revel Grove every weekend through Oct. 25, open 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. with more than 200 performers, three daily combat jousts, 140-plus merchants, and a 1540 storyline starring Henry VIII and Anne of Cleves as the village’s royal charter hangs in the balance, Eye On Annapolis reported Sept. 30. Tickets are online-only and can sell out; cash is required for beverages and games.

2ea37ae47899cb9dcbb2ced093a6a8cd51f69bb8.headline: Fairfield starts $8.2M Rooster River flood basins at Fairchild Wheeler and Tunxis Hill
2ea37ae47899cb9dcbb2ced093a6a8cd51f69bb8.summary: Fairfield began the first phases of an $8.2 million Rooster River flood-mitigation effort this week, with Grasso Construction starting a detention basin at Fairchild Wheeler Golf Course in coordination with Bridgeport and survey staking under way for a second basin at Tunxis Hill Park, Patch reported Sept. 30. Funding mixes Urban Act and Clean Water grants with town bonding; substantial flood benefit is targeted by year-end and final completion in spring 2027, while Selectpersons meet Oct. 1 on re-awarding Tunxis Hill after Grasso sought to withdraw its bid.

678f75103138eb8ac2a05cf286742894311aed7d.headline: Westport’s Compo Beach dog rules return Oct. 1 through March 2027
678f75103138eb8ac2a05cf286742894311aed7d.summary: Seasonal dog rules at Westport’s Compo Beach take effect Thursday, Oct. 1, and run through March 31, 2027, Patch reported. Dogs are barred from the pavilion, playground, and walkways; they must be leashed everywhere except the posted off-leash beach south of the pavilion, including South Beach. Owners must pick up waste, violations carry a $77 fine, and animals remain banned from Westport athletic fields and playgrounds year-round, including all of Luciano Park.

110b3e21ab508b36e62ff2b4c583697fdea7fb67.headline: Stamford speed cameras go live in October at 14 school-zone spots
110b3e21ab508b36e62ff2b4c583697fdea7fb67.summary: Stamford’s automated speed cameras will become operational in October at 14 locations across seven school zones, Mayor Caroline Simmons announced, Patch reported Sept. 30. An exact start date is still pending. Tickets apply when drivers exceed the posted limit by 11 mph or more; a 45-day warning period comes first, then $50 for a first offense and $75 for later ones, with no license points or insurance hits. Camera streets cover Cloonan, Dolan, Springdale, Toquam, Stamford High, Julia A. Stark, K.T. Murphy, and Strawberry Hill school areas.

991e8baa7aad945be2256a183409c09ce9144c35.headline: Trump and Vance open midterm blitz in deep-red Texas, Oklahoma, and Florida
991e8baa7aad945be2256a183409c09ce9144c35.summary: President Trump’s Thursday Texas and Oklahoma stops kick off a self-described 32-day midterm blitz through Nov. 3, while Vice President JD Vance stumps in Florida, the Associated Press reported via WTOP. Trump tours a Denton truck plant tied to Sen. hopeful Ken Paxton’s race, then rallies in Durant for Oklahoma gubernatorial nominee Mike Mazzei; aides say red-state stops also hit Dallas–Fort Worth and Florida panhandle media markets. Trump blamed messaging—“We’re not getting the word out”—as Republicans worry about costs, gas prices, and the Iran war.

0ac887039f1b623c1d09385db38b913bd29012b9.headline: DHS: Fairfax released Honduran child-sex suspect despite ICE detainer; ICE rearrests him
0ac887039f1b623c1d09385db38b913bd29012b9.summary: ICE rearrested Honduran national Oscar Evaristo Nunez on Sept. 15 after Fairfax County, Virginia, released him despite an ICE detainer, DHS said, Fox News reported Sept. 30. Nunez had been arrested Aug. 27, 2025, on aggravated sexual battery involving children and nonconsensual filming of a minor; DHS said he illegally entered near Arizona around 2003 and remains in ICE custody. Secretary Markwayne Mullin blasted “sanctuary politicians,” while Fairfax did not immediately comment and Gov. Abigail Spanberger has rolled back some state ICE 287(g) cooperation since January.

13fbb635ac0840390c85b6288a077d5f694ff3a5.headline: White House drops CNN from TV press pool for Trump’s Texas–Oklahoma trip
13fbb635ac0840390c85b6288a077d5f694ff3a5.summary: The White House removed CNN from Thursday’s television press-pool duty for President Trump’s Denton, Texas, and Durant, Oklahoma, trip even though Sunday’s rotation had listed the network, Mediaite reported Oct. 1. The switch comes days after a federal judge temporarily restored White House-grounds access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, without expressly covering Air Force One or travel-pool slots. CNN was similarly blocked from a Tennessee AF1 pool last weekend; counsel Theodore Boutrous again called the broader ban a First Amendment and due-process violation.

95e9ecc430bb4c6ca6fec9ef51fca63a91222f73.headline: Penguins steamroll Flyers 7–0 in season opener; Silovs earns shutout
95e9ecc430bb4c6ca6fec9ef51fca63a91222f73.summary: Nicholas Robertson scored twice in his Penguins debut and Arturs Silovs stopped 19 shots as Pittsburgh blanked Philadelphia 7–0 in both clubs’ opener Wednesday at Xfinity Mobile Arena, NHL.com reported Oct. 1. Filip Hallander had a goal and two assists; Hendrix Lapierre, Ville Koivunen, Evgeni Malkin, and Egor Chinakhov also scored, with Malkin reaching 100 career points against the Flyers. Sidney Crosby called it the “right mentality” on the road; the win tied Pittsburgh’s biggest shutout of Philadelphia and lifted Crosby–Malkin–Letang to a record 494 regular-season wins together.

5c2c396b53aa9e6f7df80efd00622a5b0d39f643.headline: Jets–Bears Week 4: Hall, Mitchell, Taylor, Parham doubtful; Fitzpatrick questionable
5c2c396b53aa9e6f7df80efd00622a5b0d39f643.summary: Ahead of Sunday’s 1 p.m. ET FOX game at Soldier Field, NBC Sports lists Jets RB Breece Hall (thigh), WR Adonai Mitchell (finger), TE Mason Taylor (thumb), and LG Dylan Parham as doubtful, with S Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) and LB Kiko Mauigoa (quad) questionable. Chicago’s Caleb Williams (hamstring) is also doubtful, pushing Tyson Bagent into the likely start after Case Keenum’s win over Philadelphia. Geno Smith has opened 783 yards, 4 TDs, and 0 INTs; markets have the Bears around −3.5 / −175 with a total near 42.5.

25e1211b9ef0fb820a456593901ce913373b74b7.headline: Apple Mail on Mac may stop syncing Microsoft 365 as Exchange EWS goes dark
25e1211b9ef0fb820a456593901ce913373b74b7.summary: Microsoft began disabling Exchange Web Services by default in Exchange Online on Oct. 1, cutting the protocol Apple Mail and Calendar on Mac still use for many Microsoft 365 work accounts, MacRumors reported. Organizations that keep EWS enabled are unaffected for now; Microsoft plans a permanent EWS shutdown April 1, 2027. Apple says it is working with Microsoft on Graph API support in a future macOS 27 update that has not shipped yet. iPhone and iPad keep working via Exchange ActiveSync; IT can re-enable EWS or move Mac users to Outlook.

e76ac9385030a8ab336b908d7d2b1c98bd0497a8.headline: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 set for 11:10 a.m. ET liftoff to the space station
e76ac9385030a8ab336b908d7d2b1c98bd0497a8.summary: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13—astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, CSA’s Joshua Kutryk, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov—is targeting an 11:10 a.m. ET Falcon 9 / Dragon launch from Cape Canaveral SLC-40 on Oct. 1, NASA’s commercial crew blog said. Weather was only about 40% favorable at the pad (cumulus, thick layers, precipitation). The crew will join Expedition 75 for roughly six months of research spanning stem-cell tissues, crop production, and medical diagnostics as Commercial Crew keeps private U.S. rides to the ISS running.

8ed56fdf024534fe437d206f4cf3b38abcc43cbf.headline: SpaceX Transporter-18 lofting Google’s Project Suncatcher AI satellite today
8ed56fdf024534fe437d206f4cf3b38abcc43cbf.summary: SpaceX’s Transporter-18 rideshare is scheduled for Oct. 1 from Vandenberg during a window opening at 2:18 p.m. ET, carrying 130 payloads including Google’s Project Suncatcher pathfinder to test TPUs in orbit for radiation and thermal performance, Space.com reported. Cowboy Space’s Reason-1 power-beaming demo and Starfish Space’s first Otter servicing satellite also fly. The Falcon 9 booster targets a Vandenberg landing on its 25th flight; SpaceX also planned Crew-13 and an NROL-97 Falcon Heavy the same day.

d170dbaec0b1c8974c161c1ec853f1112710f123.headline: Insta360 eyes smart glasses and two mirrorless cameras beyond 360 gear
d170dbaec0b1c8974c161c1ec853f1112710f123.summary: Insta360 cofounder Max Richter told The Verge the company is experimentally building smart glasses aimed at convenient high-quality capture rather than an on-face AI assistant, Photography Talk summarized Sept. 30. Founder JK Liu previously confirmed two mirrorless cameras in development—one with an unusual shape—and floated a possible CP+ 2027 prototype. Insta360 holds about 73% of worldwide 360-camera shipments and has opened a Times Square flagship, while stressing it is distancing from drone brand Antigravity amid U.S. ban risk; no glasses or mirrorless names, prices, or ship dates are announced.

89b6cc0b21cc2e6962188ad7ebc083b8e7dea880.headline: Canon RF 90mm f/2.8 IS STM Macro reportedly next—budget 1:1 alternative to the L
89b6cc0b21cc2e6962188ad7ebc083b8e7dea880.summary: Canon Rumors points to an upcoming RF 90mm f/2.8 IS STM Macro as a non-L, mid-tier 1:1 option versus the ~$1,300 RF 100mm f/2.8L Macro, The Phoblographer reported Sept. 25. Patent-linked designs suggest a compact ~100 mm length with moving middle groups for life-size magnification, aimed at hobbyists and APS-C shooters (~144 mm equivalent). No price or date is official; some fans still want a longer RF 180mm macro instead of another mid-tele STM.

62f54922bf652e9fbdafaa53af2d98a52a8258ed.headline: Idaho Renaissance Faire’s ‘Festival of Fools’ returns to Meridian Oct. 10–11
62f54922bf652e9fbdafaa53af2d98a52a8258ed.summary: The nonprofit Idaho Renaissance Faire returns to 6054 W. Cherry Lane in Meridian Oct. 10–11 from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. with an Italian Renaissance “Festival of Fools” theme, Idaho News 6 reported Sept. 25. Organizers promise live performers, vendors, characters, and the expected turkey legs while raising money for local arts and theater programs. Costumes are welcome but not required; tickets and details are on the faire’s website.

c073d6807dd1497e66e083093818f8074f0423f8.headline: Five Finger Death Punch marks 20 years in Austin with Cody Jinks and Eva Under Fire
c073d6807dd1497e66e083093818f8074f0423f8.summary: Five Finger Death Punch’s 20th-anniversary stop at Germania Insurance Amphitheater in Austin on Monday mixed new Legacy material with catalog staples, Maxazine’s live review said Sept. 30. Eva Under Fire opened and Cody Jinks mid-billed before FFDP opened with “Welcome to the Circus,” stacked “Eye of the Storm” and “Legacy,” and closed with “The Bleeding.” Moody quipped they’d tour with anyone “who isn’t going to have Beyoncé on their next record” as the North American leg continues into late October.

d35e93e89a392a4ab1125c78589b6b0d63645e0d.headline: Blue Ridge Parkway fall drive: elevation timing, Mabry Mill, and Linn Cove tips
d35e93e89a392a4ab1125c78589b6b0d63645e0d.summary: TourMe’s 2026 Blue Ridge Parkway guide notes the free 469-mile ridge road from Shenandoah to the Smokies sees two to three million October drivers, with color peaking first above 5,000 feet in late September and mid-elevations around Oct. 8–15. Practical tips cover 45 mph pacing, sunrise fog at Craggy Gardens and Waterrock Knob, Mabry Mill’s living-history millpond photos (peak ~Oct. 15–22), and the Linn Cove Viaduct’s top-down engineering story. Detours to Floyd, Blowing Rock, and Asheville round out a leaf-peeping plan beyond overlook selfies.

19e79e9f8507b42794a506c1a4aa44e811a3fd97.headline: LEGO October wave now live worldwide—Astro Bot GWP and Star Wars 2× points
19e79e9f8507b42794a506c1a4aa44e811a3fd97.summary: Jay’s Brick Blog confirmed Oct. 1 that LEGO’s October wave is live worldwide, including Holiday House, Bookshop: Book Nook, Wallace & Gromit, Downton Abbey, PlayStation, UCS Executor, Pokémon Poké Ball, Wednesday, and Avengers: Doomsday sets. Shoppers spending over $150 through Oct. 7 can claim the Astro Bot gift-with-purchase while stocks last; Executor buyers get Darth Vader’s Lightsaber GWP through Oct. 10, and selected Star Wars sets (not Executor) earn 2× Insiders points. Popular early picks flagged include Wallace & Gromit, PlayStation, Holiday House, and Doomsday Epic Battle.

0b870a171aac63689d60faa1e53a96ca54bedd95.headline: Trumbull Congregational Church hosts Blessing of the Animals on Oct. 4
0b870a171aac63689d60faa1e53a96ca54bedd95.summary: Trumbull Congregational Church will again welcome pets for a Blessing of the Animals on Sunday, Oct. 4, at 3 p.m. outdoors at 3115 Reservoir Avenue. Pastor Todd Shipley will lead the ceremony with his dachshund, Henry Houndsworth Longfellow. Owners can receive a paw-print certificate with a modest donation, browse pet toys and treats from Fairfield nonprofit Team Woofgang & Co., and enjoy refreshments, a bake sale, and live music. The event is open to all local residents; contact the church at office@trumbullcc.org or (203) 268-2433 for details.

b5fd9d8a810a33492c61cfd11a005e8e2532c165.headline: Fairfield hosts e-bike safety panel tonight at Ludlowe High School
b5fd9d8a810a33492c61cfd11a005e8e2532c165.summary: The Fairfield Safe Streets Alliance is holding a free community panel on e-bike rules, crash prevention, and shared-road safety Thursday, Oct. 1, from 7 to 8:30 p.m. at Fairfield Ludlowe High School. First Selectperson Christine Vitale said teens are riding more but may not know road rules, and residents worry about rider and driver safety. Speakers include police Sgt. Michael Komm, ER physician Dr. Douglas Latham, and crash survivors John Bysiewicz and Jenny Glass, followed by public Q&A and info tables from police, fire, hospitals, and bike groups. No taxpayer dollars fund the MetroCOG-supported campaign.

3729fcade7f35ce656b0c6ea7af5deced9adb8f0.headline: Supreme Court will hear Trump’s mandatory ICE detention-without-bond policy
3729fcade7f35ce656b0c6ea7af5deced9adb8f0.summary: The Supreme Court said Thursday it will decide whether the Trump administration can hold tens of thousands of immigrants in removal proceedings without bond hearings. The case, Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha, challenges ICE’s mandatory detention policy for people in the U.S. illegally, including longtime residents without criminal records. Appeals courts are split—two allow detention without bond, nine require bond eligibility for some detainees. The lead plaintiff, a Brazilian asylum applicant with a work permit, was released after a New York judge ordered a hearing; the Second Circuit called the policy the broadest mass-detention-without-bond mandate in U.S. history. Arguments come in the new term starting Monday.

f0dbbe2f73b3f5b06d9c79ecc8207d277e258730.headline: Penguins’ 7–0 Flyers rout sets franchise records and Silovs milestone
f0dbbe2f73b3f5b06d9c79ecc8207d277e258730.summary: Pittsburgh’s 7–0 season-opening win in Philadelphia was more than a blowout: historian Bob Grove noted it was the Penguins’ largest margin over the Flyers in Philly and their most decisive opener since 1995. Arturs Silovs became the first Penguins goalie with consecutive season-opening shutouts after blanking the Rangers last year. Sidney Crosby’s assist pushed him to an NHL-record 140 regular-season points against Philly; Evgeni Malkin’s power-play goal was his 100th point versus the Flyers. Debutant Nick Robertson scored twice, including his first career shorthanded goal. Home opener: Canadiens on Saturday at PPG Paints Arena.

ec4e48cd53570eb0dbceebf7b4cb9fd4f87dde70.headline: Jets sign OL Kohl Levao to the active roster ahead of Bears week
ec4e48cd53570eb0dbceebf7b4cb9fd4f87dde70.summary: Before Thursday’s practice, the Jets signed offensive lineman Kohl Levao (6-6, 350) from the practice squad to the 53-man roster. The Hawaii product played all three preseason games and spent most of last season on the practice squad after time with the USFL’s San Antonio Brahmas. New York also returned CB Jordan Clark and K Blake Grupe to the practice squad and released S John Saunders Jr. Grupe previously hit all 11 field goals for Indianapolis late in 2025, including a 60-yarder. The moves come as the Jets prepare for Chicago amid a heavy Week 4 injury list.

e4ef0da475086a1ce52efa20f9ea76fcaea46ee6.headline: Apple Stores get ‘Do Not Open Until October 8’ boxes ahead of smart-home launch
e4ef0da475086a1ce52efa20f9ea76fcaea46ee6.summary: Apple retail stores worldwide received confidential merchandise boxes stamped “Do Not Open Until October 8,” MacRumors verified Thursday. The materials are expected to prep displays for a rumored Oct. 13 smart-home push: a new hub device, an updated HomePod mini, and a new Apple TV 4K, following Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. The boxes could relate to iPhone Duo marketing, but timing and secrecy point more toward the hub trio that would need floor updates if announced the week of Oct. 5. Exact announcement versus on-sale timing for Oct. 13 remains unclear.

a75b8f17048c009abab897814a60c770e149a02d.headline: SpaceX Crew-13 lifts off for the ISS aboard Dragon Grace
a75b8f17048c009abab897814a60c770e149a02d.summary: Despite thunderstorm and wind concerns, SpaceX launched NASA’s Crew-13 mission Thursday from Cape Canaveral. Falcon 9 lofted Dragon capsule Grace with NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, CSA’s Joshua Kutryk, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov for up to six months on the International Space Station. Docking is expected about eight hours after liftoff. Watkins is on her second flight; Delaney, Kutryk, and Teteryatnikov are first-timers. The mission slipped from mid-September after an oxidizer leak during processing. Crew-13 will relieve Crew-12, due to splash down off Southern California next week.

0116b7d6627b01bc3ca9d1bb4b7c20eac5e5c681.headline: Tesla 2026.38 sharpens HW3 visuals and adds dynamic headlight leveling
0116b7d6627b01bc3ca9d1bb4b7c20eac5e5c681.summary: Tesla began rolling out software 2026.38 to Hardware 3 cars, with sharper on-screen vehicle visualizations for AMD Ryzen-equipped HW3 models and Dynamic Headlight Leveling for matrix-LED low beams that aim using vision AI. The headlight feature overlaps NHTSA recall 26V507 covering about 19,900 Model 3 and Y vehicles for low-beam glare; older cars without matrix LEDs still need a physical fix, and owner letters started Sept. 15. Early fleet data showed under 1% on the build. The update also includes security fixes; Intel Atom HW3 cars miss the sharper graphics.

9b333398883664dc1682fc22765f915875de5423.headline: Canon patents wild RF zooms—including a constant f/6.3 180–600mm
9b333398883664dc1682fc22765f915875de5423.summary: Canon Rumors highlighted patent filings for ambitious full-frame RF zooms: a 70–135mm f/2L IS, a 200–400mm f/4L IS, and a standout 180–600mm f/6.3L IS. Designs emphasize internal zoom with a stationary front group so less heavy glass moves, potentially faster zoom action and better sealing. The 180–600 would give Canon zoom reach where Sony and Nikon offer 600mm f/6.3 primes. Patents are not product announcements—Canon could alter or shelve them—but they sit alongside other recent fast-zoom concepts, including a previously reported 20–60mm f/2L.

0a724c30a675a33edb42b68849ba7a4ed8ad5d1a.headline: 2027 Jeep Cherokee Trailhawk earns Trail Rated status with locker and low range
0a724c30a675a33edb42b68849ba7a4ed8ad5d1a.summary: Jeep unveiled the 2027 Cherokee Trailhawk this week, finally giving the hybrid Cherokee Trail Rated hardware: a locking rear axle, two-speed transfer case (2.92:1 low / 37.5:1 crawl), nine inches of ground clearance, 245/65R17 all-terrains, and steel skid plates including hybrid-battery protection. Approach, departure, and breakover angles are claimed best-in-class, with 24-inch wading depth. Power stays 210 hp / 230 lb-ft turbo-hybrid with E-CVT and EPA estimates of 33/29/31 mpg. Pricing starts at $44,625 including destination; order books are open, production later this year.

f6735beb599837b51c4992f9d45cbb1982f4c2bd.headline: Texas Renaissance Festival’s 52nd season opens Oct. 10 under new ownership
f6735beb599837b51c4992f9d45cbb1982f4c2bd.summary: The Texas Renaissance Festival in Todd Mission opens Oct. 10 for weekends through Nov. 29 plus Black Friday—its first full season after founder George Coulam’s 2025 death and a court-ordered $60 million sale to investor Meril Rivard. Operators say the on-ground experience stays familiar under the “Magic and Memories” theme: 21 stages, nearly 500 shops, jousting, and themed weekends from Oktoberfest to Celtic Christmas. The Fields of New Market campgrounds span 230+ acres; SH 249’s Grimes County extension eases access. Tickets are date-specific; prop weapons must be sheathed and peace-tied.

f9b8875d7c03e92bd799876371c86aa9b6cf2fef.headline: LEGO UCS Executor review: 6,130 pieces, 53.5 inches—longer than a dining table
f9b8875d7c03e92bd799876371c86aa9b6cf2fef.summary: GamesRadar’s hands-on review of LEGO Star Wars 75457 Executor Super Star Destroyer calls the $799.99 / 6,130-piece UCS set the longest LEGO Star Wars model ever at 53.5 inches (136 cm). The ~15-hour build improves on 2011’s 10221 with ILM-accurate proportions, unique printed “light opening” tiles, zero stickers, and all six Empire Strikes Back bounty hunters plus Vader—though Admiral Piett is missing. Verdict: a gold-standard UCS if you can afford the price and shelf space; weak spots include no interior and some delicate panelling.

2897113dc86bf4bbe502b6bfbae54f4735e8765e.headline: Shenandoah fall travel: weekday tips, Skyline Drive entrances, and color updates
2897113dc86bf4bbe502b6bfbae54f4735e8765e.summary: Shenandoah National Park’s fall season runs late September through November, with cool days (roughly 49–60°F) and heavy weekend crowds. NPS urges buying entrance passes ahead, arriving midweek, and using southern entrances (Swift Run or Rockfish) when Front Royal and Thornton Gap back up. Campgrounds and lodges book out months ahead; first-come sites often fill by Thursday evening. Old Rag parking is limited on October Saturdays. Weekly Thursday fall-update videos plus valley and Big Meadows webcams help track color across the park’s 100-mile, multi-elevation stretch—peak timing can’t be pinned to one day.

204e3c910b79776d11132ad9b855d962a8bbe368.headline: Gurman: touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro could arrive as early as October
204e3c910b79776d11132ad9b855d962a8bbe368.summary: On Bloomberg’s Power On podcast Thursday, Mark Gurman said he believes Apple will introduce its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models this fall—“as early as October,” possibly slipping to November. The 14- and 16-inch machines are rumored with OLED touch displays, M5 Pro/Max chips, a thinner chassis, and a Dynamic Island instead of a notch, tested on macOS 27.2 (expected late October). They would sit above regular MacBook Pros slated for M7 next year; branding could stay MacBook Pro or shift to something like MacBook Ultra. Cellular Mac hopes remain speculative.

78965deb21b662f84599c371524e5d8cb275acaf.headline: Trumbull man charged in Shelton armed robbery with facsimile firearm
78965deb21b662f84599c371524e5d8cb275acaf.summary: Shelton police say Paulo Dias, 54, of Trumbull, entered a Howe Avenue business Wednesday carrying what appeared to be a black firearm, pointed it at a cashier’s head, and fled with cash after the clerk complied. Detectives arrested him about seven hours later and recovered clothing believed worn in the robbery, gloves, stolen money, and a facsimile firearm. Dias faces first-degree robbery, fourth-degree larceny, possession of a controlled substance, illegal use of a facsimile firearm, criminal possession of a firearm, and first-degree threatening. He is held on $750,000 bond pending a court appearance. Patch posted the free write-up Thursday afternoon.

260aaf71744e2bd306883d34e804f64156eb2304.headline: Westport’s Slice of Saugatuck festival returns Saturday with traffic advisory
260aaf71744e2bd306883d34e804f64156eb2304.summary: The Westport-Weston Chamber of Commerce’s 14th annual Slice of Saugatuck Festival runs Saturday, Oct. 3, from 2 to 5 p.m., with restaurants, shops, and galleries opening for community sampling. Railroad Place closes noon–6 p.m. from Riverside to Franklin; the east side of Riverside from Charles to Bridge is a temporary no-parking zone. Organizers promise seven bands, dance demos, kids’ activities including bounce houses and the Fire Department antique engine, plus beer/wine gardens and s’mores. Saugatuck Station lots (except Lot 2) are open for parking; police will assist with heavy pedestrian traffic near the station.

8b20b63f68cfbd0efa371ac57a725c6db81a89a6.headline: ICE memo bans vehicle pursuits, mandates body cams and stop training
8b20b63f68cfbd0efa371ac57a725c6db81a89a6.summary: An internal ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations memo obtained by the Associated Press orders officers not to chase vehicles that fail to pull over “under any circumstances,” instead logging plates for later investigation. Only officers who finished one of five agency training courses may run traditional or high-risk vehicle stops; untrained officers may ride only in support. Field directors must equip stop cars with lights and sirens, and every officer on scene must activate a body-worn camera. Pinning and spike strips remain allowed for specially trained agents. The guidance follows fatal ICE vehicle-stop shootings in Texas and Maine and Austin courtroom testimony that officers in a recent pursuit lacked active cameras.

cfc655d6caf86e4d2e3853620459a0ec738a803a.headline: Doocy asks Trump why he’s still stumping for Paxton after convention gripe
cfc655d6caf86e4d2e3853620459a0ec738a803a.summary: Before Trump’s Texas–Oklahoma midterm swing, Fox’s Peter Doocy asked why the president would campaign for Texas AG Ken Paxton after audio obtained by the New York Times caught Paxton saying the GOP midterm convention “dropped our numbers.” Trump called the Dallas convention a “tremendous success,” citing 107 million views versus about 24 million for the NFL that night, and said Texas has “been great to me.” He framed the Durant, Oklahoma stop as thanking a state where he won all 77 counties three times and boosting the governor’s race, while still backing Paxton: “We have to win this election.”

e442f02e702c86b8f4ce346734cb3c00fb2a71ba.headline: White House runs taxpayer-funded Trump ads on CNN and MS NOW anyway
e442f02e702c86b8f4ce346734cb3c00fb2a71ba.summary: Even as the White House fights CNN and MS NOW over press access—including dropping CNN from Thursday’s Texas–Oklahoma pool—AdImpact data show the administration has aired at least 10 Trump ads on CNN and 38 on MS NOW, part of roughly $2.87 million in taxpayer-funded TV spots. The “Paid for by the U.S. Government” spots attack “communism, socialism and Marxism,” “fake news,” “globalists,” and the “deep state.” The White House calls them patriotic PSAs; Rep. Jamie Raskin alleges Hatch Act and possible conversion issues ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms. MS NOW said the spots ran in select local markets and that accepting ads is not an endorsement.

be6d9ae881a852317eb2f6b2b207419f02d7b19a.headline: Penguins’ young depth powers 7–0 opener blueprint, NHL.com argues
be6d9ae881a852317eb2f6b2b207419f02d7b19a.summary: Beyond the box score, Dan Rosen’s NHL.com feature frames Pittsburgh’s 7–0 Flyers rout as the depth blueprint GM Kyle Dubas demanded: mid-20s forwards and defensemen must carry load alongside Crosby, Malkin, Letang, and Karlsson. Debutants Nicholas Robertson (two goals), Hendrix Lapierre (goal, assist), and Kaedan Korczak (two assists) combined for six points; Filip Hallander returned from a blood-clot layoff with a goal and two assists; Ville Koivunen scored on a breakaway; Arturs Silovs blanked Philly for a second straight opener shutout. Coach Dan Muse and Crosby praised the newcomers’ comfort. Next: home opener vs. Montreal Saturday.

1034879a261028a525f4ce9da42a4d0a23d1626f.headline: Jets–Bears Week 4: Hall expected out; Fitzpatrick expected; Williams won’t play
1034879a261028a525f4ce9da42a4d0a23d1626f.summary: Wednesday’s dual injury reports clarify Sunday’s outlook in Chicago. New York listed Breece Hall, AD Mitchell, Mason Taylor, Dylan Parham, and Kiko Mauigoa as DNPs, with Hall expected to miss Week 4; Minkah Fitzpatrick was limited and is expected to play. Chicago kept QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) and OT Braxton Jones out of practice, with Williams ruled out, while CB Kyler Gordon returned as a full participant. That points Braelon Allen and Isaiah Davis toward larger Jets run-game roles against a Bears defense without its starter behind center.

7a940037fcba71c5a7500e37de6577e057f7e4d3.headline: Apple’s rumored Home Hub may ship in four colors, including Rose Pink
7a940037fcba71c5a7500e37de6577e057f7e4d3.summary: Leaker “pdfu” says Apple’s long-rumored smart home hub—expected for an Oct. 13 unveil—may offer Silver, Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose Pink. MacRumors’ Aaron Perris previously found the same four finishes in macOS 26.7 RC code; Photo Face setup previews reportedly switch art by reported hardware color. Mark Gurman had described only a standard gray aluminum finish for the ~6-inch square tabletop/wall hub with iMac G4-style arm and speaker base, so the extra colors remain unconfirmed. The piece is distinct from Thursday’s “Do Not Open” retail-box and OLED MacBook timing reports.

eda71251fa96a40f77a677414521b196028d00fe.headline: SpaceXAI ships Grok for Intune—enterprise iOS app with MDM controls
eda71251fa96a40f77a677414521b196028d00fe.summary: Following OpenAI’s enterprise mobile split, SpaceXAI launched Grok for Intune on the App Store—the Microsoft Intune edition of Grok built for organizations that manage apps and data with Intune. It supports Mobile Application Management, honors save/share/data-transfer policies, and signs in with work email with no in-app purchases. Features mirror consumer Grok: deep research, document/photo analysis, Grok Imagine image and short-video generation, Voice Mode with Live Camera, and real-time web/X context. IT teams deploy and configure it through Intune for managed devices.

09ce1a312c9a08231d47f455a5453b81a3f30e0e.headline: Musk’s Colossus cluster races past a gigawatt toward 1.2 million Nvidia chips
09ce1a312c9a08231d47f455a5453b81a3f30e0e.summary: Drawing on Musk’s late-September X post and Epoch AI modeling, WebProNews details Colossus 2 near Memphis already running hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GB200/GB300 accelerators, with tranches aiming past 1.2 million processors by year-end if networking and power cooperate. The campus draws roughly a gigawatt of IT load, bridged by temporary turbines and a huge Tesla Megapack battery farm while a permanent Southaven gas plant finishes. Google, Anthropic, and another unnamed customer have multi-billion-dollar hosting deals; Epoch pegs capital sunk near $36B. Regulators want temporary turbines gone by mid-2027 amid noise and emissions complaints.

7da6284439349de9b1fe7912ee453c85c3d0c919.headline: Giga Texas Optimus factory steel frame nearly complete in Oct. 1 drone footage
7da6284439349de9b1fe7912ee453c85c3d0c919.summary: Drone footage from aerial documentarian Joe Tegtmeyer on Oct. 1 shows Tesla’s dedicated Optimus factory steel skeleton at Giga Texas’s North Campus nearly closing its final column grids, with upper-floor concrete pours underway. Ground broke March 23; first steel rose May 27—an aggressive ~18-week structural push aimed at shell closeout before year-end and high-volume production targeted for summer 2027. Basenor notes Fremont already runs early Gen 3 Optimus learning units while Texas is sized for multi-million-unit ambition inside a multi-billion-dollar North Campus expansion that also includes chip and AI compute halls.

f0c35a71151f41e6a14d3ae15eb6ae0928c5bcd5.headline: Rita Haney: five unseen Dimebag guitar body designs may finally surface
f0c35a71151f41e6a14d3ae15eb6ae0928c5bcd5.summary: In a new Guitar World interview published Oct. 1, Dimebag Darrell’s longtime partner and estate trustee Rita Haney says the late Pantera guitarist left five body-shape designs “that no one has seen,” which she is about to share with original Dean collaborator Dean Zelinsky for her Dime Guitarz venture. After a court left Stealth and Razorback with Dean Guitars—now on appeal—Haney is mining Dimebag’s notes; Dime Guitarz already launched the Culprit based on a late-’90s Washburn concept. She wants the brand known for pointy guitars across genres and is also working with tech Grady Champion on Warhead Amps.

48a6016a1a6b82c86ff0b71a339f2d644887f033.headline: New York foliage report: Adirondacks near peak this weekend; Catskills mid-change
48a6016a1a6b82c86ff0b71a339f2d644887f033.summary: New York’s third weekly state foliage report, summarized Oct. 1, puts the Adirondacks at or near peak for the weekend—Old Forge ~80%, Lake Placid/Whiteface/Newcomb ~75%, Tupper Lake ~85%—with vivid reds, golds, and oranges. Catskills and Capital Region spots range from mid-change (Belleayre ~65%, Windham upper elevations up to 80%) to earlier yellows farther south. Hudson Valley and Long Island remain mostly early (often under 20–40%), so leaf-peepers chasing peak color should aim north this weekend while southern tiers still green up.

e7886abd75f35fbf8c52e0c27eabe07e15c14a7d.headline: Westport issues RFP to replace flood-damaged Jesup Road Bridge
e7886abd75f35fbf8c52e0c27eabe07e15c14a7d.summary: Westport’s Public Works Department opened an expedited request for proposals for engineering and design to replace the Jesup Road Bridge at Imperial Avenue after Sept. 13 flooding left the span closed to cars and pedestrians. Proposals are due Oct. 28; the Board of Finance is set to consider a $172,500 design-and-permitting appropriation on Oct. 7 after RTM committees recommended the spend. First Selectman Kevin Christie said the town is advancing engineering, permitting, and funding in parallel, while officials also weigh whether a temporary bridge would be prudent. EMS test routes found the closure does not significantly slow ambulance response, Patch reported Thursday afternoon.

033fef6b738845771cd0557e2156041f91c4624d.headline: Westport RTM committees back $185K Plan of Conservation and Development
033fef6b738845771cd0557e2156041f91c4624d.summary: Westport’s RTM Finance and Environment committees voted 10–0 Tuesday to advance $185,000 so Planning and Zoning can hire BFJ Planning for a new ten-year Plan of Conservation and Development due by October 2027. Director Michelle Perillie said the rewrite will tackle affordable and senior housing, sea-level rise, flood resilience after the Sept. 13 storm that wrecked Jesup Road Bridge, infrastructure impacts, and the town’s net-zero-by-2050 goal. Unlike the 2017 plan, consultants plan farmer’s-market and neighborhood outreach instead of library-only forums. The full 36-member RTM still must approve the appropriation.

37b4f662f3d276fcc8e76eb7ed85094029d867b0.headline: Trump dismisses midterm polls as ‘fake numbers,’ won’t rule out emergency powers
37b4f662f3d276fcc8e76eb7ed85094029d867b0.summary: In a Time magazine interview published Thursday, President Trump brushed off low approval ratings as “fake numbers,” claimed he would beat anyone running today by 20 points, and refused to rule out declaring a state of emergency before the midterms—“I don’t rule anything out or in.” He also said he “could use” the Insurrection Act and voiced regret over appointing Justices Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett for voting against him “too often.” On the Iran war, Trump blamed the press for how his earlier “weeks” timelines were heard and said he could have ended the conflict sooner but wanted to “go further.” The free Guardian write-up pairs the quotes with AP/NORC polling showing weak job and economy approval.

b6ee76552627fb093f69c166aa98572a0aafa7cc.headline: Rain-soaked crowds line up in Durant for Trump’s first Oklahoma rally in six years
b6ee76552627fb093f69c166aa98572a0aafa7cc.summary: Supporters began lining up outside Durant’s Choctaw Event Center around noon Thursday and waited in heavy rain for President Trump’s first Oklahoma campaign stop since 2020. Doors opened mid-afternoon with remarks set for 6 p.m. ET as Trump traveled from Denton, Texas, on the opening leg of a red-state midterm blitz. Local attendee Bonnie Couch told KHBS the president “stands up for those who stay silent.” The free Fort Smith–area newscast covers logistics, weather, and GOP candidates scheduled to speak alongside Trump.

6eb600f7483dbf59729a2979240d56a0bf5cd255.headline: Trump defends taxpayer-funded TV ads as ‘for the country,’ not campaigns
6eb600f7483dbf59729a2979240d56a0bf5cd255.summary: Facing ethics pushback, President Trump told Oval Office reporters Wednesday the White House’s taxpayer-funded TV spots promote “the spirit of our country,” not candidates—“I’m not promoting myself because I’m not running for office.” AdImpact pegs at least $2.5 million already aired, with $20 million allocated from DHS; a fourth ad mixes Iran-war military footage with Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth audio. Senate Majority Leader John Thune said he likes the message but not the taxpayer tab, while FCC Chair Brendan Carr dismissed calls for review as ordinary PSAs. Democrats Murray, Murphy, Raskin, and Whitesides are pressing watchdogs over alleged propaganda rules.

3c4dfe7f8e975523c0756859b514a1808af71bdd.headline: DeKalb neighbor shoots machete-wielding man who kicked apartment doors
3c4dfe7f8e975523c0756859b514a1808af71bdd.summary: DeKalb County residents say a man with a machete went door-to-door late Wednesday kicking apartments and yelling threats; 74-year-old Ms. Brown said she braced her door with a sofa after repeated blows and believed he was enraged by a cross she displayed outside. Another tenant shot the intruder after he allegedly forced entry; investigators said the suspect’s wounds were non-life-threatening and no other injuries were reported. Brown told WSB she was “terrified beyond words” and glad someone stopped him. The free Channel 2 report says the case remains under investigation and authorities have not named the suspect.

15647ac2b8468be5b3869015064908c9e7059a15.headline: Portage homeowner’s murder charge denied pending probe after driveway stabbing
15647ac2b8468be5b3869015064908c9e7059a15.summary: Kalamazoo County prosecutors on Thursday temporarily denied charges against a 54-year-old Portage homeowner initially arrested for open murder after a fatal early-morning struggle in his driveway. Police say Roy Harris James Jr., 51, was fatally stabbed about 3:10 a.m. Wednesday after the homeowner confronted someone breaking into a vehicle; the homeowner told officers James pulled a knife and he gained control of it during the fight. Public Safety Director Matt Wolfe asked the community to wait for facts before drawing conclusions. MLive’s free report notes the denial is for additional investigation, not a final clearance.

8fc7cf601c667694e0201df1562274546034a460.headline: Jets: Fitzpatrick returns to full practice; Hall still out ahead of Bears
8fc7cf601c667694e0201df1562274546034a460.summary: Minkah Fitzpatrick practiced fully Thursday for the first time since his Week 1 groin injury, reinforcing Aaron Glenn’s earlier signal that the safety has a strong chance to play Sunday at Chicago. Breece Hall (quad), Adonai Mitchell, Dylan Parham, Mason Taylor, and Kiko Mauigoa remained out, while Kingsley Enagbare (knee) missed after being limited Wednesday. Jeremy Ruckert and Kenyon Sadiq were limited again. Official designations come Friday; Josh Alper’s free PFT note is a clearer upgrade than Wednesday’s “expected” chatter used in the 4 p.m. batch.

bbc2a5656bea5a656d0c092c35167a07b2e8ce6f.headline: Penguins take Muse and Karlsson to U.S. Steel plant for helmet-partner tour
bbc2a5656bea5a656d0c092c35167a07b2e8ce6f.summary: After announcing U.S. Steel as the club’s official helmet partner for 2026-27, Penguins coach Dan Muse and defenseman Erik Karlsson toured the Edgar Thomson Plant in Braddock—an “Ice Meets Fire” feature posted Oct. 1. Muse traced family roots to U.S. Steel’s Fairfield, Alabama, works; Karlsson likened ladle pours to Super Mario and said the visit captures why Pittsburgh exists. The free team site piece is a culture/partnership angle distinct from Wednesday’s 7–0 Flyers recap and youth-depth blueprint already archived today.

c5b28cefbb7d7d1db0f803d5c1737236f84ed31c.headline: Apple eyed to unveil Home hub, new HomePod mini, and Apple TV 4K on Oct. 13
c5b28cefbb7d7d1db0f803d5c1737236f84ed31c.summary: MacRumors aggregates Bloomberg reporting that Apple will refresh its smart-home lineup Tuesday, Oct. 13, with an updated HomePod mini (new chip, better sound, N1/Wi-Fi 7, second-gen UWB, Siri AI, new colors including pink and green), a new Apple TV 4K (likely A19-class chip, 12GB RAM, N1), and the long-awaited ~6-inch square home hub for FaceTime, photos, recipes, and HomeKit control in tabletop or wall mounts. The free Oct. 1 piece frames the three-product drop rather than the four-color Home Hub rumor alone that ran in the 4 p.m. batch.

f7b3ffb7113555636990719784b0144e82dee53c.headline: Insta360 X6 underwater review: 8K360 holds up in murky Lundy seal water
f7b3ffb7113555636990719784b0144e82dee53c.summary: DeeperBlue’s India Bradshaw stress-tested the Insta360 X6 snorkelling with seals off Lundy Island in green, low-light UK water and called low-light 8K50 360 the standout upgrade over prior models. Dual 1/1.1-inch sensors, FlowState, and the Invisible Dive Case Pro (60 m) impressed, though dedicated underwater lenses complicate same-day surface shooting and occasional stitch lines remain. Battery life stayed above 50% after ~2.5 hours of 8K360. Standard bundle pricing starts around $670; the Dive Case Pro is about $180. Free full review dated Sept. 24—not previously archived.

3104b82827366168710399c5ac21634ffd5bc993.headline: LEGO’s October wave: 20 sets from UCS Executor to PlayStation and Downton
3104b82827366168710399c5ac21634ffd5bc993.summary: ComicBook’s Oct. 1 roundup lists all 20 October LEGO launches with prices—from the 6,130-piece UCS Executor Super Star Destroyer ($799.99, with Darth Vader lightsaber GWP) to Downton Abbey ($349.99), PlayStation ($179.99), Bookstore Book Nook, Wallace & Gromit, Pokémon Trainer Moments Poké Ball, Wednesday sets, and four Avengers: Doomsday kits landing Oct. 4. Insider early access and retirement watch-list tips (Optimus Prime, Falcon, Starry Night) round out the free shopping guide—distinct from this morning’s “wave live” and midday Executor hands-on review angles.

edb18772528a1684ec6ee6fc6d4387e2975f6172.headline: Pennsylvania foliage approaching peak: statewide window centered on Oct. 11
edb18772528a1684ec6ee6fc6d4387e2975f6172.summary: Fall Photo Guide’s Oct. 1 model puts Pennsylvania at “approaching peak,” with a typical statewide peak window of Oct. 7–15 centered on Oct. 11—northern high ground first, southeast valleys later. County and elevation tables flag McKean and Potter near peak timing while Philadelphia lags into mid-to-late October. Photographer-oriented tips cover Leonard Harrison and Colton Point at Pine Creek Gorge, Mount Davis, Ricketts Glen’s Ganoga Falls, and Hawk Mountain light times. Free full guide complements today’s archived New York Adirondacks report without repeating that URL.

0019e81f1af7814589c8a341b43c96ad50a642d7.headline: Westport weighs Bay Street and Taylor Place workarounds while Jesup Bridge is out
0019e81f1af7814589c8a341b43c96ad50a642d7.summary: Dan Woog’s 06880 walks through neighborhood ideas to ease traffic and EMS access while the flood-damaged Jesup Road Bridge stays closed for what could be a 12-to-18-month replacement. Suggestions include converting short one-way Bay Street and Taylor Place to two-way traffic and temporarily removing Imperial Avenue stop signs at the closed span. The piece stresses that police and Westport EMS headquarters sit just up the hill, making Jesup the quickest path east of the Saugatuck—distinct from Thursday’s Patch RFP story on design bids. Readers also debate a temporary bridge versus living with detours until permitting clears.

65ed9890d87b8f2aec1d1c350e99283b22824aff.headline: Westport beach-resiliency forum shifts to Zoom as Burying Hill keeps eroding
65ed9890d87b8f2aec1d1c350e99283b22824aff.summary: Westport’s Parks and Recreation beach-resiliency forum moved from Town Hall to a Thursday-night Zoom after organizers flagged rapidly eroding Burying Hill Beach. The session was set to cover existing site conditions, possible beach profiles, and regulatory hurdles for shoreline work. The same 06880 roundup notes sunny weather for Saturday’s postponed Slice of Saugatuck, the Oct. 24 Halloween window-painting contest, and a Westport police blotter including one custodial arrest. Free local coverage complements earlier Compo Beach dog-rule items without repeating those URLs.

384f45fa495dfa09cc8150b2590778e9fbc37fae.headline: Trump touts Peterbilt’s 1,000 Denton jobs and doubles down on Paxton for Senate
384f45fa495dfa09cc8150b2590778e9fbc37fae.summary: At Peterbilt Motors in Denton on Thursday, President Trump credited tariffs and lighter emissions rules for a manufacturing rebound and highlighted the plant’s claim of more than 1,000 added jobs. He joked about buying a truck if Secret Service would let him drive it, then turned the stop into a midterm pitch for Republican Senate nominee Ken Paxton—calling him maybe the nation’s best attorney general while slamming Democrat James Talarico. Free FOX 4 write-up captures the post-event remarks beyond earlier “surprise stop” previews already on the site.

af8f403a71fc90637b519b3f889acede5e5c3b8c.headline: Erika Kirk says Charlie’s race comments were taken out of context: ‘He didn’t care’
af8f403a71fc90637b519b3f889acede5e5c3b8c.summary: Turning Point USA CEO Erika Kirk, more than a year after Charlie Kirk’s murder at Utah Valley University, defended her late husband against racism accusations in a fresh interview roundup. She insisted on watching a full clip before answering, then argued a widely criticized remark about urban crime was stripped of context from a 2023 Citi Bike confrontation. Kirk repeated that Charlie “didn’t care” about skin color or religion, framed her own politics through a biblical lens, and compared elections to sports when asked about 2020. Free AOL text avoids Daily Wire paywalls.

46e2ba2e8bab4bdf227742735149985ee78186d0.headline: Pampa resident shoots man who forced his way into occupied home late Friday
46e2ba2e8bab4bdf227742735149985ee78186d0.summary: Pampa police say 33-year-old Kamron Hassler arrived uninvited, forced his way into a North Duncan Street home around 11:30 p.m. Sept. 25, and was shot by an occupant who retrieved a handgun after fearing for their safety. Hassler later died at an Amarillo hospital; investigators note he was known to the residents. Texas Penal Code §9.32’s presumption for deadly force against unlawful forced entry into an occupied home may apply, but the district attorney will review charging once the Criminal Investigations Division finishes. No shooter has been publicly named while the case remains open.

af8ec98b5464801b7023c2c98a64f60470ac5c5d.headline: Tampa: State attorney won’t charge resident who fatally shot 15-year-old on patio
af8ec98b5464801b7023c2c98a64f60470ac5c5d.summary: Tampa police said Thursday the State Attorney’s Office declined charges against a mid-20s resident who fatally shot a 15-year-old on Sept. 20 after the teen and two friends entered a gated community seeking a lost phone, then went into an enclosed patio and banged on a sliding glass door. Investigators say a fight followed as others fled; the resident claimed he was headlocked and fired in fear for his life. Prosecutors concluded they could not refute a self-defense claim. Neither the teen nor the resident has been publicly named; the phone was never found.

c4d025f8f46594a6f02126d44442ff3597a8579d.headline: Scottsdale judge keeps homeowner accused of shooting salesman jailed as flight risk
c4d025f8f46594a6f02126d44442ff3597a8579d.summary: A Maricopa County judge denied travel for North Scottsdale homeowner Patrick McBride, charged after the Sept. 13 shooting of 21-year-old door-to-door salesman Juan Hoffman. Police say McBride ordered Hoffman to leave, then retrieved a gun, went outside, and shot Hoffman in the back; McBride claims self-defense. Hoffman remains hospitalized and unable to walk. Defense attorney Brenna Fisher told Arizona’s Family that leaving the house to search after grabbing a gun looks less like castle-doctrine defense and more like vigilante force—especially inside a gated community rather than inside the home.

900ac50a6ebb8abd8ab9b8484f354fc1fc677696.headline: Fitzpatrick says he’s ready for Bears as Jets chase end to 20-game INT drought
900ac50a6ebb8abd8ab9b8484f354fc1fc677696.summary: After a full Thursday practice, safety Minkah Fitzpatrick told ESPN he is ready to re-debut Sunday at Soldier Field following a groin injury on the sixth play of Week 1. He returns to a Jets secondary that has gone 20 straight games without an interception—632 pass attempts—and only one takeaway all season. Coach Aaron Glenn’s defense ranks high in yards allowed but still hunts that first pick. New York is preparing for either Case Keenum or Tyson Bagent with Caleb Williams still out; Fitzpatrick said schematics are clicking under Glenn.

966a77e27f76b04ebbcd9939c4fda332d49aa195.headline: Hallander earns welder’s win helmet after blood-clot comeback in Penguins’ 7–0
966a77e27f76b04ebbcd9939c4fda332d49aa195.summary: Penguins beat writer Michelle Crechiolo’s Oct. 1 Musings digs past the scoreline: Filip Hallander, sidelined most of last season by a blood clot, scored in the opener and received Crosby’s new welder’s-helmet player-of-the-game award. Coach Dan Muse praised Hallander’s attitude through rehab, while the improvised Hallander–Lapierre–Koivunen line each found the net with Kuzmenko, Kindel, and Rust unavailable. Silovs and Robertson quotes frame the Flyers rematch as playoff payback—fresh color beyond earlier recap and U.S. Steel plant-tour items.

66bf0d926ab0e03ec97158a58eb5f37e26501e45.headline: Amazon redesigns Kindle, Paperwhite, and Colorsoft with flush edge-to-edge color
66bf0d926ab0e03ec97158a58eb5f37e26501e45.summary: Amazon’s device blog unveiled a ground-up Kindle family with reverse-stack flush-front displays and edge-to-edge color housings in new shades like Ube and Alpine Sky. The base 6-inch Kindle starts at $149.99 (aluminum option $189.99), Paperwhite runs $199.99–$249.99 with up to 12 weeks of battery, and Colorsoft spans $289.99–$319.99. New accessories include a $34.99 Bluetooth page-turn remote and magnetic page-turn covers. Base Kindle and Kids models are available now; Paperwhite and Colorsoft open for rolling preorder—free full official text, no paywall.

88881549630cafc9b40b9a73cf18661bbcf53575.headline: Samsung’s Android XR smart glasses eyed for November launch, Korea Herald says
88881549630cafc9b40b9a73cf18661bbcf53575.summary: The Verge reports Samsung’s Android XR smart glasses—designed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker and shown at Unpacked in July—could reach stores sometime in November, citing The Korea Herald’s confirmation from a Samsung official. The short free dispatch keeps the wearable lane warm alongside earlier Insta360 glasses experiments already archived. No U.S. price or carrier details yet; November would put Samsung weeks behind Apple’s rumored mid-October home-hub wave.

ada7c7c69ec16696a98688d3285b843c8c492d86.headline: Hanford’s Renaissance of Kings Faire returns this weekend as California’s longest-running
ada7c7c69ec16696a98688d3285b843c8c492d86.summary: Downtown Hanford’s Civic Park hosts the 47th Renaissance of Kings Faire Saturday and Sunday (Oct. 3–4), billed as California’s longest-running Renaissance event. Admission is $5 for ages 13+, $3 for ages 4–12, and free under 4, with artisan markets, jesters, games, food vendors, and a beer garden for 21+. Recreation director Brad Albert called it affordable family fun; period dress is encouraged but not required. Free FOX26 local piece is distinct from already-archived Texas, Idaho, and Maryland faire items.

54c8f42d82705e3de3d5e7eab53841ea38f5c691.headline: Northeast Kingdom foliage nearing peak—this weekend looks best before it fades
54c8f42d82705e3de3d5e7eab53841ea38f5c691.summary: WCAX’s First Alert team reported Thursday from East Burke that Vermont’s Northeast Kingdom is showing some of the brightest color of the season, with drone footage underscoring reds and golds against cloudy skies. Meteorologists say this weekend is the most promising leaf-peeping window there before the region slips past peak, while cooler air should help valleys catch up. Free local TV report updates September’s broader “Vermont foliage heating up” piece with a concrete NEK timing call for Oct. 3–4 travelers.

45783d36ee3512808b57ee14d07eceec5491921e.headline: NC Smokies fall forecast: chase color by elevation from Kuwohi into November valleys
45783d36ee3512808b57ee14d07eceec5491921e.summary: Visit Smokies’ free 2026 forecast explains there is no single peak week: color starts above 5,000 feet in late September, fills 4,000-foot Parkway stretches in early–mid October, then drops into Cherokee, Bryson City, Franklin, and southwestern valleys through early November. Tips cover Kuwohi, Graveyard Fields, Waterrock Knob, Cherohala Skyway, and Great Smoky Mountains Railroad leaf rides, plus NCSU notes that western North Carolina’s outlook is better than drought-hit parts of the state. Complements today’s Pennsylvania peak guide without repeating Blue Ridge Parkway archive URLs.

2df1b564ae08344cd6740cafb61ec85e6cfc8a5c.headline: Westport beach fix could run $14M to $54M as sand must be trucked in
2df1b564ae08344cd6740cafb61ec85e6cfc8a5c.summary: In a Thursday-night Zoom forum covered Friday by Westport Journal, Parks and Rec Director Erik Barbieri warned Compo, Old Mill, Burying Hill and Canal beaches are “wasting away.” RACE Coastal Engineering laid out nourishment options restoring 2014 profiles, 1949 Army Corps conditions, or something in between—projecting $14.1 million on the cheap end to $54.5 million for the fullest rebuild. State and federal rules block dredging Long Island Sound solely for beach sand, so trucked-in material is the path; dunes and low-tide reclaim were dismissed. Officials aim for construction in late 2027 after Board of Finance and land-use reviews—fresh cost and regulatory detail beyond Thursday’s 06880 Zoom-shift note.

c93fce20db14b555a14bc5488e89c76669d9f82c.headline: Westport raises Pink Aid flag to open Breast Cancer Awareness Month
c93fce20db14b555a14bc5488e89c76669d9f82c.summary: Westport marked October 1 by raising the Pink Aid flag at Jessup Green, with First Selectman Kevin Christie reading a proclamation. Co-founder Amy Katz, a two-time breast cancer survivor, said the 2011 Westport-born nonprofit now works nationally and has distributed more than $16 million so patients are not forced to choose between treatment and groceries. Local businesses are donating a share of October proceeds. Free News 12 write-up is a fresh Fairfield County community URL not previously archived.

5307c37f12251407a81c786ca3fc6feb18e4b9d3.headline: Trump’s Mobile stop today aims to boost Tuberville and Florida’s Donalds
5307c37f12251407a81c786ca3fc6feb18e4b9d3.summary: Alabama Public Radio’s AP package frames Friday’s Mitchell Center rally in Mobile as a two-fer: Sen. Tommy Tuberville’s gubernatorial bid against Doug Jones, plus adjacent Florida panhandle messaging for Rep. Byron Donalds’s governor race. Trump and Vance are concentrating on deep-red turf to juice base turnout amid an AP-NORC poll showing only 17% approve of Trump’s handling of living costs and 26% of the economy. The president’s 32-day midterm blitz continues Saturday in Vandalia, Ohio, and Monday in Grand Island, Nebraska—new Alabama-angle coverage distinct from Thursday’s Denton/Durant stops already on the site.

cc4287db616c47f9bdb775c9b121891054095dd3.headline: Trump says Iran war ends ‘right after the election’ as 9,000 more troops head east
cc4287db616c47f9bdb775c9b121891054095dd3.summary: CBS’s Friday live updates say the USS Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group and USS Makin Island Amphibious Group are steaming toward the Middle East—about 7,000 sailors and 2,000 Marines that could push U.S. forces in theater near 20,000 with three carrier groups. In Denton Thursday, Trump claimed Iran’s theocracy is “ready to fold up” and that the seven-month war will end “right after the election,” maybe before, with energy prices “rapidly” falling. He also told reporters Iran may be linked to the FlyDubai co-pilot stabbing attempt and vowed Tehran would be “hit very hard” if confirmed. Free full-text morning briefing, not previously archived.

4145c0b6e901ca1f0463a58f2e981d50a4bf957e.headline: Trump: Iran will be ‘hit very hard’ if tied to FlyDubai cockpit stabbing
4145c0b6e901ca1f0463a58f2e981d50a4bf957e.summary: Euronews details Thursday’s White House exchange in which Trump said, based on what he is hearing, Iran was involved in the FlyDubai Dubai-to-Tel Aviv incident and that Tehran would be hit “very hard” if responsibility is proven. Netanyahu said the Omani co-pilot underwent “Islamist radical indoctrination,” passengers helped stop a plunge of roughly 17,000 feet, and the UAE is probing terrorist intent while FlyDubai suspends Israel flights. The piece also notes Patriot batteries in Saudi Arabia and Qatar plus the Theodore Roosevelt strike group’s move east—security framing distinct from the CBS troops-and-midterms live blog.

49a05bbd2fbb0d58efb6356ce9bd11e3b89aed2f.headline: San Francisco Vietnam vet shoots burglar in the buttocks after door drill break-in
49a05bbd2fbb0d58efb6356ce9bd11e3b89aed2f.summary: A 73-year-old Army Vietnam veteran in San Francisco’s Sunset District told CBS he awoke around 5 a.m. Sunday after a burglar drilled through a first-floor wooden door, then confronted a masked man in black—and a large dog—on the second floor. After being grabbed and going to his hands and knees, the homeowner fired one round that struck the intruder in the buttocks; the suspect fled, leaving a blood trail and the husky for Animal Control. Police later detained an injured man matching the description about three miles away with non-life-threatening wounds. Free Western Journal write-up of CBS-sourced facts; no shooter charged in the reporting.

ff6b4de69c22bcbfad9fc2ff17d2b342060ff010.headline: Indiana homeowner shoots man trying to enter Laurel home; pair knew each other
ff6b4de69c22bcbfad9fc2ff17d2b342060ff010.summary: Indiana State Police say a Franklin County homeowner near Laurel opened fire around 5 a.m. Tuesday when an adult male tried to enter a Chapel Road residence, striking him at least once. The wounded man was taken to University of Cincinnati Medical Center with non-life-threatening injuries. Investigators say the two men knew each other and do not believe the shooting was random; no arrests had been announced and names were withheld pending the probe. Free FOX19 local report fills a fresh courts/self-defense URL after yesterday’s Tampa, Pampa, and Scottsdale arcs.

ce7f7fee2a7cd94857820a1ca641b96e885141a3.headline: Apple Home Hub will ID users with AI facial recognition—not Face ID
ce7f7fee2a7cd94857820a1ca641b96e885141a3.summary: AppleInsider relays Bloomberg’s Power On claim that the rumored Home Hub launching around Oct. 13 will switch household photos, music, and calendars using AI facial recognition rather than Face ID. The system may continuously watch the room and identify whoever interacts with the roughly six-inch display, possibly sharing tech with future Home cameras. The same podcast still points to a Dynamic Island MacBook Pro later this fall and says manufacturing has been ready while Apple waited on improved Siri AI—new identification-angle coverage beyond color and Oct. 13 slate stories already archived.

c25c9e8a985714d8e5b40ebbfe0a07023f834029.headline: Leaked HomePad setup shows Photo Face clock-and-slideshow powered by iCloud
c25c9e8a985714d8e5b40ebbfe0a07023f834029.summary: Code researcher pdfu’s assets, reported Friday by The Apple Post, show HomePad setup offering a Photo Face that blends a large clock with Photos, Memories, or Shared Albums—requiring iCloud Photos and priming the device with full-res shots from a nearby iPhone. Users can shuffle people, pets, places, Featured Photos, or hand-picked images; the same face is tied to iPhone Duo StandBy. Preview art is grouped for Silver, Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose Pink finishes. Fresh Oct. 2 software-leak angle distinct from MacRumors color and AppleInsider AI-ID pieces.

0dad5a17304a65788aaec7be2019a36ac74dd9ed.headline: Grok Build’s Agent Dashboard runs parallel coding agents from one screen
0dad5a17304a65788aaec7be2019a36ac74dd9ed.summary: Grok announced Thursday a new Agent Dashboard inside Grok Build: type “grok dashboard” or “/dashboard” to see all agents on one screen, dispatch tasks in parallel, and spin agents into their own Git worktrees with Ctrl+W. A short demo shows the terminal command opening the top-down view. TeslaNorth frames it as the latest SpaceXAI coding-workflow upgrade alongside Cursor integration, voice calls, and 1Password support—genuine tooling news, not income-funnel spam, and a URL not yet in the archive.

2564d9823d7e0e2d4515fa9514d326b8b2503320.headline: Pens: Lizotte out with lower-body issue a day after return; Kindel skates full
2564d9823d7e0e2d4515fa9514d326b8b2503320.summary: Friday’s PensBurgh notes say Blake Lizotte missed Thursday practice while being evaluated for a lower-body injury one day after coming off IR in Pittsburgh’s 7–0 opener. Ben Kindel skated in a full-contact jersey and joined line rushes, the clearest sign yet he is nearing a return. The club also reassigned Rutger McGroarty to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton. Fresh injury/practice update that moves past Wednesday’s 7–0 and Thursday’s U.S. Steel tour pieces already published.

5db7b6af460a3d842f4d1b9406524fa8b911ce5b.headline: Jets Thursday report: Fitzpatrick full; Hall, Mitchell, Taylor still out of practice
5db7b6af460a3d842f4d1b9406524fa8b911ce5b.summary: The Jets’ official Thursday Week 4 injury report upgrades safety Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) to full participation ahead of Sunday’s trip to Chicago, while Breece Hall (quad), Adonai Mitchell (finger), Mason Taylor (thumb), Dylan Parham (knee), Kiko Mauigoa (quad), and Kingsley Enagbare (knee) were all DNP. Chicago again listed Caleb Williams (hamstring) and D’Andre Swift (knee) as DNP. Official club sheet is a cleaner Friday-morning reference than Wednesday’s Jets Wire notes and Thursday’s ESPN Fitzpatrick-ready feature already archived.

32343a8cd37a623f27ea57e0060cd2b8812f302a.headline: Connecticut Renaissance Faire opens Pirates & Vikings weekend in Lebanon
32343a8cd37a623f27ea57e0060cd2b8812f302a.summary: CTvisit lists the Connecticut Renaissance Faire’s Pirates & Vikings themed weekend for Saturday–Sunday, Oct. 3–4 at Lebanon Country Fairgrounds (122 Mack Road), 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. The weekend includes a pirate-and-viking costume contest Saturday and a Siren Song contest Sunday as the faire’s 2026 season runs through late October. Fresh local Always-search faire item distinct from yesterday’s Hanford Renaissance of Kings coverage and earlier Faerie Ring Revels archive entry.

e2d6fb2be26d40b0643c14678c6dc0891d3401fd.headline: Glacier’s Going-to-the-Sun alpine road typically closes Oct. 19—weather permitting
e2d6fb2be26d40b0643c14678c6dc0891d3401fd.summary: Deep Arrival’s free guide says the National Park Service rule of thumb puts Glacier’s alpine Going-to-the-Sun Road fully open until the third Monday of October—Oct. 19, 2026—unless snow gates Logan Pass earlier, as it already did Sept. 14. Lower West Entrance pavement to Lake McDonald stays open year-round; Highway 2 is the south-side backup when the pass closes. No vehicle reservations in 2026, but length/width limits still apply. Fresh alpine-close planning item distinct from Northeast Kingdom, Smokies, and Pennsylvania foliage stories from yesterday.

b8ae38b89dcd8f1443e02d3a1be95258eecbafc4.headline: Westoberfest returns Saturday to downtown Westport with craft beer and family art
b8ae38b89dcd8f1443e02d3a1be95258eecbafc4.summary: Westport Journal’s free preview of the ninth annual Westoberfest says Saturday’s Craft Beer & Family Fall Festival runs 1–5 p.m. at Sigrid Schultz Plaza and along Elm Street with free admission. Twenty-plus breweries pour for 21+ tasting-pass holders, One Bad Oyster plays, and a first-time MoCA CT–One River–Whimsy Works art collaboration anchors the family area alongside carnival games and pumpkin decorating. Lonnie Quinn again hosts the stein-holding contest; the Westport Downtown Association produces the rain-or-shine event. Fresh Fairfield County weekend item distinct from this morning’s beach-restoration and Pink Aid pieces.

c79c3d4dde4183da631218b3416796bf630c721c.headline: Trump expected to name DNI Jay Clayton as White House AI czar
c79c3d4dde4183da631218b3416796bf630c721c.summary: NBC reports Friday that President Trump is expected to name Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as White House artificial-intelligence czar while Clayton keeps his spy-agency post, with a social-media announcement possible as early as today. Clayton attended Tuesday’s White House AI CEO session and told CNBC the administration wants a “whole-of-government” approach to “superintelligence” as a national-security issue. The White House called pre-announcement personnel reporting “baseless speculation.” Free midday personnel story distinct from this morning’s Mobile/Tuberville midterm-stop package.

f72ce88e0de556024c9d9ea2aa1a370a6d2b351f.headline: Trump opens 32-day midterm blitz as AP-NORC poll sinks economy and Iran war ratings
f72ce88e0de556024c9d9ea2aa1a370a6d2b351f.summary: Al Jazeera’s Friday package frames Trump’s Denton–Durant kickoff of a 32-day midterm tour against AP-NORC numbers: 71% disapprove of the Iran war, only 26% approve of his handling of the economy, and fuel costs remain elevated. At Peterbilt he graded himself “A+,” blamed poor “promotion,” touted tariffs and data-center growth, and again asked voters to “pretend I’m on the ballot,” citing impeachment fears if Republicans lose. The piece also notes Paxton’s Texas Senate struggle and Abbott/Paxton pushback on AI data-center water use—broader poll-and-stakes framing than this morning’s Alabama Mobile stop note.

570a55f84ecd994da8219b2d429f3ae8987eebbd.headline: Draft 1040 would make filers check U.S. citizenship or work-authorization status
570a55f84ecd994da8219b2d429f3ae8987eebbd.summary: Fox News details the Trump Treasury draft 2026 Form 1040 and Schedule 3-A that ask every filer—and spouse on a joint return—whether they are a U.S. citizen, national, or alien lawfully authorized to work, under penalty of law. Officials say the checkbox aims to block ineligible refundable credits and could save up to $2 billion; researchers estimate hundreds of thousands of filers, including many U.S.-citizen children in mixed-status homes, could lose EITC or ACTC. Critics from Cato and the Center for Taxpayer Rights warn it could drag the IRS into immigration enforcement after a prior IRS–ICE data-sharing pact was blocked in court. Free Oct. 2 policy write-up.

60e0bfe2e932cc26b46f8b77b24b81692fda75bb.headline: Judge makes final: ICE courthouse arrests in Manhattan were arbitrary and capricious
60e0bfe2e932cc26b46f8b77b24b81692fda75bb.summary: U.S. District Judge P. Kevin Castel granted summary judgment Thursday to migrant-rights groups, finding ICE’s arrests at Manhattan immigration courthouses arbitrary and capricious under the APA after the government admitted a May 2025 memo never justified the practice. Castel wrote ICE now appears to have “no policy whatsoever” beyond “unfettered discretion,” and the NYCLU called the order an “enormous win” for people attending routine hearings. DHS did not immediately comment. Free Courthouse News final-judgment angle distinct from archived ICE pursuit-memo coverage.

166fbe9abe89a7c504b13351d59a497f667aefba.headline: ICE quietly hides final-order detainees from its public locator—and from lawyers
166fbe9abe89a7c504b13351d59a497f667aefba.summary: Documented’s Oct. 2 Throughline explains ICE’s Sept. 15 policy that drops people with final removal orders from the online detainee locator and bars facility staff from confirming their location to lawyers or families—leaving no proactive way to know if someone is still held or already deported. The agency cites a “historic number of injunctions”; the effect is to frustrate habeas filings that must be brought where the person is held. Dozens of members of Congress protested this week. Free full-text analysis of a deliberate opacity shift, not a rewrite of earlier chase-memo stories.

0e6607d6eef10b74965d2f86dad3e3fda7417206.headline: Report: Trump asked Grok how Venezuelans would react before Maduro capture
0e6607d6eef10b74965d2f86dad3e3fda7417206.summary: The Independent relays a TIME-sourced account that Trump spent hours with Elon Musk’s Grok chatbot the month before the January “Absolute Resolve” operation that extracted Nicolás Maduro, including a question about how Venezuelans would react if Maduro were deposed—Grok reportedly predicted celebrations. Officials say Trump was later impressed when diaspora celebrations matched the answer; America.gov still partly runs on Grok alongside Gemini. Free Friday AI-politics piece distinct from this morning’s Grok Build Agent Dashboard tooling note—and not an income-funnel story.

f2822e1f0eb24d86d2796fa61a89d86856a29ebf.headline: Jets rule out Hall, Mitchell, Taylor, Parham, and Mauigoa for Sunday at Bears
f2822e1f0eb24d86d2796fa61a89d86856a29ebf.summary: Aaron Glenn’s Friday presser, reported by NBC Sports at 11:09 a.m. ET, formally rules out Breece Hall (quad), Adonai Mitchell (finger), Mason Taylor (thumb), Dylan Parham (knee), and Kiko Mauigoa (quad) for Week 4 at Chicago. Kingsley Enagbare (knee) was expected limited Friday after a Thursday DNP and could land questionable; Minkah Fitzpatrick remains on track after Thursday’s full practice. Official game-status step beyond this morning’s Thursday injury-report table.

b8a1487d40adc50cf061e76c50f32e80aed20562.headline: Penguins’ remade defense faces first real test Saturday vs. Canadiens’ offense
b8a1487d40adc50cf061e76c50f32e80aed20562.summary: Adam Gretz’s Friday Yahoo column argues Pittsburgh’s opening-night shutdown of Philadelphia—Silovs facing only 19 mostly low-danger shots, every pairing over 80% expected-goals share—came against a limited Flyers attack. Saturday’s Canadiens bring Suzuki, Caufield, Slafkovský, Demidov, Hutson, and Kreider as the new-look blue line (Karlsson–Carlile, Korczak–Girard, Letang–van Riemsdyk) gets its first measuring-stick game. Fresh weekend preview distinct from this morning’s Lizotte/Kindel practice notes.

4d09edb6845a4ab79f7f3c709f38a499ca77077c.headline: Harley-Davidson ends MotoAmerica factory bagger team after 2026 to grow World Cup
4d09edb6845a4ab79f7f3c709f38a499ca77077c.summary: Harley’s Oct. 1 media release says Factory Racing and official King of the Baggers support end after the 2026 MotoAmerica season, with investment shifting to expand the FIM Harley-Davidson Bagger World Cup in 2027 plus new grassroots racing. CEO Artie Starrs framed a two-track strategy—premier World Cup stages and accessible local competition—while Jason Kehl thanked MotoAmerica and rival Indian. Kyle Wyman’s 27 wins and three of six national titles close the factory chapter. Official free release; fresher strategic pivot than archived Softail/product pieces.

8cb0a314ca93b742f983a801a47b45783587149d.headline: Jeep/Ram Pentastar tick settlement: CT owners have until Oct. 12 to claim repairs
8cb0a314ca93b742f983a801a47b45783587149d.summary: Motoring Chronicle’s Oct. 2 explainer walks the Stellantis 3.6L Pentastar class settlement covering valve rocker arms, stem oil seals, and tappets on many 2015–2020 Jeep, Ram, Dodge, and Chrysler models registered in eleven California-emissions states—including Connecticut. Owners who already paid can seek 100% reimbursement at FCAWarrantySettlement.com by Oct. 12; others get an automatic 7-year/70,000-mile extended warranty at dealers. Deadline-and-CT-eligibility angle distinct from the earlier OpenClassActions settlement summary already archived.

5f630cc899bd3626c6ca6b64e0e4eafef3da748b.headline: Canon launches AI “Connected Value Platform” to clean up web pages before you print
5f630cc899bd3626c6ca6b64e0e4eafef3da748b.summary: Canon’s Oct. 1 Tokyo release introduces Connected Value Platform, a cloud feature layer using generative AI plus Canon imaging tech for PIXUS/PIXMA and office MFPs. First tool Web Print Optimizer strips ads and whitespace from recipes and articles before print; Content-Based Naming for scans is due late November. Access runs through Canon Print Assistant 2.0 / Canon PRINT 4.0 with genuine-ink requirements in the launch markets. Free manufacturer note fills the Canon always-search lane without repeating EOS R8 Mark II camera coverage.

a37e5b80c8baf8bad93b6437f8079e4f0e85670a.headline: New England foliage this weekend: White Mountains “glowing”; more peak weekends ahead
a37e5b80c8baf8bad93b6437f8079e4f0e85670a.summary: Boston.com’s Oct. 1 guide, citing Jim Salge and WBZ’s Eric Fisher, says northern New England maples are putting on their best show in several years—peak or near-peak along the Kancamagus, Crawford Notch, Bretton Woods, and related White Mountain corridors this Oct. 2–4 weekend—while much forest remains green, so later October weekends should stay strong. Massachusetts peaks later (western hills mid-month; Boston area toward Halloween). Fresh weekend-planning travel item distinct from Glacier alpine-close, Smokies elevation, and PA statewide pieces already on the site.

45d7f9b80a13a20fd35904895c330a4be30862e2.headline: Tesla ships “Emergency Drive Away” so Supercharging cars can flee plugged-in danger
45d7f9b80a13a20fd35904895c330a4be30862e2.summary: Business Insider reports Tesla’s Thursday OTA “Emergency Drive Away” lets a vehicle shift into Drive while still connected to a Supercharger after an on-screen Activate confirm—breaking the cable and damaging hardware by design. Charging chief Max de Zegher called it a feature “we hope you never need,” citing years of debate and the August Twin Falls, Idaho, shooting near a charger; Tesla warns deliberate misuse brings “additional penalties.” Free full-text safety-feature story, not Colossus/Optimus/Agent Dashboard rewrites.

885b82b5ee3c1e2a008c51b11d918ec7cff85cab.headline: Austin police: homeowner who shot South Austin burglar faces no charges so far
885b82b5ee3c1e2a008c51b11d918ec7cff85cab.summary: A Sept. 30 Statesman update on the Virtus Bend burglary says Dmario Antonie Jones, 24, was fatally shot after entering a South Austin bedroom around 3:51 a.m. Sept. 23; detectives now say he did not know or specifically target the homeowners and may be linked to other area thefts that night. The homeowner was questioned and released; no charges had been filed. Free local self-defense URL distinct from this morning’s San Francisco and Indiana arcs.

72bb1e56854fd7b6ca204883a4ba4ee5c01da603.headline: Trumbull police recover two stolen cars; three arrested in overnight busts
72bb1e56854fd7b6ca204883a4ba4ee5c01da603.summary: Trumbull police said three people were arrested this week after two stolen cars turned up in town. On Thursday morning officers found two 19-year-olds asleep in a Bridgeport-stolen car on Whitney Avenue and charged them with motor-vehicle larceny and conspiracy; after midnight Friday they recovered a Stratford-stolen car near Sterling and Walker roads and charged a 16-year-old Trumbull juvenile with larceny. Lt. Brian Falkenstein also noted 18 car-break complaints and eight stolen vehicles in September, many tied to unlocked cars or keys left inside.

d7c4a80a50f224561feaeb6a160d35a7dfcd388f.headline: Trump warns Republicans he’s worried about Texas and Michigan midterms
d7c4a80a50f224561feaeb6a160d35a7dfcd388f.summary: Speaking in Oklahoma on Thursday after a Denton, Texas stop, President Trump told supporters he is not worried about Oklahoma turnout but that Republicans are “worried about Michigan” and “worried about Texas,” citing roughly 35 to 40 races that matter most. He again urged voters to pretend he is on the ballot for a midterm win “too big to rig,” attacked Democrats on inflation and immigration, and said the administration’s problem is poor public relations rather than results.

20f09a5d4fad1ad9259858af32a5591a5a480945.headline: Third U.S. carrier and ~10,000 more troops head near Iran before midterms
20f09a5d4fad1ad9259858af32a5591a5a480945.summary: A U.S. official told Al Jazeera the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group left San Diego bound for the Middle East, followed by the Makin Island Marine Expeditionary Unit with more than 2,000 Marines—part of a reported 9,000–10,000 additional sailors and Marines. By end of November, three carriers and two amphibious groups are expected near Iran, adding to roughly 50,000 U.S. personnel already in the region. Trump told Time it is “possible” he could ramp up bombing after the Nov. 3 midterms while rejecting Iran’s latest Hormuz ceasefire terms.

eca463fa7ff459059a6a1e0a9c71df9f395c31c5.headline: ICE lodges detainers for 4 illegal immigrants arrested in Indiana sex sting
