0f85304d58c3399c95bd1bdf37611499a0fc48bc.summary: Just the News argued that legacy coverage of the economy has left out figures economists Larry Kudlow and Stephen Moore highlighted in the New York Post. They said real median household income rose 2.6 percent to $87,460 in 2025, the highest inflation-adjusted reading since the series began in 1967, and that the poverty rate fell to 10.2 percent, the lowest on record. July jobless claims hit 187,000, the lowest since September 1969. Unemployment is 4.2 percent, about where it was in September 2024, even with gas near $4.50 a gallon. The two say Republicans can still win the affordability argument in November.

6298e7ecbf6675b87b587c9bb81d8d7548ae2117.headline: Judge says Trump administration cannot keep the boat-strike legal memo secret
6298e7ecbf6675b87b587c9bb81d8d7548ae2117.summary: U.S. District Judge Paul A. Engelmayer rejected the Trump administration’s bid to withhold a classified Justice Department memo used to justify lethal strikes on suspected drug boats. In a 66-page ruling he said officials cannot claim deliberative-process and attorney-client privilege after senior officials cited the Office of Legal Counsel opinion as the binding legal basis for the operations. The case grew out of FOIA suits, including one from the ACLU. The strikes have killed at least 200 people in international waters, OANN reported.

9108d568fea171b6a7c2680cd8a52c87b68db999.headline: Canadian rock singer Sass Jordan dies at 65
9108d568fea171b6a7c2680cd8a52c87b68db999.summary: Sass Jordan’s family said the singer, songwriter, Juno winner, and longtime Canadian Idol judge died peacefully on October 2, surrounded by family. She was 65. Born Sarah Jordan in Birmingham, England, she moved to Montreal as a child, was fronting club bands by 16, and spent four decades as one of Canadian rock’s best-known voices. Her publicist said she drew from Judas Priest, Ozzy Osbourne, and Anthrax as well as Al Green and Aretha Franklin. The family called her an irreplaceable force of nature.

20b4b38c7672afd34c3d9a2ac4aab0d68f77f4a7.headline: Musk asks owners how they want their FSD, and fans pitch minivans and a 500-mile Cybertruck
20b4b38c7672afd34c3d9a2ac4aab0d68f77f4a7.summary: Elon Musk asked Tesla followers on Saturday, “How would you like your FSD?” The post drew about 4.8 million views after he quote-posted a fan who wrote that people want Full Self-Driving and then go to tesla.com to pick the shape. Replies turned into a wish list: a seven-seat minivan, a three-row SUV, a 500-mile Cybertruck, and a new Model S Plaid+ with active aero. TeslaNorth said the question does not confirm a new vehicle or a customization program. It does show owners asking for body styles Tesla does not sell today.

02cb8592033750f8d61df03ca98e7e27894ee8a4.headline: Former FBI agent: investigators are quietly rebuilding the Lynette Hooker scene
02cb8592033750f8d61df03ca98e7e27894ee8a4.summary: Six months after Lynette Hooker, 55, vanished on an April 4 sailing trip in the Bahamas, former FBI agent Nicole Parker said the case is not closed. Her husband, Brian, told investigators she went overboard from a dinghy near Hope Town after drinks. He was questioned and released and has not been charged. The Coast Guard Investigative Service seized the couple’s sailboat Soulmate in May and sent divers in June. Parker, a former Crimes on the High Seas coordinator, said evidence went to the FBI lab at Quantico and agents are trying to reconstruct a possible crime scene on the water. Hooker’s mother has said she believes Lynette made it back to the boat.

4fdbbef2a69e31680ff23c3d5c9b1fbf08185338.headline: Trumbull football falls 28–14 at Shelton; Eagles drop to 1–3
4fdbbef2a69e31680ff23c3d5c9b1fbf08185338.summary: Trumbull High lost 28–14 to Shelton on Friday night and fell to 1–3, a second straight defeat. Cade Volpicelli still rushed for 43 yards and a touchdown and added 62 receiving yards. Shelton improved to 3–1. Trumbull’s next game is at Danbury at 7 p.m. on October 16. Shelton plays Sheehan on Friday. The town newsflash had nothing newer than items already in the archive.

04fd85508a9d8715636cf88d1140cf2d733cf8af.headline: Jets list seven inactives for Sunday’s game at Chicago, including Hall and Mitchell
04fd85508a9d8715636cf88d1140cf2d733cf8af.summary: The Jets posted seven inactives about 90 minutes before the 1 p.m. kickoff at Soldier Field: edge Kingsley Enagbare, running back Breece Hall, linebacker Kiko Mauigoa, wide receiver Adonai Mitchell, guard Dylan Parham, tight end Mason Taylor, and defensive back Nahshon Wright. Wide receiver Sterling Shepard and linebacker Jaden Keller were elevated from the practice squad. Kicker Jason Sanders, elevated for the first three games, was signed to the active roster Tuesday. Chicago’s inactive list includes quarterback Caleb Williams. Kickoff is on FOX.

cfa8c873b0942e227b325df9fec8c81f7ac86b41.headline: Mario Lemieux joins Crosby for the Penguins’ 60th-anniversary puck drop
cfa8c873b0942e227b325df9fec8c81f7ac86b41.summary: Before Saturday’s home opener against Montreal, Mario Lemieux walked onto the ice at PPG Paints Arena for a ceremonial puck drop marking the Penguins’ 60th anniversary season. Doug McGregor, son of original owner Jack McGregor, and chairman Jeff Hoffman joined him. Sidney Crosby and Canadiens captain Nick Suzuki met at center ice, and the original puck from the franchise’s first home game in 1967 was brought back out. The matchup itself echoed that 1967 opener against Montreal. Lemieux fist-bumped players on the bench as the crowd gave the Hall of Famer a standing ovation.

4b080b2f9692df156db865e339db367aeb96c354.headline: Trump tells Ohio voters the polls don’t account for him campaigning
4b080b2f9692df156db865e339db367aeb96c354.summary: At Saturday’s Vandalia, Ohio rally, President Trump said Republicans will overcome soft polls now that he is on the trail personally. “These fake polls, they don’t account for one thing. They don’t account for the fact that Trump is out campaigning,” he told the crowd, urging them to pretend he is on the ballot. A recent Fox News poll gives Democrats a wider House path, projecting 215 Democratic seats to 201 Republican with 19 toss-ups still in play. A House GOP memo obtained by Fox says the final four weeks will focus on the border, fraudulent use of taxpayer dollars, the economy, and public safety.

d23813df6268bb09bc0ced7f2867bfcc907711b9.headline: Trump creates a Super Intelligence Force led by DNI Clayton and FTC’s Ferguson
d23813df6268bb09bc0ced7f2867bfcc907711b9.summary: On Sunday morning President Trump announced a Super Intelligence Force to follow the White House Accord on Super Intelligence. He said the group will coordinate federal engagement with consumers, public-interest groups, religious organizations, critical-infrastructure providers, and AI companies so America keeps leading what he called bigger than the industrial revolution and the internet. Leaders named include Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson, Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering and CTO Emil Michael, and OPM Director Scott Kupor, reporting to Trump and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles.

6e692b219470be6fd4e8f0a83fee657b2e38d8de.headline: Trump credits pharma tariffs after Bayer announces a $2.2 billion Ohio campus
6e692b219470be6fd4e8f0a83fee657b2e38d8de.summary: President Trump said Bayer announced a new $2.2 billion pharmaceutical manufacturing campus near Columbus that will create thousands of Ohio jobs in advanced manufacturing, research, and construction. He credited his pharmaceutical tariffs for more than $600 billion in new pharma investment and lower most-favored-nation drug prices, writing that companies must build in America, hire American workers, and price drugs fairly for patients—or pay. The Truth Social post landed as Trump campaigned in Ohio for the midterms.

70c684cfd74fb96a554a3ea591d83d26e272fbd2.headline: Supreme Court opens a new term with guns, voting, and Trump power still on the docket
70c684cfd74fb96a554a3ea591d83d26e272fbd2.summary: Chief Justice John Roberts opens the Court’s new term Monday with oral arguments, starting with a climate-liability fight against oil and gas companies. Already on the docket are religious-school preschool aid, state AR-15-style bans, and proof-of-citizenship voting rules. Fox notes the 6-3 majority has greenlighted many Trump emergency applications while also handing him losses on tariffs and birthright citizenship. Gallup has Court approval at a record-low 33 percent, and justices have warned Congress about rising threats, including a swatting incident at Justice Barrett’s home.

4abad7bc6a017582a9a323bb802ed27b04191601.headline: Fugitive in a 2009 silicone-injection murder is caught after a DMV license renewal
4abad7bc6a017582a9a323bb802ed27b04191601.summary: Tamaira Angell Smith, 52, faces a felony murder charge in the 2009 death of Eyanna Moore, 29, after an illegal silicone injection in a Georgia hotel room. Police said Smith fled after a 2009 warrant, later obtained a South Carolina license under a stolen identity, and in July 2026 called the DMV for help renewing it when an online alert blocked her. Facial recognition tied her to the murder warrant; Texas police arrested her in McKinney in August and she was extradited to Gwinnett County. A bond hearing is set for Oct. 22.

e568e61d466956681506852da9b11e5c85af2115.headline: Metallica plays ‘Devil’s Dance’ for the first time in 18 years at Sphere night two
e568e61d466956681506852da9b11e5c85af2115.summary: On Saturday’s second Life Burns Faster show at Las Vegas Sphere, Metallica opened with Blackened, Fuel, and Leper Messiah, then played Devil’s Dance for the first time since June 7, 2008. The Outlaw Torn also returned for the first time since 2019. The residency’s No Repeat Weekend format keeps Thursday and Saturday setlists entirely different across 24 dates through March 13, 2027. Fan video of the deep cuts circulated quickly Sunday morning.

63bb31d34894fe9957733ba2a34e80e105964223.headline: Carolina Renaissance Festival opens its 33rd season in Huntersville
63bb31d34894fe9957733ba2a34e80e105964223.summary: The Carolina Renaissance Festival kicked off Oct. 3 at 16445 Poplar Tent Road in Huntersville, North Carolina. Rain-or-shine weekends run Saturdays and Sundays from 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. through Nov. 22, with horseback jousting, circus entertainers, rides, artisan demonstrations, shopping, and games. The “Escape to the Renaissance” return marks the fair’s 33rd annual season.

e23326f826eb1e44ef0ac870c8f6fa4ef1efe897.headline: Westport–Weston Restaurant Week runs Oct. 4–18 with 20 prix-fixe menus
e23326f826eb1e44ef0ac870c8f6fa4ef1efe897.summary: The Westport-Weston Chamber’s Restaurant Week is actually two weeks, Sunday Oct. 4 through Oct. 18, with nineteen Westport restaurants and one Southport spot posting prix-fixe lunch and dinner deals. Chamber president Matthew Mandell said the point is to eat local and show off Fairfield County’s dining scene. Participating names include The Boathouse at Saugatuck, Kawa Ni, Zucca Gastrobar, Felice, Pepe’s, Romanacci, and Yuzu. Trumbull’s own town newsflash had nothing newer than already-archived items, so this nearby free stand-in is labeled honestly.

3cbb62629a754db1320d48fc5449d0213d3b9815.headline: Trump blasts Fox & Friends for skipping his packed midterm rallies
3cbb62629a754db1320d48fc5449d0213d3b9815.summary: In a Sunday morning Truth Social post, President Trump said Fox & Friends was not covering sold-out rallies in Ohio, Alabama, Texas, and Oklahoma and warned MAGA viewers would “very quickly stop watching.” He attacked Jessica Tarlov and said Fox spends more time talking to “Communists, Socialists, and Dumocrats” without rebuttal. He also criticized Maria Bartiromo’s exit and reminded Fox it “almost went out of business” the last time it tried this before an election. Mediaite noted Fox & Friends had aired a brief data-center clip from the Ohio rally minutes earlier.

d1064be432fdd8b19dbda279a4473cbd5b12f04a.headline: Twisted Sister box set collects the classic 1982–1987 studio albums
d1064be432fdd8b19dbda279a4473cbd5b12f04a.summary: BMG and Rhino announced Totally Twisted - The Studio Albums 1982-1987, a five-LP color vinyl and five-CD set spanning Under The Blade, You Can’t Stop Rock ’N’ Roll, Stay Hungry, Come Out And Play, and Love Is For Suckers. The package covers the Dee Snider–era run that produced We’re Not Gonna Take It and I Wanna Rock. It arrives as Sebastian Bach fronts the band on fall dates after Snider stepped aside for health reasons, with Jay Jay French and Eddie Ojeda still on guitar.

944f49fb4b0e69d3096ada2fbccb10c9446748f2.headline: Harley-Davidson’s Ladies International Run brings about 400 bikes to Pescara
944f49fb4b0e69d3096ada2fbccb10c9446748f2.summary: About 400 Harley-Davidson motorcycles and roughly 900 riders filled Pescara, Italy, on Oct. 3 for the International Ladies of Harley Run, part of the brand’s 2026 European community calendar with Jeep. The weekend included a city parade and fundraising tied to cancer research. Organizers billed it as one of the partnership’s fall stops before a H.O.G. Winter Meeting later in Genoa.

4de4a3ed54f2f8ebeeaf2292a906768e8118459d.headline: Floor Jansen’s solo album Hytress aims for a heavier sound that isn’t Nightwish
4de4a3ed54f2f8ebeeaf2292a906768e8118459d.summary: Nightwish singer Floor Jansen told Finland’s Imperiumi that her second solo album, Hytress, due Jan. 15, 2027 via REVAMP Music/Warner, pushes a heavier, more compact metal sound inspired by bands like Bleed From Within, Gojira, and Periphery—without copying Nightwish’s orchestral bombast. She said the twelve-song set keeps catchy choruses under a “very heavy jacket,” and that Nightwish’s current live pause lets her tour the heavier material without clashing setlists. Paragon, her 2023 solo debut, has nearly 150 million streams.

530d6e6a37fc86793e968088e11cfd077d3177cb.headline: Cruz says Vance is ‘feeling insecure’ after the VP called a 2028 run obvious
530d6e6a37fc86793e968088e11cfd077d3177cb.summary: Sen. Ted Cruz told Politico on Saturday that Vice President JD Vance is “feeling insecure” after Vance said in an NBC interview that it was “really obvious” Cruz is already running for president in 2028. Cruz said people “engage in political bomb-throwing when they’re feeling insecure” and that he will stay focused on helping Republicans win the midterms in the next 30 days. Vance said he is not running and is trying to elect Republicans. Cruz, who sought the nomination in 2016, has said he will “certainly be part of the discussion.”

63e08f0c947484c448648c41c6bc5c9d7bf096e2.headline: Coast Guard won’t say if the Nantucket jet search has become a recovery
63e08f0c947484c448648c41c6bc5c9d7bf096e2.summary: At a Sunday news conference, Coast Guard Rear Adm. Matt Lake said crews, Massachusetts authorities, and the New York National Guard have searched about 2,840 square miles over more than 53 hours for six people aboard a medical jet that vanished Saturday off Nantucket. He would not say whether the mission has shifted from rescue to recovery, and he said there is no sign a flight recorder has been found in the extensive debris field about 20 miles offshore. The Latitude Air Ambulance Gulfstream was flying from Bermuda to Boston with four Canadians and two Bermudians, a patient and the patient’s son. Controllers lost contact as the jet dropped from 24,000 feet to 11,000 feet. Lake said crews hope to search the seabed with sonar.

5a09509ca3e9e43619afe63e3a5d7348acc0ad1f.headline: Rahm Emanuel tells Democrats not to impeach Trump if they take the House
5a09509ca3e9e43619afe63e3a5d7348acc0ad1f.summary: On NBC’s Meet the Press Sunday, former Chicago mayor and Obama chief of staff Rahm Emanuel told Democrats not to impeach President Trump if they win the House. He said an impeachment “is not going anywhere” and would turn into “a food fight” that proves Washington is “Disneyland on the Potomac.” He urged the party to deliver an ethics package instead of another round of investigations that go nowhere. Democrats currently hold a significant polling edge heading into the midterms.

fd774a90ec8e1280b2bc8857c799ca01e1a5a216.headline: Oz calls Obamacare ‘phantom accounts’ fraud and wants broker calls recorded
fd774a90ec8e1280b2bc8857c799ca01e1a5a216.summary: CMS Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz is pressing health insurers to work only with brokers who record their calls with Obamacare applicants, widening the Trump administration’s crackdown on unauthorized enrollments. He told Fox News Digital the accounts are “phantom accounts” with “no human beings” behind them: no claims filed, no answers to agency questions, and no Social Security number to check whether someone even qualifies. Vice President JD Vance said Tuesday the anti-fraud task force will remove 750,000 fraudulent Obamacare recipients, a step the administration says will save taxpayers $2.2 billion.

b84555c58b177f5597dc8e66c0f092677ca79158.headline: Banks says Democrats will block voter ID just to deny Trump a win
b84555c58b177f5597dc8e66c0f092677ca79158.summary: Senate Democrats’ refusal to pass a federal voter-ID law is giving Republicans a midterm argument on a practice that is already common in the states and popular with voters in both parties. Sen. Jim Banks of Indiana told Fox News Digital that Democrats will vote no “because they don’t want to give the president a win,” even if it means blocking a bill that also bans congressional insider trading. The latest package follows months of Democratic opposition to the SAVE America Act, a Trump priority that Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer has kept out of funding deals.

92e4a648a44c630a5dd0769384d9fa76a631fa25.headline: Trump calls Jack Smith a ‘crooked prosecutor’ over a No Kings festival shirt
92e4a648a44c630a5dd0769384d9fa76a631fa25.summary: President Trump on Sunday called former special counsel Jack Smith a “Crooked Prosecutor” after Smith was seen at Tom Morello’s Power to the People Fest in Maryland wearing a “No Kings” shirt. Trump posted the line on Truth Social alongside a Just the News report on Saturday’s festival, where Bruce Springsteen performed his anti-ICE song “Streets of Minneapolis.” Morello, who organized the show, closed by telling the crowd he hoped they had been “energized, radicalized, revolutionized” and “wound up.”

de63a23dc8f176e35d1ee4d74441eb419e55b076.headline: Angela Paxton says she will vote the GOP ticket without naming Ken Paxton
de63a23dc8f176e35d1ee4d74441eb419e55b076.summary: Texas state Sen. Angela Paxton, who filed for divorce from Senate candidate Ken Paxton last year on “biblical grounds,” says in a new ad that she will vote the Republican ticket on Nov. 3. She never says her estranged husband’s name. “In a general election, it’s not as much about the individual players on the team; it’s about getting the whole team across the finish line,” she says, framing the choice as holding every Republican seat or handing Texas “to the other team.” Ken Paxton faces Democrat James Talarico in a tight race.

dfd1e4cf7879e50e40d190260b02920112150580.headline: Trump posts photos of a ‘crumbling’ Kennedy Center and blames a judge for the delay
dfd1e4cf7879e50e40d190260b02920112150580.summary: President Trump on Sunday posted photos of backstage areas of the Kennedy Center and wrote that the building “is crumbling, and a great danger to anyone who walks inside.” He said it “has been this way for years” and blamed a “Radical Left Judge, with his Trump Hating lawyer wife,” for blocking repairs he says require a temporary closure. Trump, the center’s current chair, has argued the work cannot wait after a piece of the ceiling fell. Critics have said the center should stay open.

e4f9110baff26470b71103512a5b3fc301815491.headline: Bartender charged after a birthday trip ends in a fatal push down bar stairs
e4f9110baff26470b71103512a5b3fc301815491.summary: Mary Lopez Hunt, 68, is charged with voluntary manslaughter and aggravated assault after prosecutors say she shoved Joyce Tomlinson, 62, of Minnesota, down the stairs at Coot’s Bar & Grill on Edisto Island, South Carolina. Tomlinson’s childhood friend Ruth Peterson told Fox News Digital she had stepped out to get the car around 11 p.m. on Oct. 3, 2025, while Tomlinson settled the tab on a birthday trip. Peterson said she looked up, saw a brief exchange, and watched Hunt run at Tomlinson and push her with both hands. Peterson spoke to Fox two days before the one-year mark of the death.

64905d148a2e86984277305acb37e850044d1736.headline: Retired pilot who carried Clinton’s nuclear football warns of airline terror cells
64905d148a2e86984277305acb37e850044d1736.summary: Retired Air Force Lt. Col. Buzz Patterson, who carried the nuclear football for President Clinton and later flew for Delta, told Fox News Digital that terror cells inside foreign airlines are “certainly a possibility” after a FlyDubai copilot allegedly attacked the captain of an Israel-bound flight with the cockpit crash ax. Patterson said most vetting still depends on pilots self-reporting, and he wants the Justice Department to look hard at who is in the cockpit. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Fox & Friends the copilot appeared to have had “Islamist radical indoctrination.” The Boeing 737, with 174 passengers and eight crew, diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

0441d82492d9272ae839cded1d66153500484b92.headline: A driverless Cybercab pulls into a Supercharger while one worker plugs in ten cars
0441d82492d9272ae839cded1d66153500484b92.summary: A 57-second clip posted Oct. 2 by X user Abhimanyu Yadav shows what he describes as an empty Cybercab arriving at a public Supercharger at night beside nine Model Ys, while one person walks the row and plugs each vehicle in. The post has drawn more than 162,000 views. TeslaNorth notes that “unsupervised,” “public supercharger,” and “Tesla employee” are the poster’s labels and have not been independently verified. Tesla already runs dedicated Robotaxi chargers and recently extended Austin Cybercab service to 11 p.m., while NHTSA is still examining the company’s certification of nearly 1,000 Cybercabs.

89bedc8e6fc796861fa6a35cb980a71fa9c8e137.headline: Musk says SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI as he drops the word AI
89bedc8e6fc796861fa6a35cb980a71fa9c8e137.summary: Elon Musk posted overnight that there should be “No more AI,” that “SI” is better, and that “SpaceX is a super intelligence company.” When a user suggested renaming SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI, Musk replied, “Yes, we will make that change.” It would be the second name for the business in under a year: SpaceX absorbed xAI in an all-stock deal in February, then adopted the SpaceXAI name in July. Musk did not say when the switch takes effect, whether it is a legal rename, or whether the @SpaceXAI handle will change. No company announcement had followed as of Sunday morning.

e1cba6afdd883acb2014fcf68c5bcc3e442f6142.headline: Gurman: the next MacBook Pro with OLED will be significantly lighter
e1cba6afdd883acb2014fcf68c5bcc3e442f6142.summary: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Apple’s redesigned MacBook Pro, expected by the end of November, will be significantly lighter after the company miniaturized parts and rearranged the interior. Today’s 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs as much as 4.8 pounds, against 3.3 pounds for the 15-inch MacBook Air, so a real cut would be obvious in a bag. Gurman did not give a new weight. The machines are still expected to ship with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, skipping the high end of the M6 family, plus OLED, touch, and a Dynamic Island, with macOS changes in Golden Gate and 27.2 to support them.

afb8f1673a8c9826aef92585427dac540a5a5ebd.headline: Geezer Butler joins Jack Black’s Sabbath cover band for ‘War Pigs’
afb8f1673a8c9826aef92585427dac540a5a5ebd.summary: Black Sabbath bassist Geezer Butler walked on with Jack Black’s tribute act Jack Sabbath on Saturday night at Tom Morello’s Power to the People festival in Columbia, Maryland, and played “War Pigs.” Black’s band, with Morello’s son Roman on guitar, Anthrax guitarist Scott Ian’s son Revel on bass, drummer Yoyoka Soma, and keyboardist Hugo Weiss, opened with Ozzy Osbourne’s “Mr. Crowley” and Sabbath’s “The Wizard” before Butler came up. Black has long tied himself to that catalog, from a Tenacious D song named for Ronnie James Dio to his speech when Ozzy entered the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

80d22ae22619e16de4e91cb374558bdd26c55c89.headline: Hassett tells Kudlow it’s time for Powell to leave the Fed board
80d22ae22619e16de4e91cb374558bdd26c55c89.summary: National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett told Larry Kudlow on Sunday Morning Futures that former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell should leave the Fed board now that his chairmanship is over. Hassett called the extended stay “completely unprecedented” and said Powell should “move on” and “respect the independence of the Fed” rather than keep a visible partisan split inside the central bank. He argued an independent Fed is what the economy needs, and that Powell’s lingering role is getting in the way of that.

4b09d38feb51cb460ac22309f9fa02acd63e6202.headline: Jets fall 23–12 at Chicago as Bears hold the ball for nearly 43 minutes
4b09d38feb51cb460ac22309f9fa02acd63e6202.summary: The Jets fell behind early and lost 23–12 to the Bears at Soldier Field on Sunday, dropping to 1–3 while Chicago improved to 3–1. Kyle Monangai ran for two Bears touchdowns, and Chicago piled up 492 total yards and 34 first downs while holding the ball for 42:45; the Jets went 0-for-7 on third down. Minkah Fitzpatrick, in his first action since Week 1, had 16 tackles and the team’s first interception of the season, but the Jets were flagged 12 times, including three penalties that wiped out other interceptions. Geno Smith’s 58-yard touchdown to Isaiah Williams came late, and head coach Aaron Glenn said he was “very, very disappointed on a number of different levels.”

c5b7a445d1ee308abbfa3df80e3e2c67bfcf1cc9.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula in Brazil’s early count, just above the line that avoids a runoff
c5b7a445d1ee308abbfa3df80e3e2c67bfcf1cc9.summary: Brazil’s electoral court showed Flávio Bolsonaro, the conservative senator and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, ahead of President Lula in Sunday’s first-round count. At 5:32 PM Eastern, with about 37% of polling stations counted, Flávio had 50.63% of valid votes to Lula’s 41.23%, a gap of about 4 million votes. A candidate needs more than half of the valid votes in the final count to win outright; otherwise the top two meet in a runoff on October 25. The count was far from finished, and several northeastern states where Lula leads were less than a third counted, so the shares were expected to move. The final Datafolha poll had shown Lula slightly ahead.

9020da691c7ed65b3e790c4a7eb98dd13fc5e3bf.headline: U.S. pulls all its bombers out of RAF Fairford after last month’s terror-plot arrests
9020da691c7ed65b3e790c4a7eb98dd13fc5e3bf.summary: The U.S. Air Force has sent every bomber it had deployed at RAF Fairford in England back to home stations in the United States, a Pentagon spokesperson confirmed to CBS News on Sunday. The move follows a security incident last month in which five British men in their 20s were arrested near the base, which American bombers have used for strikes on Iran; police found gasoline in three vans tied to the suspects but no explosives. A dual U.K.-Iranian national was later arrested on suspicion of plotting an attack and has been released on bail. The Pentagon said B-1, B-2 and B-52 crews remain ready to strike “anywhere, anytime,” including from the continental United States.

522b768897b68feccd8a9cab73690d07a371d353.headline: Arizona appeals court tosses a killer’s sentence because the judge ‘loved’ an AI video of the victim
522b768897b68feccd8a9cab73690d07a371d353.summary: The Arizona Court of Appeals has ordered a new sentencing for Gabriel Paul Horcasitas, who got the maximum 10½ years for the 2021 road-rage shooting death of Christopher Pelkey. At the 2025 hearing, Pelkey’s sister played an AI-generated video in which a replica of Pelkey offered “forgiveness,” and Maricopa County Judge Todd Lang said, “I loved that AI.” The appeals judges wrote that the video “clearly impacted the sentencing judge” and “does not reflect actual events,” making the sentencing “fundamentally unfair.” The manslaughter sentence was vacated and sent back for resentencing.

46cead8e2d70358c00b80ae960bf8fcafd73711e.headline: North Korea’s new missile test could put Guam in range as Kim brushes off Trump
46cead8e2d70358c00b80ae960bf8fcafd73711e.summary: North Korea fired what it called an intermediate-range strategic missile on October 3, part of a “hypersonic strategic weapon system” that state media said flew about 621 miles into waters off the east coast, with Kim Jong Un watching. Former U.S. Forces Korea analyst Sydney Seiler told Fox News Digital that a missile in that class, which flies roughly 3,000 to 5,000 kilometers, would bring Guam, parts of Alaska and Japan into range. Hours after the launch, Trump told an Ohio rally, “I get along great with Kim Jong Un.” Seiler said the test likely was not a direct answer to Trump, but “North Korea simply isn’t interested in talking right now.”

9193f0ef15c6f6a95402bbe576174c9255970769.headline: Trump renews his $5,000 check promise, but only if Republicans keep Congress
9193f0ef15c6f6a95402bbe576174c9255970769.summary: In a Truth Social video on Saturday, Trump said that if Republicans win the House and Senate in November, he will give every adult citizen $5,000. He has not said where the money would come from or who would approve it; CNBC estimates the cost at roughly $1.2 trillion, which would need an act of Congress. The pledge comes alongside $90 payments to 20.8 million Medicare enrollees and $500 Obamacare “refund” checks already going out. Rep. David Schweikert, R-Ariz., has vowed to fight the idea over deficit and interest-rate worries, and polls are split: Rasmussen found likely voters 47% to 48% on it, while 57% in an Economist/YouGov survey doubted he would deliver.

b7cd631373e9eb678c2f908ab7cf84b471b08d09.headline: Sen. John Kennedy says he is thinking about a 2028 run if ‘a bunch of goobers’ jump in
b7cd631373e9eb678c2f908ab7cf84b471b08d09.summary: Asked on NBC’s “Meet the Press” on Sunday whether he is thinking about running for president, Louisiana Republican Sen. John Kennedy answered, “Yeah.” He said his plan for now is to seek re-election to the Senate in 2028, but “if a bunch of goobers run, and I think they’re goobers and one of the goobers might win, and I think I could do a better job, I would consider running.” Kennedy would not say why voters should pick him over Vice President JD Vance, who is widely seen as a likely candidate, and said a full field would be good for both parties.

805d94d880101b43382a3df3c6c3fcd59797ade0.headline: Utah’s colleges approve security upgrades a year after Charlie Kirk’s assassination
805d94d880101b43382a3df3c6c3fcd59797ade0.summary: The Utah System of Higher Education on Friday approved a campus security review prompted by Charlie Kirk’s killing during a live debate event at Utah Valley University a little more than a year ago. The report lists 25 areas for improvement across the state’s campuses, including a standard process for securing campus events, real-time sharing of threat information between schools, and better communication with police and private security working events. Keith Squires, the state Department of Public Safety chief and one of the authors, called it a chance to bring every campus up to the same level of safety. Tyler Robinson, who is accused of killing Kirk, has pleaded not guilty.

210b6596fa9830f728847f6341989001b36d9f7d.headline: DHS tells Paramore’s Hayley Williams to thank ICE officers after her ‘F— ICE’ concert outburst
210b6596fa9830f728847f6341989001b36d9f7d.summary: Paramore frontwoman Hayley Williams shouted “F— ICE!” and “Free Palestine!” during her solo show Saturday night in Chula Vista, California, while performing her song “Ice in My OJ,” lines she has been adding throughout her 2026 tour. A Department of Homeland Security spokesperson answered on Sunday: “America is grateful all the time for our federal law enforcement officers who keep us safe. We suggest Ms. Williams to thank them for their service, not belittle their sacrifice.” DHS says it recorded 647 assaults on ICE personnel between January 2025 and September 2026, compared with 37 in the comparable 2021–2022 period.

608fe4fba795aee0b6dbf55440e7b00b3a1d5e68.headline: Florida TikTok ‘grey hat hacker’ is jailed again over posts exposing women’s private data
608fe4fba795aee0b6dbf55440e7b00b3a1d5e68.summary: Mark Stephen Asea, 36, of Port St. Lucie, a TikTok creator who calls himself a “demonologist” and “Grey Hat Hacker,” was booked into the St. Lucie County Jail on September 30 on a felony charge of offense against computer users, with bond set at $35,000. Two women told police their private information showed up in his posts; in one video he allegedly taunted a woman with “let’s talk about your actual password” and her last 10 online purchases. Asea was first arrested in April on stalking and computer charges, which prosecutors dropped in May before filing the new computer-access charge in September.

4bc93c4661cbbf57da9912605d5ed61c254c77ae.headline: Apple CEO John Ternus is working hands-on in the design studio several times a week
4bc93c4661cbbf57da9912605d5ed61c254c77ae.summary: About a month into the job, Apple CEO John Ternus has immersed himself in the company’s industrial design and human interface teams, working in the studio several times a week and sometimes more than once a day, according to Mark Gurman’s reporting summarized by 9to5Mac. Former CEO Tim Cook reportedly visited about once a month. Ternus has also focused on refilling design roles after departures to Meta and OpenAI, promoting junior designers and hiring from outside. Apple is not searching for a Jony Ive-style chief design officer; Molly Anderson and Steve Lemay lead the two teams, with Ternus making the final design calls.

f381def8976053c057c5291f234d12dc8edc4400.headline: Mac malware hides its commands inside a public iCloud calendar event
f381def8976053c057c5291f234d12dc8edc4400.summary: Kaspersky researchers found a new version of MacSync, an information-stealing malware for macOS, that in one infection chain pulled hidden commands from the description of a public iCloud calendar event and fed them to the Mac’s command shell to download more malware. The calendar does not infect anyone by itself; the attack starts after a user runs a malicious app, often disguised as free or cracked software or delivered through fake “copy and run this command” prompts. The new version also disguises itself as Finder to survive restarts, and attackers promoted a fake crypto wallet called Toria on X and Telegram.

030d9c2e7848bd8c4da78c000493ac445452dbd7.headline: ‘The Book of Elon’ author says Musk is driven by curiosity and mission more than money
030d9c2e7848bd8c4da78c000493ac445452dbd7.summary: Eric Jorgenson, author of “The Book of Elon: A Guide to Purpose and Success,” told Fox News Digital that he reviewed millions of words of Musk’s interviews and appearances to pull out the ideas behind Tesla, SpaceX and xAI. He says Musk’s work flows from what Musk calls a “philosophy of curiosity,” and that his ideas about multi-planetary life and electric and self-driving cars date back to his college years. The book walks through Musk’s five-step engineering process, known as “the algorithm,” and how his companies use it. Jorgenson says his goal is to “create one million Musks” by teaching readers the methods.

f39f360e4dbe897af8e5e0b8e739b5a66ef6fa10.headline: Devin Townsend opens up about a 36-year breakup and the money crunch that sent him back on tour
f39f360e4dbe897af8e5e0b8e739b5a66ef6fa10.summary: Former Strapping Young Lad frontman Devin Townsend told the Sixty Scales And The Truth podcast that a “financial Armageddon” pushed him back on stage a year and a half after announcing an indefinite break from touring. He is in the middle of “Metamorphosis,” a 23-show solo tour across 10 European countries. Townsend said his dog died and he split with his partner of 36 years, calling it “devastating,” and said he does not plan to go home to British Columbia and expects to relocate to Spain. His orchestral album “The Moth” came out in May.

d3af21a72a6dae744690caefd2d886ba61bf1cb6.headline: Trumbull boys soccer wins its third straight, edging New Canaan 1–0; Wilton is next Tuesday
d3af21a72a6dae744690caefd2d886ba61bf1cb6.summary: Trumbull’s defense carried the Eagles past New Canaan 1–0 on Friday, their third win in a row, raising their record to 8–3–1. Trumbull hosts Wilton at 6:00 p.m. on Tuesday. The Warriors, ranked 40th in MaxPreps’ Connecticut rankings, are 6–3–2 after a surprise 3–2 loss to 170th-ranked Ludlowe on Friday and have gone 2–3–2 since a four-game winning streak ended.
